title.en: ‘Too little response’ to Russian strikes on Ukraine, Zelenskyy says after latest deadly attacks – Europe live
title.zh: 泽连斯基称俄军袭击乌克兰回应“太少”，在最新致命袭击后呼吁盟友采取更多行动

summary.en: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy has stated that the international response to recent deadly Russian attacks on Ukraine has been insufficient. He made this call for greater action from allies following overnight strikes that resulted in two fatalities. Meanwhile, in Germany, Alice Weidel of the AfD party...
summary.zh: 乌克兰总统弗拉基米尔·泽连斯基表示，国际社会对近期俄罗斯致命袭击乌克兰的回应“太少”。在造成两人死亡的夜间袭击之后，他呼吁盟友采取更多行动。与此同时，在德国，选择党（AfD）的爱丽丝·维德尔在联邦议院表示，周末萨克森-安哈尔特州的选举结果表明“人民终于想要政策改变”，并称现任执政联盟应被“推翻”。

body.en: Ukrainian leader calls for more action from allies following overnight attacks in which two people died Over in Germany, AfD’s Alice Weidel said in the Bundestag the result of the Saxony-Anhalt election over the weekend showed “the people finally want a change in policy,” saying the ruling coalition should be “over.” She also harshly criticised the government’s track record on migration , “war propaganda” against Russia, and on energy, calling for resumption of deliveries through the Nord Stream pipeline. Continue reading...
body.zh: 德国选择党的艾丽丝·韦德尔在联邦议院表示，周末的萨克森-安哈尔特州选举结果表明“人民最终希望改变政策”，并称执政联盟应该“结束”。她还严厉批评政府在移民、针对俄罗斯的“战争宣传”以及能源方面的记录，呼吁恢复通过北溪管道的输送。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The news of continued deadly strikes in Ukraine, met with a call for more international action, underscores the tragic cycle of conflict. President Zelenskyy's plea echoes the deep human yearning for an end to violence. The challenge remains to find pathways that overcome escalating hostility, not by mirroring it, but by seeking just and lasting peace.
reflection.zh: 乌克兰持续遭受致命袭击的消息，以及要求国际社会采取更多行动的呼吁，凸显了冲突的悲剧性循环。泽连斯基总统的恳求呼应了人类对结束暴力的深切渴望。挑战依然在于寻找能够克服不断升级敌意的方式，不是以暴制暴，而是寻求公正持久的和平。

verse.textEn: Do not be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.
verse.textZh: 你不可为恶所胜，反要以善胜恶。

title.en: White Australia party is ‘modern manifestation’ of Nazi movement and should be banned, commonwealth tells high court

The White Australia party, formerly known as the National Socialist Network (NSN), was designated as an illegal hate group in May after the Australian Security and Intelligence Organisation (Asio) passed on its recommendation to the home affairs minister, Tony Burke. Continue reading...

Acts 17:26 reminds us that Yahweh has made from one man every nation and all peoples to live on all the face of the earth. This truth challenges any ideology that seeks to divide or elevate one group over...
reflection.zh: 白澳大利亚党被指为纳粹运动的“现代表现”，这引发了关于身份和归属感的深刻问题。使徒行传17:26提醒我们，雅伟“从一个人造了全人类，让他们住在全地上”。这一真理挑战了任何试图基于种族或出身来划分或抬高某一群体于另一群体的意识形态。

verse.textEn: From one man he made all the nations, that they should inhabit the whole earth.
verse.textZh: 他从一本造出万族的人，住在全地上。

Andrew Frederick’s body was found in the property he was staying at in Grenada on 4 January. An autopsy, performed in the same week by a privately hired pathologist, concluded that the 47-year-old’s death was a homicide. Continue reading...

Their plea for cooperation between local and UK investigators highlights the deep human need for answers and accountability when a life is tragically cut short. This situation calls for compassion and a commitment to uncovering the...
reflection.zh: 安德鲁·弗雷德里克在格林纳达去世后，他的家人正经历着寻求真相和正义的痛苦过程。他们呼吁当地和英国调查机构合作，凸显了在生命被悲惨地缩短时，人们对答案和问责的深切需求。这种情况需要同情心和查明事实的承诺，为留下的人们带来一丝慰藉。

title.en: US slaps import ban on Canadian alcohol, motorbikes and other goods
title.zh: 美国禁止进口加拿大酒类及其他商品

summary.en: The US is banning a slew of Canadian products, including alcoholic spirits, dairy goods, and motor vehicles, as Canadian retaliatory tariffs on American goods come into force. This is the latest escalation in a trade war between the two countries, with no new talks scheduled since negotiations collapsed in late August.
summary.zh: 随着加拿大对美国商品实施报复性关税，美国正在禁止包括酒精饮料、乳制品和汽车在内的一系列加拿大产品。这是两国贸易战的最新升级，自8月下旬谈判破裂以来，双方未安排新的会谈。

body.en:
The US is banning a slew of Canadian products, including alcoholic spirits, dairy goods and motorbikes, as its neighbour's retaliatory tariffs on American goods come into force.

In a series of executive orders on Tuesday, President Donald Trump said Canada is "discriminating" against the US and outlined the import bans, which will begin on 29 September.

Earlier on Tuesday, Canada's Prime Minister Mark Carney said in a video address that his country's move away from the US as its largest trading partner "will come at a cost".

Both US and Canadian officials have said they would like to strike a trade deal, but no new talks have been scheduled since negotiations collapsed in late August.

The White House's new sanctions are the latest strike in a months-long trade war between the US and Canada. The two countries have historically been close allies, with each a key business partner to the other.

On the other hand, Canada is the second-largest trading partner of the US, after Mexico, although its exports are far more diversified.

Business owners on both sides of the border have expressed fears over the trade war's fallout . Many expect prices of goods to rise and the number of customers to fall.

Last month, the White House imposed 50% tariffs on around $20bn (£14.8bn) of Canadian goods after several rounds of talks had broken down.

Those tariffs hit sectors including Canada's furniture and wine industries, as well as some sporting and fishing equipment businesses.

Canada responded with dollar-for-dollar tariffs on US goods like steel, clothing and furniture. The counter-duties came into effect after midnight on Tuesday.

Canada is "discriminating" against US businesses by restricting American goods while not doing the same to the same products from other countries, the White House said when announcing the new import restrictions on Tuesday.

Some products, like whey and non-alcoholic beer, have been banned from import entirely, while tariffs have been further hiked for others, including cheeses and motorboats.

Washington has targeted "significant industries" for Canada, including its politically influential dairy businesses , said economics lecturer Scott French from the University of New South Wales in Australia.

Trump has previously argued that Canada's system - which has production quotas, set pricing, and import limits on dairy, eggs, and poultry - is unreasonable to US farmers.

The import bans and new tariffs will also put Canada's leaders under more pressure to resist Trump's demands for concessions, French said.

The trade war will be "costly for both sides due to the historical level of integration of the North American economy," he said, adding that consumers on both sides will end up as "the biggest losers".

On Monday, Trump hinted...
body.zh: 随着加拿大对美国商品征收报复性关税生效，美国正在禁止大量加拿大产品，包括烈酒、乳制品和机动车辆。 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普在周二发布的一系列行政命令中表示，加拿大“歧视”美国，并概述了将于 9 月 29 日开始实施的进口禁令。 周二早些时候，加拿大总理马克·卡尼在视频讲话中表示，加拿大放弃美国作为其最大贸易伙伴的地位“将付出代价”。 美国和加拿大官员均表示希望达成贸易协议，但自八月底谈判破裂以来尚未安排新的谈判。 BBC 已联系加拿大总理马克·卡尼办公室征求评论。 白宫的新制裁是美国和加拿大之间长达数月的贸易战中的最新打击。双方历来都是亲密盟友，彼此都是对方的重要商业伙伴。 美国是加拿大最大的贸易伙伴——其出口总额的三分之二以上销往其邻国。 另一方面，加拿大是美国第二大贸易伙伴，仅次于墨西哥，尽管其出口更加多元化。 边境两边的企业主都表达了对贸易战后果的担忧。许多人预计商品价格会上涨，而顾客数量会下降。 上个月，在几轮谈判破裂后，白宫对约 200 亿美元（148 亿英镑）的加拿大商品征收 50% 的关税。 这些关税打击了加拿大家具和葡萄酒行业以及体育和渔业设备行业等行业。 作为回应，加拿大对钢铁、服装和家具等美国商品征收报复性关税。反关税措施于周二午夜后生效。 白宫在周二宣布新的进口限制时表示，加拿大限制美国商品的分销，而不是对其他国家的此类产品采取同样的措施，这是对美国企业的“歧视”。 根据总统签署的一系列白宫声明，这一应对措施针对的是各种酒精饮料和乳清等乳制品。 周一，特朗​​普暗示将实施更多贸易限制，并警告加拿大飞机公司庞巴迪，除非将生产转移到美国，否则它将无法再在美国销售其产品。 特朗普长期以来一直认为关税将有助于减少美国与其他国家之间的贸易失衡，但他范围广泛的关税计划令美国许多传统盟友感到不安。 8月，特朗普下令将安大略湖更名为美洲湖，引起加拿大人和部分美国人的轩然大波。

reflection.en: The escalating trade war between the US and Canada, marked by import bans and retaliatory tariffs, highlights a breakdown in peaceful relations. The call to 'live at peace with everyone' (Romans 12:18) is a profound challenge when economic and political tensions rise, urging a pursuit of reconciliation even amidst conflict.
reflection.zh: 美加之间不断升级的贸易战，以进口禁令和报复性关税为标志，凸显了和平关系的破裂。《罗马书》12章18节呼吁“务要随众和睦”，这在经济和政治紧张局势加剧时是一个深刻的挑战，敦促人们在冲突中也要寻求和解。

verse.textEn: If it is possible, as far as it depends on you, live at peace with everyone.
verse.textZh: 若是能行，总要尽力与众人和睦。

title.en: Putin rejects mobilization rumors, many Russians unconvinced
title.zh: 普京否认动员传言，许多俄罗斯人仍不信

summary.en: Russian President Vladimir Putin has dismissed rumors of military mobilization, calling them 'complete nonsense' and an 'information attack.' However, many Russians, including DW readers, are preparing for the possibility, indicating a lack of trust in the official statements.
summary.zh: 俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京已否认有关军事动员的传言，称其为“纯属无稽之谈”和“信息攻击”。然而，许多俄罗斯人，包括德国之声的读者，正在为这种可能性做准备，这表明他们不信任官方声明。

body.en:
Russia’s President Vladimir Putin has dismissed rumors about military mobilization. But many Russians, including many DW users, say they are preparing for the possibility.

Twice within the first week of September, Russian President Vladimir Putin publicly dismissed rumors of a looming mobilization campaign in the country. On September 1, Putin called the rumors "complete nonsense" and described them as an "information attack" against Russia .

Two days later, on September 3, at the Economic Forum in Vladivostok, Putin said that "there is no scenario today that would require mobilization."

DW's Russian service asked readers in Russia, on condition of anonymity, whether they see signs of an impending mobilization . The most common response from DW readers concerned receiving summonses from military enlistments offices.

"My nephew received a summons for data verification," wrote a reader from the industrial city of Naberezhnye Chelny.

"I received a summons ordering me to appear for data verification. I'm self-employed. What should I do?"  wrote a user named Maxim.

"One of my friends, a school teacher, received a summons through the government services portal [Gosuslugi] on July 9 to update his records," said another reader, Sergei.

People fear that they may be called up for military service or lose the ability to leave the country freely. As a result, some of those who have received draft notices are seeking to travel abroad as quickly as possible, while restrictions on leaving the country have not yet taken effect.

"One acquaintance of mine left Russia two months ago after receiving a summons for data verification from the military enlistment office," one reader wrote.

Not everyone, however, sees emigration as a realistic option in the event of mobilization.

"As for leaving, that's a fantasy. Where would you go, and more importantly, with what money?" one DW reader wrote.

In June, reports emerged from Russia's Penza region that men were forcibly taken to military enlistment offices and pressured into signing military contracts. According to local reports, the practice became widespread enough that residents organized protests in support of relatives and neighbors. Journalists reporting on the issue say such raids are continuing.

"People are being detained, particularly near the entrances to their apartment buildings," Lena Lemyasova, a journalist with news outlet Important Stories [Vazhnye Istorii] , told DW. "Often men who have been drinking. Unknown individuals approach them, or vehicles pull up — often cars provided by local authorities. The men are simply seized and taken away, then their families and neighbors hear nothing more. Later, information sometimes emerges that they were transported to military units. They are often...
body.zh: 俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京否认了有关军事动员的传言。但许多俄罗斯人，包括许多德国之声用户，表示他们正在为这种可能性做好准备。 9 月第一周内，俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京 (Vladimir Putin) 两次公开驳斥了该国即将开展动员运动的传言。 9月1日，普京称这些谣言“完全是无稽之谈”，并将其描述为针对俄罗斯的“信息攻击”。 两天后，即 9 月 3 日，普京在符拉迪沃斯托克举行的经济论坛上表示，“今天没有任何情况需要动员”。 德国之声俄语部门向不愿透露姓名的俄罗斯读者询问他们是否看到了即将动员的迹象。德国之声读者最常见的反应是收到征兵办公室的传票。 “我的侄子收到了一份要求核实数据的传票，”一位来自工业城市卡马河畔切尔尼的读者写道。 “我收到传票，要求我出庭核实数据。我是个体经营者。我该怎么办？” 一位名叫马克西姆的用户写道。 “我的一个朋友，一名学校老师，7 月 9 日通过政府服务门户网站 [Gosuslugi] 收到传票，要求更新他的记录，”另一位读者谢尔盖 (Sergei) 说。 人们担心他们可能会被征召入伍或失去自由离开该国的能力。因此，一些收到征兵通知的人正在寻求尽快出国旅行，而出境限制尚未生效。 一位读者写道：“我的一位熟人在收到征兵办公室的数据核实传票后，两个月前离开了俄罗斯。” 然而，并非所有人都认为移民是动员时的现实选择。 “至于离开，那是一个幻想。你会去哪里，更重要的是，带着什么钱？”一位《德国之声》读者写道。 六月，俄罗斯奔萨地区有报道称，男子被强行带到征兵办公室，并被迫签署军事合同。据当地报道，这种做法变得非常普遍，以至于居民组织了抗议活动来支持亲戚和邻居。报道这一问题的记者表示，此类突袭仍在继续。 “人们被拘留，特别是在公寓楼入口附近，”新闻媒体《重要故事》的记者莱娜·莱米亚索娃 (Lena Lemyasova) 告诉德国之声。 “通常是喝了酒的男人。不明身份的人接近他们，或者车辆停下来——通常是地方当局提供的汽车。这些人只是被抓住并带走，然后他们的家人和邻居就再也听不到任何消息。后来，有时有消息称他们被运送到军事单位。他们经常......

reflection.en: Amidst rumors of military mobilization and official denials, many Russians are experiencing significant fear and uncertainty about the future. Isaiah 41:10 offers a profound reassurance: 'So do not fear, for I am with you; do not be dismayed, for I am your God. I will strengthen you and help you; I will uphold you with my righteous right hand.' This ancient...
reflection.zh: 在关于军事动员的传言和官方否认的背景下，许多俄罗斯人对未来感到极度的恐惧和不确定。以赛亚书41:10 提供了深刻的保证：“不要惧怕，因为我与你同在；不要惊惶，因为我是你的神。我必坚固你，我必帮助你，我必用我公义的右手扶持你。”这古老的应许触及了被焦虑抓住的人心，提醒我们即使在国家动荡和个人忧虑的时刻，雅伟也同在，赐予力量和坚定的支持。

verse.textEn: So do not fear, for I am with you; do not be dismayed, for I am your God.
verse.textZh: 你不要害怕，因为我与你同在；不要惊惶，因为我是你的神。

title.en: Dallas Republican convention: How Trump looms over midterms
title.zh: 达拉斯共和党大会：特朗普如何笼罩中期选举

summary.en: Donald Trump is not on the ballot in the midterm elections, but the first Republican midterm convention is putting him center stage. This strategy could prove risky for the party.
summary.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普并未出现在中期选举的选票上，但首次共和党中期选举大会却将他置于中心舞台。这一策略可能对该党来说是一场冒险。

body.en:
Donald Trump is not on the ballot in the midterm elections — but the first Republican midterm convention is putting him center stage. It's a strategy that could prove risky for the party.

In the midterm elections on Nov. 3, US President Donald Trump will not be on the ballot. Nevertheless, his party is putting him at the center of a major convention two months before the election. On Wednesday and Thursday, Republicans are gathering at the American Airlines Center in Dallas, which can hold around 20,000 spectators, for the "Republican Midterm Convention."

In the United States , this sort of large party conventions are normally only held before presidential elections. Democrats experimented with similar gatherings in the 1970s and early 1980s, but for Republicans, the format is a first. In Texas, they want to mobilize Trump supporters for Republican candidates.

Republicans are heading into the campaign with an unpopular president. According to a recent Reuters/Ipsos poll , Donald Trump had an approval rating of just 33%. On top of that, Democrats are currently much more energized. Nearly half of their supporters say they are especially enthusiastic about the midterm elections, compared with just 31% of Republicans.

Even so, the convention is entirely centered around Trump. The president will appear on both nights, putting him even more prominently in the spotlight than the Republican candidates who will actually be on the ballot for the Senate and House of Representatives in November. But for some of those candidates in particular, being seen as close with Trump poses a risk. A survey of more than 70 Republican candidates and lawmakers by Politico found considerable reluctance toward the convention.

Numerous candidates in competitive districts appear to shy away from being too closely associated with the president. The fact that some candidates are even avoiding their own party's convention altogether highlights the Trump dilemma. On the one hand, he could mobilize the MAGA base . On the other, his presence could also alienate moderate voters and even boost the opposition.

Despite the president's weak poll numbers, the convention's choreography initially focuses on a positive record of his time in office so far. Topics such as the economy , border security, trade and public safety are intended to show what Trump has already accomplished from the Republicans' perspective.

With segments such as "Two Visions for America" and "The Opposition Contrast," the convention is designed as an attack on the Democrats. Republicans portray them as a party dominated by the political left and a Democratic congressional majority as a threat to Trump's policies so far. In fact, it could block his agenda over...
body.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普并未出现在中期选举的选票上，但第一次共和党中期代表大会将他置于舞台中央。这一策略可能会给该党带来风险。 在 11 月 3 日的中期选举中，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普将不会参加投票。尽管如此，他的政党还是将他置于大选前两个月举行的一次重要大会的中心位置。周三和周四，共和党人将聚集在达拉斯的美国航空中心，该中心可容纳约 20,000 名观众，举行“共和党中期代表大会”。 在美国，这种大型党代会通常只在总统选举前举行。民主党在 20 世纪 70 年代和 1980 年代初尝试过类似的集会，但对于共和党来说，这种形式尚属首次。在德克萨斯州，他们希望动员特朗普的支持者支持共和党候选人。 共和党人正在与一位不受欢迎的总统一起参加竞选。根据路透社/益普索最近的一项民意调查，唐纳德·特朗普的支持率仅为 33%。最重要的是，民主党目前更加充满活力。近一半的支持者表示，他们对中期选举特别热情，而共和党人的这一比例仅为 31%。 即便如此，大会仍然完全以特朗普为中心。总统将在两个晚上都露面，这使他比实际上将在 11 月份参加参议院和众议院投票的共和党候选人更受关注。但特别是对于其中一些候选人来说，被视为与特朗普关系密切会带来风险。 Politico 对 70 多名共和党候选人和立法者进行的一项调查发现，人们对召开大会相当不情愿。 竞争激烈的选区的许多候选人似乎都回避与总统有过于密切的联系。一些候选人甚至完全回避自己政党的全国代表大会，这一事实凸显了特朗普的困境。一方面，他可以动员 MAGA 基地。另一方面，他的存在也可能疏远温和派选民，甚至助长反对派。 尽管总统的民意支持率较低，但大会的编排最初侧重于他迄今为止在任期间的积极记录。经济、边境安全、贸易和公共安全等话题旨在从共和党的角度展示特朗普已经取得的成就。 大会通过“美国的两种愿景”和“反对派对比”等部分来攻击民主党。共和党人将他们描绘成一个由政治左派和民主党国会多数派主导的政党，对特朗普迄今为止的政策构成威胁。事实上，这可能会阻碍他的议程......

reflection.en: The Republican party is centering its midterm convention around Donald Trump, a figure not on the ballot. This strategy raises questions about political focus and the pursuit of effective leadership. Proverbs 18:15 reminds us that the discerning heart seeks knowledge and understanding, a principle applicable to any group strategizing for future success.
reflection.zh: 共和党将其中期选举大会的焦点集中在并未出现在选票上的唐纳德·特朗普身上。这一策略引发了关于政治重心和有效领导力追求的疑问。箴言18:15提醒我们，明达人的心寻求知识和理解，这一原则适用于任何为未来成功进行战略规划的团体。

verse.textEn: The heart of the discerning acquires knowledge, for the ears of the wise seek it out.
verse.textZh: 聪明人的心得知识；智慧人的耳求知识。

title.zh: 加拿大称其可以在没有美国的情况下“转型并繁荣”。但代价是什么？

summary.en: Canada and the US have "arguably the most interconnected trade" in the world — and tariffs will likely hit those in the middle. The escalating trade war between the United States and Canada could cause mass layoffs across North America, as the long-term allies find themselves "at serious odds". Canada matched the US...

body.en:
The escalating trade war between the United States and Canada could cause mass layoffs across North America, as the long-term allies find themselves "at serious odds".

The latest round of retaliatory tariffs took effect overnight, as Canada matched the US by imposing levies of up to 50 per cent on US$20 billion ($27.7 billion) worth of US goods.

The Canadian levies follow 50 per cent tariffs the US imposed on some US$20 billion ($27.7 billion) of Canadian goods last month , after several rounds of negotiations collapsed, with no new talks scheduled.

The breakdown has widened a rift between the longtime allies, both of whom have blamed the other for the failed talks, as the 18-month-old trade war intensifies.

But the costs could go beyond economics, as the countries have historically relied on close trade and supply-chain ties.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

As former US ambassador to Canada David Cohen explained, many products, such as motor vehicles, cross the two countries' borders several times during the manufacturing process.

"The trade relationship between the United States and Canada is arguably the most interconnected trade relationship anywhere in the world," he told ABC Radio National on Wednesday morning.

The "people getting hurt" are not the leaders of Canada and the US, he added, but small and medium-sized businesses getting "caught in the middle".

On Monday, US President Donald Trump said on social media that Canadian private jet maker Bombardier would no longer be allowed to sell its planes in the US unless it started manufacturing in the country, without saying whether an official government order would follow.

While Bombardier is owned by Canada, the company employs more than 1,000 US workers in Kansas and works with US companies across 47 states.

Blocking this manufacturing is a "clear example" of the two countries' interconnectedness, Cohen said, as an attempt to punish Canada will also affect US workers.

"In a trade war, the only people being hurt are small businesses and individual employees in both Canada and the United States. That can't go on. We have to find a resolution to it," Cohen said.

Jessica Genauer, an expert in international conflict and international relations at the University of NSW, said recent animosity stems back to Trump's first term as president and has been reignited.

"What we're seeing now is a much more fractious, deep-seated antagonism that's starting to emerge," she told SBS News.

Comments made by Trump that undermine Canada's sovereignty and national identity, such as referring to the country as a 51st state of the US, have been "particularly egregious" to Canadians.

reflection.en: The escalating trade war between Canada and the US, marked by retaliatory tariffs and collapsed negotiations, illustrates the difficulty of maintaining peace between close allies. Even as nations assert their independence, the call to 'live at peace with everyone' remains a challenge, urging us to seek reconciliation over conflict.
reflection.zh: 加拿大和美国之间不断升级的贸易战，以报复性关税和谈判破裂为标志，说明了在亲密盟友之间维持和平的困难。即使国家宣称独立，‘与众人和睦’的呼召仍然是一个挑战，促使我们寻求和解而非冲突。

verse.textEn: If it is possible, as far as it depends on you, live at peace with everyone.

title.en: South Park creators rename show 'South America' in apparent dig at Trump
title.zh: 《南方公园》创作者将节目更名为“南美洲”，似乎在嘲讽特朗普

summary.en: The creators of the animated show 'South Park' have announced that the new series will be named 'South America,' seemingly in response to US President Donald Trump's attempts to rename geographical features with the word 'America.' Trump has previously ordered the renaming of Lake Ontario to Lake America and suggested...
summary.zh: 动画节目《南方公园》的创作者宣布新系列将更名为《南美洲》，这似乎是对美国总统唐纳德·特朗普试图用“美洲”一词重命名地理特征的回应。特朗普此前曾下令将安大略湖更名为“美洲湖”，并建议将墨西哥湾称为“美洲湾”。

body.en:
The creators of South Park, the animated TV show, have announced that its new series will be named South America, in an apparent reference to US President Donald Trump's attempts to rename a lake and a gulf.

"Inspired by the bravery and patriotism of Apple and Google, we are changing the name of South Park to SOUTH AMERICA," creators Matt Stone and Trey Parker wrote in a statement.

Trump signed an executive order in August to rename Lake Ontario as Lake America, and last year declared that the Gulf of Mexico be known as the Gulf of America.

The announcement from South Park, now in its 29th season, comes after the show won an Emmy for Outstanding Animated Program on Sunday.

The official name change shared to the show's official social media account featured an image of the South Park sign with the word 'Park' replaced with 'America'.

"We especially want to thank our parent company Paramount - a Skydance Capitulation," its creators said in the post.

Paramount Skydance is the show's parent company. The Trump administration this year approved a $111bn (£82.8bn) merger with Warner Bros Discovery - one of the biggest media deals in history.

But the merger has since been paused until June 2027, after 12 US states filed lawsuits against the deal for fear of it harming competition and leading to higher prices for consumers.

A day before the show's announcement, Trump shared an AI-generated video of him placing the word 'America' over 'Mexico' on a "Welcome to New Mexico" sign.

In August, as trade tensions escalated between the US and Canada, Trump ordered a similar change for Lake Ontario - renaming it Lake America.

Apple and Google subsequently changed the name in their respective Maps apps for US-based users.

And last year, Trump ordered the Gulf of Mexico be renamed as Gulf of America. Mexico has rejected the name change, arguing a single country cannot rename a shared body of international water.

South Park, which has run since 1997, has regularly mocked the US president during his two presidency terms.

Both its creators, Stone and Parker, have repeatedly drawn criticism from Trump, the White House and MAGA supporters for its jabs at the president.

During its 27th season, the White House described South Park as a "fourth-rate" show that was "hanging on by a thread with uninspired ideas in a desperate attempt for attention", after an episode depicted Trump naked in bed with Satan .

After winning the award for Outstanding Animated Program on Sunday, South Park also shared an image depicting a fictionalised Donald Trump with the words: "You finally got your Emmy."
body.zh: 动画电视节目《南方公园》的创作者宣布，其新系列将被命名为“南美洲”，这显然是指美国总统唐纳德·特朗普试图重新命名湖泊和海湾。 创作者马特·斯通和特雷·帕克在一份声明中写道：“受到苹果和谷歌的勇敢和爱国主义的启发，我们将南方公园的名字改为南美洲。” 特朗普于8月签署行政命令，将安大略湖更名为美洲湖，并于去年宣布将墨西哥湾更名为美洲湾。 南方公园现已播出第 29 季，周日该剧荣获艾美奖最佳动画节目奖后，该剧宣布了这一消息。 分享到该剧官方社交媒体账户的官方更名内容是南方公园标志的图片，其中“公园”一词被“美国”取代。 “我们特别要感谢我们的母公司派拉蒙 - Skydance Capitulation，”其创作者在帖子中表示。 派拉蒙 Skydance 是该剧的母公司。特朗普政府今年批准了与华纳兄弟探索公司 (Warner Bros Discovery) 价值 1,110 亿美元（828 亿英镑）的合并，这是历史上最大的媒体交易之一。 但由于担心该交易损害竞争并导致消费者支付更高的价格，美国 12 个州对该交易提起诉讼，此后合并一直暂停到 2027 年 6 月。 在节目宣布的前一天，特朗普分享了一段人工智能生成的视频，视频中他将“美国”一词放在“欢迎来到新墨西哥州”标志上的“墨西哥”之上。 八月，随着美国和加拿大之间的贸易紧张局势升级，特朗普下令对安大略湖进行类似的改变——将其更名为美国湖。 苹果和谷歌随后为美国用户更改了各自地图应用程序的名称。 去年，特朗普下令将墨西哥湾更名为美洲湾。墨西哥拒绝更名，认为单一国家无法重新命名共享的国际水域。 《南方公园》自 1997 年开始运营，在美国总统的两届总统任期内经常嘲笑他。 它的创始人斯通和帕克都因其对总统的攻击而多次招致特朗普、白宫和 MAGA 支持者的批评。 在第 27 季中，白宫将《南方公园》描述为“四流”节目，在其中一集描绘特朗普与撒旦赤身裸体地躺在床上后，“以毫无创意的想法濒临崩溃，拼命试图吸引注意力”。 在周日获得最佳动画节目奖后，南方公园还分享了一张描绘虚构的唐纳德·特朗普的图片，并写道：“你终于得到了艾美奖。”

reflection.en: The creators of 'South Park' are engaging in a form of satirical commentary, renaming their show 'South America' in response to President Trump's efforts to rename geographical features. This act of renaming, while perhaps intended humorously, echoes the ancient story of Babel, where human ambition and the desire to make a name for themselves led to...
reflection.zh: 《南方公园》的创作者们通过将他们的节目更名为“南美洲”，以回应特朗普总统重命名地理特征的举动，进行了一种讽刺性的评论。这种更名行为，尽管可能是出于幽默，却呼应了古代巴别塔的故事，当时人类的野心和想要扬名立万的愿望导致了混乱和分裂。这促使我们反思我们如何使用语言和象征，以及我们试图确立身份或控制叙事的努力，最终是带来更大的理解还是意想不到的后果。

verse.textEn: Yahweh said, 'If as one people speaking the same language they have begun to do this, then nothing they plan to do will be impossible for them.'
verse.textZh: 雅伟说：「看哪，他们成为一样的人民，都是一样的言语，如今既做起这事来，以后他们所要做的事就没有不成就的了。」

title.en: US strikes Iranian oil tankers as Tehran targets American base in Jordan
title.zh: 美军袭击伊朗油轮，德黑兰袭击约旦美军基地

summary.en: Oil prices neared $100 a barrel following an escalation in retaliatory strikes between the United States and Iran. US forces struck five Iranian oil tankers, sinking one, in response to Iran's repeated targeting of an American warship. Tehran retaliated by launching missiles at a US base in Jordan.
summary.zh: 在美国和伊朗之间报复性打击升级后，油价逼近每桶100美元。美军袭击了五艘伊朗油轮，击沉一艘，以回应伊朗两次袭击美国军舰。德黑兰则向约旦的一处美军基地发射了导弹。

body.en:
US forces struck five Iranian tankers on Tuesday, sinking one, in response to Tehran twice targeting an American warship, US Central Command (Centcom) said.

Four Iranian oil tankers in the Gulf of Oman linked to Iran's Revolutionary Guards Corps (IRGC) were targeted, as well as another near Kharg Island, a major oil terminal off Iran's coast, Centcom added.

Tehran responded by launching missiles at a US base in Jordan - most of which were shot down - and said it attacked two US vessels and eight oil tankers in the Strait of Hormuz.

Tit-for-tat strikes between the two countries have escalated in the past week, more than six months after the US and Israel launched attacks on Iran on 28 February.

Oil prices rose in Asia trading. Benchmark Brent crude was up by 1.5% at $99.35 (£73.35) a barrel, while US-traded oil was 1.3% higher at $94.23.

Jordan said it had shot down 18 of the 20 Iranian missiles, while two of them fell in unpopulated areas, an official spokesperson for the Jordanian Armed Forces said.

After warning of further retaliatory strikes, Iran's Revolutionary Guards said on Wednesday they had attacked two US vessels, eight oil tankers and 10 "non-compliant vessels" trying to pass through the Strait of Hormuz, state media reported.

The latest round of escalation comes after Iran targeted a US warship with ballistic missiles, which Centcom said were "successfully evaded". It added that no American troops were harmed during the attacks.

In response, the US said that the five Iranian oil tankers it targeted were "part of a multi-billion-dollar shadow network that funds the IRGC and its regional proxies".

One of the ships it had struck, the M/T Riesco, sunk in the Gulf of Oman, Centcom later said, posting a video on X of the damaged vessel.

Kharg Island - where one Iranian tanker was attacked in the latest round of US strikes - hosts Iran's main terminal for exporting oil.

Some 90% of the country's crude oil passes through the island in the Gulf, transported through pipes from the mainland.

Also on Tuesday, Yemen's Iran-backed Houthi movement attacked energy facilities and civilian infrastructure in Saudi Arabia, injuring 73 people, according to Saudi authorities.

The drone and missile attack caused fires at oil facilities and installations that led to a temporary halt in operations, Saudi Arabia's military and energy ministry said.

When asked by reporters about the latest tit-for-tat strikes between the US and Iran, US Secretary of State Marco Rubio said the situation was "pretty straightforward".

"Iran continues to try to hit US naval ships. And, for every time they do that or try to do that, they're going to lose tankers. And I think you'll see that again today," Rubio told reporters during a trip in Colombia.

The US strikes on...
body.zh: 美国中央司令部（Centcom）表示，美国军队周二袭击了五艘伊朗油轮，击沉其中一艘，以回应德黑兰两次瞄准一艘美国军舰。 中央司令部补充说，阿曼湾与伊朗革命卫队（IRGC）有联系的四艘伊朗油轮以及伊朗沿海主要石油码头哈格岛附近的另一艘油轮受到攻击。 德黑兰做出回应，向约旦的美国基地发射了导弹，其中大部分被击落，并表示袭击了霍尔木兹海峡的两艘美国船只和八艘油轮。 距离美国和以色列于 2 月 28 日对伊朗发动袭击已过去 6 个多月，两国之间的针锋相对的打击在过去一周不断升级。 亚洲交易时段油价上涨。基准布伦特原油上涨 1.5%，至每桶 99.35 美元（73.35 英镑），而美国交易的石油价格上涨 1.3%，至每桶 94.23 美元。 约旦武装部队官方发言人表示，约旦称已击落 20 枚伊朗导弹中的 18 枚，其中两枚落在无人居住地区。 据官方媒体报道，伊朗革命卫队在发出进一步报复性袭击的警告后，周三表示，他们袭击了两艘美国船只、八艘油轮和 10 艘试图通过霍尔木兹海峡的“违规船只”。 最新一轮升级是在伊朗用弹道导弹瞄准一艘美国军舰之后发生的，中央司令部称其“成功规避”。声明补充说，没有美军在袭击中受伤。 作为回应，美国表示，其针对的五艘伊朗油轮是“为伊斯兰革命卫队及其地区代理人提供资金的数十亿美元影子网络的一部分”。 中央司令部后来说，其中一艘被击中的船只“M/T Riesco”号在阿曼湾沉没，并在 X 上发布了受损船只的视频。 哈格岛——一艘伊朗油轮在美国最新一轮袭击中遭到袭击——是伊朗石油出口的主要码头所在地。 该国约90%的原油经过海湾岛屿，通过管道从大陆输送。 据沙特当局称，周二，也门伊朗支持的胡塞运动袭击了沙特阿拉伯的能源设施和民用基础设施，造成 73 人受伤。 沙特阿拉伯军事和能源部表示，无人机和导弹袭击导致石油设施和装置起火，导致运营暂时停止。 当被记者问及美国和伊朗之间最新的针锋相对的袭击时，美国国务卿卢比奥表示，情况“非常简单”。 “伊朗继续试图袭击美国海军舰艇。而且，每次他们这样做或试图这样做，他们都会失去油轮。我想你今天会再次看到这种情况，”卢比奥在哥伦比亚访问期间告诉记者。 美国袭击...

reflection.en: The cycle of 'tit-for-tat' strikes between the US and Iran, as reported, illustrates a dangerous pattern of retaliation. The news highlights how each act of aggression seems to invite another, pushing towards greater conflict and instability. This dynamic underscores the biblical call to break such cycles, choosing instead to 'overcome evil with good'...
reflection.zh: 报道中描述的美伊之间“针锋相对”的打击循环，展示了一种危险的报复模式。新闻表明，每一次侵略行为似乎都在招致另一次，将局势推向更大的冲突和不稳定。这种动态凸显了圣经中打破此类循环的呼吁，选择“以善胜恶”（罗马书12:21），这是一条在敌意中也需要巨大勇气并致力于和平的道路。

verse.textEn: Do not be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.
verse.textZh: 你不可为恶所胜，反要以善胜恶。

title.en: Hong Kong's first leader after British handover dies
title.zh: 香港首位回归后领导人逝世

summary.en: Tung Chee-hwa, the first chief executive of Hong Kong after its handover from British to Chinese rule, has died at age 89. His time in office, from 1997 to 2005, was characterized by significant challenges including the Asian Financial Crisis, major epidemics, and large-scale protests, leading to his eventual...
summary.zh: 香港首任行政长官董建华在英国将香港移交中国后去世，享年89岁。他在1997年至2005年任职期间，经历了亚洲金融危机、两次重大疫情以及大规模抗议活动等严峻挑战，最终于2005年辞职。

body.en:
Tung Chee-hwa, Hong Kong's first leader after the city returned to Chinese rule, has died at the age of 89.

The former shipping scion took over the reins from the last British Governor Chris Patten in July 1997 when the UK handed Hong Kong back to China , ending more than 150 years of British control.

Tung's rocky tenure was marked by the Asian Financial Crisis, two major epidemics, and historic protests which attracted criticism of his administration. He eventually resigned in 2005.

Tung died on Tuesday night surrounded by loved ones, local media reported. His office described him as a man "devoted to his country and its people".

Born in Shanghai in 1937, Tung graduated with a mechanical engineering degree from Liverpool University in the UK before moving to the US, where he worked at General Electric for almost a decade.

In 1969, he moved to Hong Kong and worked in his father's shipping conglomerate, the Orient Overseas, eventually taking over the reins in 1979.

His political career began in 1992 when he was appointed a member of Patten's executive council.

Despite having little political experience, Tung was believed to be handpicked by Beijing to lead Hong Kong after the handover. He was seen as a loyalist, especially after China's state-run banks helped rescue his family business during a global slump in the mid-1980s.

During a reception at the Great Hall of the People in January 1996, China's then-president Jiang Zemin walked across a packed room to shake Tung's hands – a widely photographed gesture that at the time famously signalled Beijing's backing of Tung for the top job.

The Asian Financial Crisis hit shortly after Tung took over, which sent home prices diving. His administration was also beset by a series of public health challenges, including a bird flu outbreak from 1997 to 2002 and the 2003 outbreak of Sars, also known as Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome.

But Tung's biggest political challenge took place in July 2003 during his second term, when half a million Hongkongers took to the streets to protest against a proposed national security law they feared would threaten their civic rights.

His administration abandoned the proposed legislation following the massive outcry, which also contributed to Tung stepping down in March 2005.

At the time his declining health was cited as a reason - but some said he was pressured by Beijing to step down.

Beijing ultimately imposed a national security law on Hong Kong in 2020, which authorities have argued is necessary to maintain stability. Critics however have called it "the end of Hong Kong" and say it has created a climate of fear in the city.

Tung's last public outing was in July 2021, at an event marking the 100th anniversary of the founding of the Chinese Communist Party. He...
body.zh: 香港回归中国后的首任领导人董建华去世，享年89岁。 1997 年 7 月，英国将香港交还给中国，结束了英国 150 多年的控制，这位前航运业子弟从最后一任英国总督彭定康 (Chris Patten) 手中接过了权力。 亚洲金融危机、两次重大流行病以及引发对其政府批评的历史性抗议活动，标志着董建华的任期充满坎坷。他最终于2005年辞职。 据当地媒体报道，董于周二晚上在亲人的陪伴下去世。他的办公室形容他是一个“献身于他的国家和人民”的人。 董先生 1937 年出生于上海，毕业于英国利物浦大学，获得机械工程学位，随后移居美国，在通用电气工作了近十年。 1969年，他移居香港，在其父亲的航运集团东方海外工作，最终于1979年接手大权。 他的政治生涯始于1992年，当时他被任命为彭定康行政委员会成员。 尽管董建华缺乏政治经验，但据信是北京精心挑选的，在香港回归后领导香港。他被视为忠诚者，特别是在 20 世纪 80 年代中期全球经济衰退期间，中国国有银行帮助拯救了他的家族企业之后。 1996 年 1 月，在人民大会堂举行的招待会上，时任中国国家主席江泽民走过挤满人的房间，与董建华握手，这一举动被广泛拍照，在当时标志着北京支持董建华担任国家主席。 董建华上任后不久，亚洲金融危机袭来，房价暴跌。他的政府还受到一系列公共卫生挑战的困扰，包括1997年至2002年爆发的禽流感和2003年爆发的非典（又称严重急性呼吸系统综合症）。 但董建华最大的政治挑战发生在他的第二个任期内的 2003 年 7 月，当时 50 万香港人走上街头抗议一项拟议的国家安全法，他们担心这会威胁到他们的公民权利。 在遭到强烈抗议后，他的政府放弃了拟议的立法，这也导致董建华于 2005 年 3 月下台。 当时他的健康状况恶化被认为是一个原因，但也有人说他是受到北京方面的压力才下台的。 北京最终于 2020 年对香港实施了国家安全法，当局认为这是维持稳定所必需的。然而，批评者称其为“香港的终结”，并称这在这座城市造成了恐惧气氛。 董建华最后一次公开露面是在 2021 年 7 月的中国共产党成立 100 周年纪念活动上。他...

reflection.en: The passing of Tung Chee-hwa, Hong Kong's first post-handover leader, brings to mind the immense pressures and crises that marked his tenure. Leaders are entrusted with the well-being of their people, and the biblical call is to "execute justice and righteousness, and deliver from the hand of the oppressor him who suffers violence." The challenges faced...
reflection.zh: 香港首位回归后领导人董建华的逝世，令人回想起他任内所经历的巨大压力和危机。领导人被托付管理人民的福祉，圣经呼吁要“施行公平和公义，拯救被欺压的脱离欺压者的手”。他任职期间所面临的挑战，提醒我们领导者在治理与民众需求之间必须寻求的艰难平衡。

verse.textEn: Do what is just and right. Rescue from the hand of the oppressor the one who has been robbed.
verse.textZh: 你们要施行公平和公义，拯救被抢夺的脱离欺压人的手。

title.en: Fine art thieves nab two 'priceless' Renoir paintings from French museum
title.zh: 法国博物馆两幅“无价”雷诺阿画作被盗艺术品大盗落网

summary.en: Two thieves stole two Renoir paintings from a museum on the French Riviera on Tuesday. Local authorities described the robbery as a "wake-up call" regarding the protection of fine art.
summary.zh: 周二，两名窃贼在法国里维埃拉的一家博物馆盗走了两幅雷诺阿的画作。当地官员称此次盗窃是对艺术品展示和保护方式的一次“警钟”。

body.en:
Two thieves stole two Renoir paintings from a museum on the French Riviera on Tuesday.

Local authorities said the pair broke in shortly before 6 am (2 pm AEST) by cutting a hole in a garden fence and entering through a window.

The stolen paintings by Pierre-Auguste Renoir, whose most valuable works have fetched dozens of millions of dollars at auctions, were Madame Colonna Romano and Young Woman at the Well. Both belong to Paris' famous Orsay Museum and were on loan to the museum.

The thieves had taken two more paintings, Madame Pichon and Coco Reading, a portrayal of Claude, the young son of the famous Impressionist artist, but dropped them in the gardens as police, alerted by alarms, arrived and gave chase, local mayor Bryan Masson and the Marseille prosecutor's office said.

Masson said of the paintings, "They are priceless; you cannot sell them just like that."

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

The Marseille prosecutor added that an investigation had been opened into theft by an organised gang.

The museum, set up in 1960 in Renoir's mansion on a hill near Nice where he died in 1919, had 13 paintings by the master on display and some 40 sculptures, items of furniture and photographs.

Masson, a member of the far-right National Rally (RN) party, called for greater security for museums around France.

"This incident should serve as a wake-up call about the protection of our museums, which are now facing a new form of crime targeting works of art," he said.

The French government has come under pressure to tackle dramatic failures in the security of the country’s museums.

A French parliamentary report this summer said museums lacked resources and were ill-prepared to safeguard precious artworks and cultural artefacts.

A culture ministry survey in 2024 found that only one in four institutions had an emergency and risk-prevention plan, and nearly half lacked any video surveillance.

Art thieves in Europe are committing more violent robberies, and specialist gangs have been replaced by ad hoc opportunists recruited through social media, pan-European police body Europol said last month.

It cited a heist at the Louvre Museum in Paris in October last year as a prime example. Other French museums were also targeted in the past months.

"They are attacking all museums now, we must react," Luc, a neighbour of the Renoir museum, told BFM TV.

body.zh: 周二，两名小偷从法国里维埃拉的一家博物馆偷走了两幅雷诺阿的画作。 地方当局称，两人在早上 6 点（澳大利亚东部时间下午 2 点）前不久，在花园栅栏上挖了一个洞，然后从窗户进入。 皮埃尔·奥古斯特·雷诺阿最有价值的作品在拍卖会上以数千万美元成交，被盗的画作是《科隆纳·罗马诺夫人》和《井边的年轻女子》。这两件作品均属于巴黎著名的奥赛博物馆，并被该博物馆借出。 当地市长布莱恩·马森(Bryan Masson)和马赛检察官办公室表示，窃贼又拿走了两幅画作《皮尚夫人》(Madame Pichon)和《可可·雷丁》(Coco Reading)，画的是著名印象派艺术家的小儿子克洛德(Claude)，但当警察接到警报后赶到并追赶时，窃贼把它们扔到了花园里。当地市长布莱恩·马森(Bryan Masson)和马赛检察官办公室表示。 马森谈到这些画作时说：“它们是无价的；你不能就这样卖掉它们。” 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 马赛检察官补充说，已对一个有组织团伙的盗窃行为展开调查。 该博物馆建于 1960 年，位于雷诺阿位于尼斯附近一座小山上的宅邸，雷诺阿于 1919 年在尼斯去世，馆内展出了这位大师的 13 幅画作以及约 40 件雕塑、家具和照片。 马森是极右翼国家集会党 (RN) 的成员，他呼吁加强法国各地博物馆的安全。 他说：“这一事件应该为我们的博物馆的保护敲响警钟，我们的博物馆现在面临着一种针对艺术品的新形式的犯罪​​。” 法国政府面临着解决该国博物馆安全方面严重失误的压力。 今年夏天的一份法国议会报告称，博物馆缺乏资源，而且在保护珍贵艺术品和文化文物方面准备不足。 文化部2024年的一项调查发现，只有四分之一的机构制定了应急和风险防范计划，近一半的机构没有视频监控。 泛欧警察机构欧洲刑警组织上个月表示，欧洲的艺术品窃贼正在实施更加暴力的抢劫，专业团伙已被通过社交媒体招募的临时机会主义者所取代。 它以去年十月巴黎卢浮宫博物馆发生的抢劫案为例。过去几个月，其他法国博物馆也成为攻击目标。 雷诺阿博物馆的邻居吕克告诉 BFM 电视台：“他们现在正在袭击所有博物馆，我们必须做出反应。” 如需了解 SBS 新闻的最新动态，请下载我们的应用程序并订阅我们的时事通讯。

reflection.en: The audacious theft of two Renoir masterpieces, valued in the millions, speaks to the human heart's susceptibility to coveting what is not theirs. The pursuit of such 'treasures' often leads down paths of deceit and illegality, ultimately bringing no lasting good, as the proverb warns that dishonest scales are an abomination to Yahweh.
reflection.zh: 盗窃两幅价值连城的雷诺阿杰作，揭示了人心对不属于自己的东西的贪婪。对这些“珍宝”的追求常常导致欺骗和非法行为，最终不会带来任何持久的好处，正如箴言所警示的，不公的秤是雅伟所憎恶的。

verse.textEn: Yahweh detests dishonest scales, but accurate weights find favor with him.
verse.textZh: 诡诈的天平为雅伟所憎恶；公平的法码为他所喜悦。

title.en: Meta continues to run ads promoting child sexual abuse material in India - report
title.zh: Meta 报告继续在印度推广儿童性虐待材料

summary.en: A report by the Tech Transparency Project found that Meta ran hundreds of paid advertisements featuring AI-generated child sexual abuse imagery on Facebook and Instagram over the past 10 months, with a significant number appearing in India, despite a government order to remove such content.
summary.zh: 根据华盛顿特区的 Tech Transparency Project（TTP）的报告，Meta 在过去 10 个月内，在 Facebook 和 Instagram 上投放了数百个包含人工智能生成的儿童性虐待图像的付费广告，其中相当一部分出现在印度。尽管印度政府已下令删除此类内容，但该问题依然存在。

body.en:
Meta ran hundreds of paid ads with artificial intelligence-generated child sexual abuse imagery, including several in India, over the past 10 months, a new report by US-based campaigners has found.

The report comes two months after the Indian government ordered Meta to remove all ads and content promoting child sexual abuse material (CSAM) on Instagram. This was in the aftermath of a BBC Eye investigation which found that Instagram was running paid adverts promoting CSAM in India.

Washington-based Tech Transparency Project (TTP) , external says it found 332 adverts with CSAM that ran on Facebook and Instagram, the majority of them (274) in August this year.

When the BBC wrote to Meta about these findings, they said in a statement, "We don't tolerate nudify apps or any kind of child exploitation, whether real or AI-generated. These criminals constantly shift tactics to evade detection, which is why we keep strengthening our detection and enforcement."

The TTP report, published on Tuesday, says that it identified several photos of real children, including a member of a European royal family, that were used in the ads and then manipulated using AI. It says more than a dozen ads appeared on Meta platforms even after TTP made the company aware of its findings.

About a quarter (84) of the ads ran in India and 78 of these were published after the Indian government's order on removing CSAM and its meeting with senior Meta officials.

After the BBC investigation, several Indian agencies including the National Commission for Protection of Child Rights and the National Human Rights Commission have said they are examining the matter.

The distribution of CSAM is a criminal offence in India, while Meta's policy states that ads must not contain content that sexually exploits or endangers children.

When the BBC contacted Meta about its investigation, it said that when it becomes aware of apparent child exploitation, it reports it to the US-based National Center for Missing and Exploited Children (NCMEC) in compliance with its legal obligations.

The NCMEC is the centralised global reporting system for the online sexual exploitation of children.

But Bhuwan Ribhu, the founder of Just Rights for Children, a network of more than 250 organisations working to prevent violence against children in India, says this is not enough.

Just Rights for Children has filed a petition in India's Supreme Court, citing the BBC's findings, and asked for directions to social media platforms for mandatory reporting and identification of those promoting child sexual abuse material

"Social media companies are clearly flouting Indian laws by not reporting child sexual abuse content to Indian law enforcement agencies as mandated by our child protection laws," said Ribhu.

body.zh: 美国活动人士的一份新报告发现，在过去 10 个月里，Meta 投放了数百个带有人工智能生成的儿童性虐待图像的付费广告，其中包括在印度的几个广告。 该报告发布两个月前，印度政府命令 Meta 删除 Instagram 上所有宣传儿童性虐待内容 (CSAM) 的广告和内容。这是在 BBC Eye 调查发现 Instagram 在印度投放推广 CSAM 的付费广告之后发生的。 总部位于华盛顿的技术透明度项目 (TTP) 外部表示，它发现 Facebook 和 Instagram 上投放了 332 个 CSAM 广告，其中大多数（274 个）是在今年 8 月发布的。 当 BBC 就这些发现写信给 Meta 时，他们在一份声明中表示，“我们不会容忍裸体应用程序或任何形式的儿童剥削，无论是真实的还是人工智能生成的。这些犯罪分子不断改变策略来逃避检测，这就是我们不断加强检测和执法的原因。” TTP 周二发布的报告称，它发现了广告中使用的几张真实儿童的照片，其中包括一名欧洲王室成员，然后使用人工智能进行了处理。据称，即使在 TTP 让公司了解其调查结果后，Meta 平台上仍出现了十多个广告。 大约四分之一 (84) 条广告在印度投放，其中 78 条是在印度政府下令删除 CSAM 并与 Meta 高级官员会面后发布的。 英国广播公司(BBC)调查后，包括国家保护儿童权利委员会和国家人权委员会在内的多个印度机构表示，他们正在调查此事。 在印度传播 CSAM 属于刑事犯罪，而 Meta 的政策规定，广告不得包含性剥削或危害儿童的内容。 当BBC就其调查联系Meta时，它表示，当发现明显的儿童剥削行为时，它会根据其法律义务向位于美国的国家失踪和受虐儿童中心（NCMEC）报告。 NCMEC 是针对儿童在线性剥削的集中式全球报告系统。 但“儿童正义权利”（Just Rights for Children）的创始人布万·里布（Bhuwan Ribhu）表示，这还不够。该组织由 250 多个致力于防止印度儿童遭受暴力的组织组成。 儿童正义组织已向印度最高法院提交请愿书，援引英国广播公司的调查结果，并要求社交媒体平台强制报告和识别那些宣扬儿童性虐待内容的人 里布说：“社交媒体公司没有按照儿童保护法的规定向印度执法机构报告儿童性虐待内容，这显然是对印度法律的蔑视。” TTP，一个...

reflection.en: It is deeply disturbing that paid advertisements promoting child sexual abuse material continue to appear on Meta's platforms, especially in India. This highlights a profound failure to protect the most vulnerable. We must advocate for those who cannot speak for themselves, ensuring their safety and dignity are paramount.
reflection.zh: 令人深感不安的是，推广儿童性虐待材料的付费广告仍在 Meta 的平台上出现，尤其是在印度。这凸显了在保护最弱势群体方面存在的严重失职。我们必须为那些无法为自己发声的人发声，确保他们的安全和尊严至关重要。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: Saudi oil sites hit as Houthi attacks intensify amid US-Iran fighting
title.zh: 沙特石油设施遭袭，胡塞武装袭击加剧，美伊冲突升级

summary.en: Yemen's Iranian-backed Houthi rebels attacked four cities in southern Saudi Arabia, injuring over 70 people and setting oil facilities ablaze. Simultaneously, explosions were reported at Iran's major oil hub and in the Gulf of Oman, suggesting a potential resumption of US strikes.
summary.zh: 也门受伊朗支持的胡塞武装周二袭击了沙特阿拉伯南部四个城市，造成70多人受伤，并点燃了石油设施。与此同时，据伊朗媒体报道，伊朗主要石油枢纽哈尔格岛以及阿曼湾的杰斯克港也发生爆炸，表明美国可能在美国与伊朗的冲突暂停两天后恢复了打击行动。

body.en:
Yemen's Iran-backed Houthi rebels attacked four cities in southern Saudi Arabia, a US ally, on Tuesday, injuring more than 70 people and setting oil facilities ablaze in what appeared to be a significant escalation of the six-month-old conflict in the Middle East.

At the same time, explosions were reported on Kharg Island, Iran's major oil hub, and in the Gulf of Oman port of Jask, according to Iranian media, suggesting that US strikes against Iran may have resumed following a two-day pause.

Iranian news agency Tasnim reported that a US missile hit an Iranian tanker approximately 6 kilometres from Kharg Island. The vessel’s crew was reportedly being evacuated, although no casualties were reported, citing local sources.

The Pentagon did not immediately comment on the reports. However, a Fox News reporter, citing unidentified senior US officials, said the strikes were carried out by the US military.

In Saudi Arabia, the Houthis, who control most of Yemen's populated areas including the capital, said they had launched a broad operation deep into Saudi territory.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

They used drones and missiles to strike a Saudi airbase in the southern city of Khamis Mushait as well as Saudi state oil company assets in the cities of Abha, Najran and Jazan.

NASA satellite images showed a thick cloud of black smoke over the Jazan refinery and a column of white smoke rising from an oil distribution centre in Abha.

Saudi authorities described blazes at the sites and said women and children were among the 73 people hurt.

The reports of such large numbers of wounded suggested the attacks were among the biggest carried out against Saudi Arabia since the US and Israel launched their war against Iran in February.

No confirmed images from the ground of the attacked Saudi cities were available, and witnesses could not be reached in a country where media is tightly controlled.

After a month of calm in August, fighting in the Gulf has resumed, with Iran and the US exchanging fire, sending global oil prices back towards the US$100 ($138.5) a barrel level passed at the war's peak.

Prices for benchmark Brent crude and US West Texas Intermediate rose and were on track for their highest closes since 23 July.

Houthi attacks on southwestern Saudi Arabia have the potential to worsen the war's global economic impact by disrupting Middle East energy supplies beyond the blockaded Strait of Hormuz.

Saudi Arabia has led an Arab coalition battling against the Houthis in Yemen for more than a decade. That war had calmed in recent years, but a ceasefire there has broken down, with the Houthis threatening shipping at the mouth of the Red Sea.

title.en: 'Absolute nightmare': Mass flight cancellations in the UK prompt calls for dismissals
title.zh: “简直是噩梦”：英国大规模航班取消引发解雇呼声

summary.en: Nearly 1,100 flights to and from UK airports were cancelled overnight due to a 'system issue'.
summary.zh: 由于“系统问题”，英国机场往返的近1100个航班在夜间被取消。

body.en:
Consumer chaos has descended on the UK's busiest airports as an air traffic glitch causes major disruptions, prompting calls to fire the head of the air traffic control service.

Almost 1,100 flights to and from UK airports were cancelled Tuesday, due to what the country's air traffic control service called a technical issue, in this latest error.

A total of 1,055 flights to and from British airports had been axed by 8pm (5am AEST) according to the aircraft tracking website FlightRadar24.

"Recovery from today's system issue has taken longer than we had hoped," Britain's air traffic control service, known as NATS, said on social media.

"Our system issue is now resolved, we are operating normally and working as hard as possible to clear the backlog of flights," it noted, adding "this is hugely frustrating and apologise unreservedly".

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Tuesday's issues follow a technical glitch in July last year that saw scores of flights to and from the UK cancelled and which prompted anger from airline chiefs.

Britain saw its worst air systems failure in years in 2023, with more than 700,000 passengers affected after hundreds of flights were delayed or cancelled.

Heathrow Airport, Britain's largest and busiest airport, in west London, confirmed it was among those affected on Tuesday, along with Gatwick to the south of the UK capital.

"It's just an absolute nightmare down there," healthcare worker Josie Donoghue said of Gatwick after leaving the airport, having had to disembark her flight to Ireland after three hours stuck on the runway.

"Getting through that airport was like trying to get out of Alcatraz," she told Britain's domestic Press Association news agency.

Liverpool, Birmingham and Edinburgh airports were also affected, while Dublin Airport in Ireland said it had cancelled dozens of flights.

British Airways said it had to cancel or divert more than 100 flights, affecting tens of thousands of its customers.

Irish no-frills carrier Ryanair said more than 65,000 passengers had been disrupted and it had cancelled more than 50 flights.

Arsenal, due to play Napoli in the Champions League on Wednesday in the southern Italian city, were forced to cancel a press conference ahead of the match after the team's flight was delayed.

UK transport secretary Heidi Alexander said on X she was "seeking assurances that lessons will be learned and systems that support aviation are up to the job".

But Ryanair COO Neal McMahon repeated his calls for NATS chief executive Martin Rolfe to be fired, accusing him of having again "failed UK travellers".

"Enough is enough, it's time for the UK government to intervene ... and put somebody in...
body.zh: 由于空中交通故障造成重大干扰，英国最繁忙的机场出现了消费者混乱，促使人们呼吁解雇空中交通管制服务负责人。 周二，近 1,100 架往返英国机场的航班被取消，原因是该国空中交通管制部门在最新的错误中称其为技术问题。 根据飞机跟踪网站 FlightRadar24 的数据，截至晚上 8 点（澳大利亚东部标准时间上午 5 点），共有 1,055 架往返英国机场的航班被取消。 英国空中交通管制服务机构 NATS 在社交媒体上表示：“从今天的系统问题中恢复所需的时间比我们预期的要长。” 声明指出：“我们的系统问题现已解决，我们正在正常运营，并正在尽最大努力清理积压的航班。”并补充道，“这令人非常沮丧，我们深表歉意”。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 周二的问题是在去年 7 月的一次技术故障之后发生的，该故障导致大量往返英国的航班被取消，并引发了航空公司负责人的愤怒。 2023 年，英国遭遇了多年来最严重的航空系统故障，数百个航班延误或取消，超过 70 万名乘客受到影响。 位于伦敦西部的英国最大、最繁忙的机场希思罗机场周二证实，该机场以及英国首都南部的盖特威克机场均受到影响。 “那里绝对是一场噩梦，”医护人员乔西·多诺霍(Josie Donoghue)离开机场后谈到盖特威克机场时说，她在跑道上滞留三个小时后不得不下机前往爱尔兰。 “通过那个机场就像试图逃离恶魔岛一样，”她告诉英国国内新闻协会通讯社。 利物浦、伯明翰和爱丁堡机场也受到影响，爱尔兰都柏林机场表示已取消了数十个航班。 英国航空公司表示，不得不取消或改道 100 多个航班，影响了数万名乘客。 爱尔兰廉价航空公司瑞安航空 (Ryanair) 表示，超过 65,000 名乘客受到影响，并取消了 50 多个航班。 阿森纳定于周三在意大利南部城市对阵那不勒斯的欧冠比赛中，由于球队的航班延误，他们被迫取消了赛前的新闻发布会。 英国交通大臣海蒂·亚历山大 (Heidi Alexander) 于 X 日表示，她“正在寻求保证，确保汲取教训，支持航空的系统能够胜任这项工作”。 但瑞安航空首席运营官尼尔·麦克马洪 (Neal McMahon) 再次呼吁解雇 NATS 首席执行官马丁·罗尔夫 (Martin Rolfe)，指责他再次“让英国旅客失望”。 “够了，英国政府是时候进行干预了……并安排某人……

reflection.en: When complex systems fail, as seen with the UK's air traffic control glitch cancelling over 1,000 flights, it raises questions about leadership and foresight. Proverbs 11:14 reminds us that 'where there is no guidance, a people falls, but in an abundance of counselors there is safety.' This suggests that robust systems and wise counsel are vital to prevent...
reflection.zh: 当像英国空中交通管制故障导致一千多个航班取消这样复杂的系统出现故障时，就会引发对领导力和远见的质疑。《箴言》11:14提醒我们：“在愚昧人那里，智慧是无影无踪；在愚昧人的口中，智慧是无影无踪。”这句话暗示，健全的系统和明智的咨询对于防止大范围的混乱和确保公众安全至关重要。

verse.textEn: For lack of guidance a nation falls, but victory is won through many advisers.
verse.textZh: 无智谋，民就败落；谋士多，人便安居。

title.en: German economy frets about Saxony-Anhalt election results
title.zh: 德国经济因萨克森-安哈尔特州选举结果而担忧

summary.en: The AfD won the election in the eastern German state of Saxony-Anhalt by a wide margin. While politicians and analysts debate the reasons for the far-right party's popularity, economists are sounding the alarm about the potential implications of this significant political shift.
summary.zh: 在德国东部萨克森-安哈尔特州的选举中，德国选择党（AfD）以较大优势获胜。尽管政治家和分析人士仍在辩论该极右翼政党受欢迎的原因，但经济学家们已对这一重大政治转变的潜在影响敲响了警钟。

body.en:
The AfD won the election in the eastern German state by a wide margin. While politicians and election analysts are still debating the reasons for the far-right party's popularity, economists are sounding the alarm.

The results came in as predicted: The AfD, which is considered far-right extremist in parts, won the election in Saxony-Anhalt and could now put forward the state’s minister-president and take over the  state government . 

What hardly anyone expected, however, was this: The governing CDU is now barely half as strong as it was, while the other parties have been left far behind. Calling it a landslide victory for the AfD is no exaggeration. And many commentators go so far as to call it a turning point in Germany’s postwar history.

"A state government led by the AfD would certainly be seen by many as a turning point and would further fuel the debate over how best to deal with the party," Commerzbank economist Ralph Solveen told Reuters.

At the same time, he advises waiting to see what happens, saying that things are rarely as bad as they seem.

"Many of these decisions are unlikely to affect the economy until the medium to long term," he said. "Decisions on most taxes, the structure of the labor market and social security systems are made at the federal level. That is why the AfD, in many of its pledges, only promises to advocate for something in the Bundesrat, which is unlikely to succeed given the foreseeable isolation of an AfD-led government."

Many business community concerns had already been raised before the election. It also became clear that there are differing views within the AfD, which could lead to unpredictable policies.

For example, DW reported two months ago that Hannes Loth, a member of the AfD and the mayor in Raguhn-Jessnitz, Saxony-Anhalt, sought to have six new wind turbines installed. This pledge puts him at odds with the official stance of his own party.

Whether this is a sign of internal party pluralism or simply local political pragmatism will become clear during the coming legislative term, especially if the AfD ends up in the state government. It is not, however, serving to reassure business leaders.

One issue the AfD campaigned on was a promise to limit the number of foreigners. But will the party actually be able to implement its goal? On this point, Michael Berlemann, director of the Hamburg Institute of International Economics (HWWI), remains skeptical.

"A large part of the measures it has promised cannot be implemented at the state level because the federal government is responsible for them," he said. "Another part would be illegal and would be overturned by the courts after some delay: The AfD cannot...
body.zh: 德国选择党以大幅优势赢得了德国东部各州的选举。尽管政治家和选举分析人士仍在争论极右翼政党受欢迎的原因，但经济学家已经敲响了警钟。 结果正如预期的那样：被部分视为极右极端主义的德国选择党赢得了萨克森-安哈特州的选举，现在可以推举该州部长兼总统并接管州政府。 然而，几乎没有人预料到的是：执政的基民盟现在的实力只有原来的一半，而其他政党则被远远抛在了后面。称其为德国选择党的压倒性胜利并不夸张。许多评论家甚至称其为德国战后历史的转折点。 德国商业银行经济学家拉尔夫·索尔文对路透社表示：“由德国选择党领导的州政府肯定会被许多人视为一个转折点，并将进一步加剧有关如何最好地与该党打交道的争论。” 与此同时，他建议静观其变，并表示事情很少像看上去那么糟糕。 “其中许多决定在中长期之前不太可能影响经济，”他说。 “大多数税收、劳动力市场结构和社会保障体系的决定都是在联邦层面做出的。这就是为什么选择党在其许多承诺中只承诺在联邦参议院倡导某些东西，鉴于选择党领导的政府可预见的孤立，这一点不太可能成功。” 许多商界的担忧在选举前就已经提出。很明显，德国选择党内部存在不同观点，这可能导致政策不可预测。 例如，德国之声两个月前报道称，德国选择党成员兼萨克森-安哈尔特州拉古恩-杰斯尼茨市市长汉内斯·洛斯(Hannes Loth)寻求安装六台新风力涡轮机。这一承诺使他与本党的官方立场不一致。 这究竟是党内多元化的标志，还是仅仅是地方政治实用主义的标志，将在即将到来的立法任期内变得清晰，特别是如果选择党最终入主州政府的话。然而，这并不能让企业领导人放心。 德国选择党竞选的议题之一是承诺限制外国人数量。但该党真的能够实现其目标吗？对于这一点，汉堡国际经济研究所 (HWWI) 所长迈克尔·伯勒曼 (Michael Berlemann) 仍持怀疑态度。 他说：“它所承诺的大部分措施无法在州一级实施，因为联邦政府要对它们负责。” “另一部分将是非法的，并会在拖延一段时间后被法院推翻：选择党不能……

reflection.en: The election results in Saxony-Anhalt represent a seismic shift in German politics, with the AfD achieving a landslide victory. Such dramatic political upheavals can create uncertainty and anxiety, particularly for economic stability. The ancient words remind us that ultimate authority rests with the Divine, who can bring about unexpected changes in...
reflection.zh: 萨克森-安哈尔特州的选举结果标志着德国政治的巨大转变，德国选择党取得了压倒性胜利。这种剧烈的政治动荡可能带来不确定性和焦虑，尤其对经济稳定而言。古老的经文提醒我们，最终的权柄在于雅伟，祂能带来领导和治理的意外变革。

verse.textEn: It is God who judges: He brings one down, he exalts another.
verse.textZh: 惟有神断定；他使这人降卑，使那人升高。

title.en: Fifty years after Mao’s death, China has transformed. DW looks at why his political legacy still matters.
title.zh: 毛泽东去世五十周年，中国已发生巨变。德国之声探讨其政治遗产为何仍具影响力。

summary.en: Mao Zedong was perhaps the most influential, and certainly one of the most controversial, figures in 20th-century China. Even five decades after his death, the legacy of his era continues to influence China today.
summary.zh: 毛泽东或许是20世纪中国最具影响力，也无疑是最具争议的人物之一。他去世五十载后，其时代的遗产至今仍在影响着中国。

body.en:
Mao Zedong was perhaps the most influential, and certainly one of the most controversial, figures in 20th-century China. Even five decades after his death, the legacy of his era continues to influence China today.

On September 9, 1976, Mao Zedong died. The revolutionary leader who led the Chinese Communist Party (CCP) to power and founded the People's Republic of China left behind a profoundly contradictory historical legacy.

He shaped the narratives of revolution, nation-building and national independence, but also left behind immense social trauma as a result of successive political campaigns and persecutions.

When Mao died, China was still a poor and relatively isolated communist state. Today, it is the world's second-largest economy, deeply embedded in the supply and value chains of global capitalism, with a vast private sector, a large urban middle class and a highly digitalized society. 

Zhang Lun, a professor at Cergy-Paris University, said Mao left behind four major political legacies: the authoritarian and highly centralized political system; a model of governance that relies on revolution and political campaigns to solve social problems; populist tendencies marked by anti-elitism and anti-rationalism; and utopian visions of egalitarianism and moralism.

From the perspective of political legacies, Zhang told DW, the most fundamental change in China over the past five decades has been "de-Maoization" — while its greatest challenge has been that this process was never fully completed.

Mao's name remains written into the CCP's constitution, while his thought remains part of China's official ideology and his portrait still hangs in Beijing's Tiananmen Square.

Mao helped forge the Chinese Communist Party, and his insistence on the party's supremacy over the state and society has remained a fundamental principle throughout the decades, said Jean Christopher Mittelstaedt, professor at the University of Zurich.

Veteran journalist and political commentator Chang Ping agrees, adding that what has truly endured is the institutional core of the principle that "the party leads everything," serving a state vision of being able to "concentrate resources to accomplish major tasks." 

The CCP, he said, can pursue such objectives "at all costs" — meaning the interests of ordinary people can be sacrificed to the maximum extent necessary to preserve the regime. 

Under current leader Xi Jinping , a number of political concepts and methods of governance associated with the Mao era — such as ideological unity and the spirit of "struggle" — have again attracted attention.

Xi's actions such as abolishing the presidential term limits, strengthening his...
body.zh: 毛泽东也许是 20 世纪中国最有影响力、当然也是最具争议性的人物之一。即使在他去世五年后，他那个时代的遗产仍然影响着今天的中国。 1976年9月9日，毛泽东逝世。 这位领导中国共产党夺取政权、建立中华人民共和国的革命领袖，留下了极其矛盾的历史遗产。 他塑造了革命、国家建设和民族独立的叙事，但也因连续的政治运动和迫害而留下了巨大的社会创伤。 毛泽东去世时，中国仍然是一个贫穷且相对孤立的共产主义国家。如今，它是世界第二大经济体，深深嵌入全球资本主义的供应链和价值链，拥有庞大的私营部门、庞大的城市中产阶级和高度数字化的社会。 巴黎塞尔吉大学教授张伦表示，毛泽东留下了四大政治遗产：专制和高度集权的政治制度；依靠革命和政治运动来解决社会问题的治理模式；以反精英主义和反理性主义为标志的民粹主义倾向；以及平等主义和道德主义的乌托邦愿景。 张向德国之声表示，从政治遗产的角度来看，中国过去50年最根本的变化是“去毛化”，而最大的挑战是这一过程从未完全完成。 毛泽东的名字仍然写进了中国共产党的党章，他的思想仍然是中国官方意识形态的一部分，他的肖像仍然悬挂在北京天安门广场上。 苏黎世大学教授吉恩·克里斯托弗·米特尔施塔特 (Jean Christopher Mittelstaedt) 表示，毛泽东帮助建立了中国共产党，几十年来，他坚持党对国家和社会的至高无上一直是一项基本原则。 资深记者、时事评论员常平对此表示赞同，并补充道，真正经久不衰的是“党领导一切”的制度核心，服务于“集中资源办好大事”的国家愿景。 他说，中共可以“不惜一切代价”追求这些目标——这意味着为了维护政权，可以最大限度地牺牲普通民众的利益。 在现任领导人习近平的领导下，一些与毛泽东时代相关的政治理念和执政方式——例如思想统一和“斗争”精神——再次引起人们的关注。 习近平的行动包括取消国家主席任期限制、加强...

reflection.en: Mao Zedong's death fifty years ago marked a turning point, yet his legacy continues to shape China's path. Proverbs 14:34 reminds us that national character and direction are deeply tied to righteousness. As nations navigate complex histories and evolving identities, the pursuit of justice and moral integrity remains a vital, enduring principle.
reflection.zh: 毛泽东去世五十周年标志着一个转折点，但他的遗产至今仍在塑造着中国的道路。箴言14:34提醒我们，国家的品格和方向与公义息息相关。当国家在复杂的历史和不断变化的身份中前行时，对公义和道德诚信的追求仍然是至关重要且持久的原则。

verse.textEn: Righteousness exalts a nation, but sin condemns any people.
verse.textZh: 公义使邦国高举；罪恶是人民的羞辱。
