title.en: ‘Long live Chairman Mao’: Supporters pay respects to founder of Communist China
title.zh: “毛主席万岁”：中国共产党创始人逝世五十周年之际，支持者表达敬意

summary.en: Fifty years after his death, devoted followers of Chinese Communist leader Mao Zedong gathered in his hometown to pay tribute. They held portraits, flags, and large floral arrangements, commemorating the founder of the People's Republic who died on September 9, 1976. This fervent commemoration occurs as China faces...
summary.zh: 毛泽东逝世五十周年之际，中国共产党领导人毛泽东的忠实追随者在他的家乡聚集致敬。他们手持肖像、旗帜和巨大的花束，纪念这位1976年9月9日去世的中华人民共和国创始人。在中国面临经济挑战之际，对毛泽东时代的怀旧情绪日益增长，本周他受到了热烈纪念。

body.en: Fifty years after his death, diehard fans of the Chinese Communist leader Mao Zedong lined up Wednesday in his hometown to pay homage, holding portraits, flags and huge floral tributes. People gather to pay tribute to late Communist leader Mao Zedong at the Bronze Statue Square in Shaoshan, China’s central Hunan province on September 8, 2026, a day before the 50th anniversary of his death. Photo: Hector Retamal/AFP. Chairman Mao, the founder of the People’s Republic, died on September 9, 1976, and his life and legacy was being commemorated fervently this week by those who still revere him as a visionary leader. As China grapples with a slowing economy, nostalgia is growing for Mao’s egalitarian ideals , but his drastic policies are also blamed by historians for mass starvation and millions of deaths. Tourists — many of them university students — laid chrysanthemum wreaths, bottles of Chinese alcohol, and cigarettes at the foot of a 10-metre-tall bronze statue of Mao in the main square in Shaoshan, in central Hunan province. Hundreds of visitors lined up in carefully organised queues to bow solemnly and observe a few seconds of silence, while others posed for photos in front of the statue. Watchful police stopped people from lingering too long. People pay tribute to late Communist leader Mao Zedong at the Mao Zedong Bronze Statue Square in Shaoshan, China’s central Hunan province on September 9, 2026, during the 50th anniversary of his death. Photo: by Hector Retamal/AFP. Deng, a 28-year-old tourist, told AFP that he had “been influenced” by Mao’s spirit and had great respect for him. “I suddenly felt like coming here today to commemorate him, because the 50th anniversary is something that only comes around once in a lifetime.” The night before, around 1,000 ardent admirers — some in the short, tunic-style suits famously worn by Mao — held an emotional ceremony at the statue. They brandished relics of a bygone era: old portraits of the leader and copies of the “Little Red Book”, a collection of his quotations that was once virtually ubiquitous in China. “Long live Chairman Mao!” the group roared repeatedly, some pumping their fists in the air and singing revolutionary songs. Reminders of Mao are peppered all around the otherwise nondescript village of Shaoshan, propelled to fame by the man who would become known as the “Great Helmsman”. ‘Never forget’ Busloads of visitors were arriving at Mao’s remote hometown, where he was born in December 1893. Shaoshan has been promoted by state media as a spot for “red tourism” — part of Beijing’s decades-long push to bring tourists enamoured by the...
body.zh: 中国共产党领导人毛泽东逝世五十周年后，周三，中国共产党领导人毛泽东的铁杆粉丝在他的家乡排队悼念，他们举着肖像、旗帜和巨大的鲜花。 2026 年 9 月 8 日，即毛泽东逝世 50 周年纪念日的前一天，人们聚集在中国中部湖南省韶山市铜像广场，悼念已故共产党领导人毛泽东。照片：赫克托·雷塔马尔/法新社。中华人民共和国创始人毛主席于 1976 年 9 月 9 日逝世，本周，那些仍然尊崇他为富有远见的领导人的人们热烈纪念他的一生和遗产。随着中国努力应对经济放缓的问题，人们对毛泽东的平等主义理想的怀念与日俱增，但历史学家也指责他的严厉政策导致了大规模饥饿和数百万人死亡。游客——其中许多是大学生——在湖南省中部韶山市主广场上一尊 10 米高的毛泽东铜像脚下敬献了菊花圈、几瓶中国酒和香烟。数百名游客精心组织起来，庄严地鞠躬并默哀几秒钟，其他人则在雕像前摆好姿势拍照。警惕的警察阻止人们逗留太久。 2026年9月9日，在已故共产党领导人毛泽东逝世50周年之际，人们在中国中部湖南省韶山市的毛泽东铜像广场悼念他。照片：赫克托·雷塔马尔/法新社拍摄。 28岁的游客邓告诉法新社，他“受到毛泽东精神的影响”，对他非常尊敬。 “我今天突然很想来这里纪念他，因为五十周年纪念是一生只有一次的事情。”前一天晚上，大约 1000 名狂热的崇拜者——其中一些人穿着毛泽东著名的中山装短裙——在雕像前举行了一场激动人心的仪式。他们挥舞着过去时代的遗物：领导人的旧肖像和“红宝书”的副本，这是他的语录集，曾经在中国几乎无处不在。 “毛主席万岁！”这群人不断地咆哮，一些人举起拳头，唱着革命歌曲。韶山这个原本不起眼的村庄随处可见毛泽东的痕迹，这座村庄因这位后来被称为“伟大舵手”的人而声名鹊起。 “永远不会忘记” 满载游客的巴士正抵达毛泽东 1893 年 12 月出生的偏远家乡。韶山被官方媒体宣传为“红色旅游”胜地——这是北京数十年来推动吸引游客的一部分。

reflection.en: In Shaoshan, Hunan province, crowds gathered to honor Mao Zedong, the founder of Communist China, fifty years after his passing. The fervent displays of portraits and floral tributes reveal a deep reverence for a political figure. This devotion raises questions about where ultimate loyalty and worship are directed, reminding us of the biblical call to place...
reflection.zh: 在中国湖南省韶山，人群聚集纪念中国共产党创始人毛泽东，在他逝世五十周年之际。展示的肖像和花束显示出对一位政治人物的深切崇敬。这种奉献引发了关于最终忠诚和敬拜指向何处的问题，提醒我们圣经呼召雅伟独自成为我们效忠的中心。

verse.textEn: You shall have no other gods before me.
verse.textZh: 除了我以外，你不可有别的神。

title.en: Political groups vow to uphold Tung's vision
title.zh: 政党誓言继承董建华遗志

summary.en: Political parties and institutions on Wednesday pledged to carry on Tung Chee-hwa's legacy, upholding his spirit of service and dedication to Hong Kong and the nation. Tung died on Tuesday at the age of 89.
summary.zh: 周三，政党和机构承诺继承董建华的遗志，发扬他为香港和国家服务的精神和奉献精神。董建华于周二去世，享年89岁。

body.en: Political parties and institutions on Wednesday pledged to carry on Tung Chee‑hwa's legacy, upholding his spirit of service and dedication to Hong Kong and the nation. Tung died on Tuesday at the age of 89. In a statement, the DAB said Tung was a lifelong patriot who loved Hong Kong. The party pledged to carry on his spirit and continue working hard for the good of both the nation and the SAR. "He firmly believed that Hong Kong could participate widely in the nation's reform and opening‑up and make contributions, and that the country's development and strength would bring new opportunities for Hong Kong to become even more prosperous," it said. The Liberal Party, for its part, said Tung had a deep love for his country and that his spirit continued to inspire them to actively participate in the SAR's development and integrate into the nation's progress. "The Liberal Party will follow Mr Tung's example of patriotism and dedication, firmly safeguard 'One Country, Two Systems,' and devote ourselves fully to the prosperity of the nation and Hong Kong," it said. President of Hong Kong University of Science and Technology Nancy Ip said Tung consistently placed great importance on higher education. She said he had strongly advocated strengthening Hong Kong through education, technology and talent development. "His unwavering support for young people in pursuing scientific advancement and serving society and the nation left a lasting impact on Hong Kong's education and innovation landscape," she said. Lawmaker Simon Lee, who had worked at the think tank Our Hong Kong Foundation founded by Tung, said his contributions were not just to Hong Kong, but to the nation and to the complex China-US relationship. "I think the greatest way we can repay him is to stay committed to serving the public good, contribute more to the nation and Hong Kong, and carry forward his vision and dedication," he said. Edited by Tony Sabine
body.zh: 周三，各政党和机构承诺继承董建华的遗产，秉承他为香港和国家服务和奉献的精神。董建华周二去世，享年89岁。民建联在一份声明中表示，董建华是一位热爱香港的终生爱国者。党承诺继承他的精神，继续为国家和特区的利益而努力奋斗。他坚信，香港能够广泛参与国家改革开放并作出贡献，国家的发展和强大将为香港带来更加繁荣的新机遇。自由党则表示，董建华对国家有着深厚的热爱，他的精神继续激励着他们积极参与特区的发展，融入国家的进步。自由党将效仿董先生的爱国奉献精神，坚定维护‘一国两制’，全力致力于国家和香港的繁荣昌盛。”香港科技大学校长叶玉如表示，董建华一贯高度重视高等教育。她说，他强烈主张通过教育、科技和人才发展来加强香港。她表示：“他坚定不移地支持年轻人追求科学进步、服务社会和国家，对香港的教育和创新格局产生了持久影响。”曾在董建华创立的智囊团团结香港基金会工作的立法会议员李少杰表示，他的贡献不仅是对香港，也是对国家和复杂的中美关系。他说：“我认为我们报答他最好的方式就是继续致力于服务公众利益，为国家和香港做出更多贡献，并将他的愿景和奉献精神发扬光大。”托尼·萨宾编辑

reflection.en: Following the passing of Tung Chee-hwa, political groups have vowed to continue his legacy of service and dedication. This commitment to working for the good of Hong Kong and the nation echoes the ancient call to act justly, love mercy, and walk humbly with God. May their efforts be guided by these enduring principles.
reflection.zh: 在董建华先生逝世后，政界团体誓言将继承他服务奉献的遗志。这种为香港和国家福祉而努力的承诺，呼应了古老的呼召：要秉公行义，喜爱怜悯，谦卑地与雅伟同行。愿他们的努力能以此不朽的原则为指引。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: Ex-Hong Kong lawmaker William Wong’s bail extended on 4 traffic offences
title.zh: 前香港立法会议员黄国桐的四项交通违规保释金获延期

summary.en: Former Hong Kong lawmaker William Wong Kam-fai, who resigned following an alleged drunk-driving incident, has been granted two months to consider his plea on four traffic offenses. Wong, 66, did not enter a plea during his initial court appearance at Sha Tin Court on Wednesday.
summary.zh: 前香港立法会议员黄国桐在涉嫌酒后驾驶事件后辞职，现获准两个月时间考虑对四项交通违规控罪的答辩。现年66岁的黄国桐周三在沙田法院首次出庭时，无需答辩。

body.en: Former Hong Kong lawmaker William Wong Kam-fai, who resigned after an alleged drink-driving incident, has been given two months to consider his plea on four traffic offences. Wong, 66, was not required to enter a plea during his first appearance at Sha Tin Court on Wednesday. Defence lawyer Paul Tse Wai-chun, also a former legislator, sought a nine-week adjournment to allow time for legal advice. Magistrate Raymond Wong Kwok-fai set the next hearing for November 11. A computer scientist by...
body.zh: 因涉嫌酒后驾驶事件而辞职的前香港议员黄锦辉有两个月的时间考虑他对四项交通违法行为的认罪。 66岁的黄周三首次在沙田法院出庭时无需提出抗辩。辩护律师、前立法会议员谢伟俊寻求休庭九周，以便有时间接受法律咨询。裁判官黄国辉将下一次听证会定于 11 月 11 日举行。一位计算机科学家...

reflection.en: Public figures, even those no longer in office, are held to a standard of integrity. The legal process for William Wong's traffic offenses serves as a reminder that accountability extends to all, regardless of past positions. Proverbs 16:12 reminds us that righteousness, a quality essential for good governance, is also foundational to personal conduct.
reflection.zh: 公众人物，即使已卸任，也应受到诚信标准的约束。黄国桐因交通违规而面临的法律程序，提醒我们问责制适用于所有人，无论其过往职位如何。《箴言》16章12节提醒我们，公义不仅是良好治理的基石，也是个人品格的基础。

verse.textEn: Kings detest wrongdoing, for a throne is established through righteousness.
verse.textZh: 作恶为王所憎恶，因国位是靠公义坚立。

title.en: Belt and Road members praise HK's strengths
title.zh: ‘一带一路’成员称赞香港的优势

summary.en: Participants in the Belt and Road initiative on Wednesday expressed confidence in Hong Kong’s strengths for driving cooperation. Speaking at the Belt and Road Summit in Wan Chai, Laos' Deputy Prime Minister Saleumxay Kommasith noted significant progress in areas like infrastructure, finance, digital innovation, and...
summary.zh: “一带一路”倡议的参与者周三对香港在推动合作方面的优势表示信心。在湾仔举行的“一带一路”高峰论坛上，老挝副总理Saleumxay Kommasith指出，在基础设施互联互通、金融融合、数字创新和可持续发展等关键领域取得了显著进展，并强调香港作为“超级联系人”和“超级增值者”，能够将对话转化为具体成果。

body.en: Belt and Road participants on Wednesday expressed confidence in Hong Kong’s advantages in driving cooperation under the initiative. Speaking at the Belt and Road Summit in Wan Chai, Deputy Prime Minister of Laos Saleumxay Kommasith said there had been significant progress in key areas, such as infrastructure connectivity, financial integration, digital innovation and sustainable development. “As a 'super connector' and 'super value-adder', Hong Kong drives multilateral cooperation, business matching and open trade, while providing the financial and professional expertise to turn dialogue into concrete achievement,” he said. He added his country recognised the importance of transitioning regional partnerships from traditional models towards green innovation and high-value economic growth. Vice President of Uruguay, Carolina Cosse, also said her country recognised Hong Kong’s advantages as an international financial, trade and shipping centre. She proposed the development of a hub-to-hub cooperative platform between Uruguay and Hong Kong under the Belt and Road Initiative. Edited by Tony Sabine
body.zh: 周三，“一带一路”参与者对香港在推动“一带一路”合作方面的优势充满信心。老挝副总理沙伦赛·贡马西在湾仔举行的“一带一路”高峰论坛上表示，基础设施互联互通、资金融通、数字创新、可持续发展等关键领域取得重大进展。他表示：“作为‘超级联系人’和‘超级增值者’，香港推动多边合作、商业配对和开放贸易，同时提供金融和专业知识，将对话转化为具体成果。”他补充说，他的国家认识到将区域伙伴关系从传统模式转向绿色创新和高价值经济增长的重要性。乌拉圭副总统卡罗琳娜·科斯亦表示，乌拉圭认同香港作为国际金融、贸易和航运中心的优势。她提出在“一带一路”倡议下发展乌拉圭与香港之间的枢纽合作平台。托尼·萨宾编辑

reflection.en: The Belt and Road Summit showcases a vision for global cooperation, with Hong Kong positioned as a key facilitator. This ambition to connect nations and foster development finds resonance in Proverbs 16:3, which encourages committing our plans and endeavors to Yahweh, trusting that He will establish them. May the efforts in Wan Chai be guided by wisdom and...
reflection.zh: “一带一路”高峰论坛展示了全球合作的愿景，香港被定位为关键的推动者。这种连接国家、促进发展的雄心与箴言16:3的教导不谋而合，该经文鼓励我们将计划和努力交托给雅伟，并信靠祂必成就。愿在湾仔所做的努力都能以智慧和正直为指引，不仅追求经济发展，也寻求人类共同的繁荣。

verse.textEn: Commit to Yahweh whatever you do, and he will establish your plans.
verse.textZh: 你所做的，要交托雅伟，你所谋的，就必成立。

title.en: SAR's first astronaut inspires students from space
title.zh: 香港首位航天员从太空启迪学子

summary.en: Hong Kong's first astronaut, Lai Ka-ying, delivered a live educational lecture from the Tiangong Space Station to students in Hong Kong and Macao. The event, part of the 'Tiangong Class' initiative, offered a rare look into life in orbit and featured interactive demonstrations by Lai and her crewmates.
summary.zh: 香港首位航天员李佳颖周三上午通过视频连线，从天宫空间站为香港和澳门的学生们带来了一场现场教育讲座。此次活动是“天宫课堂”港澳专场的一部分，在荃灣 public 何传耀纪念中学举行，让年轻观众得以一窥空间站内的生活。

body.en: The SAR's first astronaut, Lai Ka-ying, made a virtual return to her alma mater on Wednesday morning, beaming in from the Tiangong Space Station for a live educational lecture that captivated students across Hong Kong and Macao. The event, part of the "Tiangong Class" Hong Kong and Macao Designated Session, took place at Tsuen Wan Public Ho Chuen Yiu Memorial College and gave young viewers a rare glimpse into life aboard the space station. Alongside her Shenzhou-23 crewmates, Zhu Yangzhu and Zhang Zhiyuan, Lai led a 90-minute interactive tour, showcasing in-orbit demonstrations and offering an intimate look at their daily routines. As a payload specialist, Lai drew particular attention when she gave students a tour of her sleeping quarters and presented the surprisingly diverse menu available to the crew. "The science and technology teams on the ground have prepared a wide variety of nutritious and well-balanced recipes for us. There are staple foods like rice, noodles, and bread, as well as dozens of speciality dishes like braised pork, Buddha Jumps Over the Wall, Kung Pao Chicken, black pepper beef fillet, and many more," she said. "There are also various types of dehydrated vegetables; after adding water, they look like this... very healthy and delicious. We also make our own yoghurt here. The variety of food is truly diverse." During a lively question and answer session, one student asked what motivated her to apply for the national payload specialist programme. Lai admitted she hadn’t dreamt of becoming an astronaut as a child, but when she learned that mainland authorities were, for the first time, opening the selection process to candidates from Hong Kong and Macao, she knew she had to seize the chance. "Looking back now, my educational background, scientific research training, and work experience, have all been important factors that enabled me to seize this opportunity," she said. "So I hope that students will always prepare yourselves well in your daily lives. When an opportunity comes, be brave and actively go after it." Also present at the dialogue was Chief Executive John Lee, who noted that many students had written letters to Lai during her mission. Lai said that training and life in orbit can sometimes feel isolating and difficult, but she draws strength from the trust placed in her and is determined to complete her mission with full dedication. In his opening remarks, Lee praised Lai’s achievement as proof that Hongkongers can play a direct role in national space endeavours — and that the dream of space flight is within reach for those bold enough to pursue it. He also reaffirmed the government’s commitment to strengthening science education and outreach, urging broader community participation in the city’s growing aerospace...
body.zh: 周三上午，香港特区首位宇航员黎嘉英虚拟返回母校，从天宫空间站传来现场教育讲座，吸引了香港和澳门的学生。该活动是“天宫班”港澳专场的一部分，在荃湾公立何传耀纪念中学举行，让年轻观众难得一睹空间站生活。赖与她的神舟二十三号船员朱杨柱和张志远一起进行了90分钟的互动参观，展示了在轨演示并近距离观察了他们的日常生活。作为一名有效载荷专家，赖在带领学生参观她的卧室并向机组人员展示令人惊讶的多样化菜单时引起了特别关注。 “现场的科技团队为我们准备了种类丰富、营养均衡的菜谱，有米饭、面条、面包等主食，还有红烧肉、佛跳墙、宫保鸡丁、黑椒牛柳等几十种特色菜肴。”她说。 “还有各种脱水蔬菜，加水后是这样的……非常健康又美味。我们这里还自制酸奶，食物种类真是多种多样。”在热烈的问答环节中，一名学生询问是什么促使她申请国家有效载荷专家项目。黎智英承认，她小时候并没有梦想成为一名宇航员，但当她得知内地当局首次向香港和澳门的候选人开放选拔程序时，她知道自己必须抓住这个机会。 “现在回想起来，我的教育背景、科研训练、工作经历，都是让我抓住这个机会的重要因素。”她说。 “所以我希望同学们在日常生活中时刻做好准备，当机会来临时，要勇敢，积极去争取。”出席对话的还有行政长官李家超，他指出，在黎智英出访期间，有很多学生给她写信。赖表示，在轨训练和生活有时会感到孤独和困难，但她从人们的信任中汲取力量，决心全力以赴完成自己的使命。李在开场白中称赞黎智英的成就证明香港人可以在国家太空事业中发挥直接作用，而且对于那些有勇气追求太空飞行的人来说，太空飞行的梦想是可以实现的。他还重申了政府对加强科学教育和推广的承诺，敦促更广泛的社区参与该市不断发展的航空航天……

reflection.en: From the vastness of the Tiangong Space Station, astronaut Lai Ka-ying shared a glimpse of humanity's reach beyond Earth. It’s a profound reminder of our place in the universe, prompting wonder at what we can achieve and the scale of creation. "What is man that you are mindful of him?" the Psalmist asked. Seeing humanity venture into space, touching the...
reflection.zh: 从天宫空间站的浩瀚之中，航天员李佳颖分享了人类超越地球的探索一瞥。这深刻地提醒我们自己在宇宙中的位置，激发了对人类成就和造物之宏伟的惊叹。 “人算什么，你竟顾念他？”诗人曾如此发问。看到人类进入太空，触及星辰，这能激发敬畏之心，并更深地体会生命的恩赐和我们所居住的宇宙。

verse.textEn: What is mankind that you are mindful of them, human beings that you care for them?
verse.textZh: 人算什么，你竟顾念他？

title.en: Ex-lawmaker William Wong charged with drink driving, released on HK$5,000 bail
title.zh: 前议员黄碧云被控酒驾并获准以5000港元保释

summary.en: Former lawmaker William Wong has been charged with drink driving and failing to stop after a traffic accident, two months after the incident prompted his resignation from the Legislative Council. The 66-year-old lawmaker appeared at the Shatin Magistrates’ Court on Wednesday morning for the first mention of the case....
summary.zh: 前议员黄碧云被控酒驾及肇事后不顾而去，事件发生在两个月前，并导致他辞去立法会议员职务。这位66岁的议员周三上午在沙田裁判法院首次提堂。黄碧云被控酒后驾驶、危险驾驶、肇事后不顾而去以及未有报告涉及损坏的事故，所有指控均与6月29日发生在中国香港中文大学的事件有关。

body.en: Ex-lawmaker William Wong has been charged with drink driving and failing to stop after a traffic accident, two months after the incident prompted his resignation from the Legislative Council. Ex-lawmaker William Wong. Photo: William Wong, via Facebook. The 66-year-old lawmaker appeared at the Shatin Magistrates’ Court on Wednesday morning for the first mention of the case. Wong was charged with driving with alcohol concentration above the prescribed limit; dangerous driving; failing to stop after an accident; and failing to report an accident involving damage. The charges all relate to an incident at the Chinese University of Hong Kong (CUHK) on June 29. Wong, who was also an associate dean at the university’s engineering faculty, allegedly hit two parked cars outside a residential hall at CUHK on that night, police said. Wong left the scene after the accident but later returned for an investigation, during which he failed a breathalyser test. Days after, he stepped down as a lawmaker and apologised for bringing “trouble” to society. CUHK also suspended Wong from his position as the engineering faculty’s external affairs associate dean, although the university website still lists him as a professor. A sign inside Hong Kong’s Legislative Council showing the names of lawmakers, including William Wong, who resigned on July 3, 2026 following a drink driving arrest. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. According to the prosecution, Wong had a breath-alcohol level of 45 micrograms – more than double the legal limit of 22 micrograms. Wong was released on a bail of HK5,000, local media reported , and will return to court on November 11. Under his bail conditions, he is prohibited from driving, must report to a police station fortnightly, and is barred from contacting prosecution witnesses. Wong evaded reporters’ questions as he left the court building. His lawyer Paul Tse, who is also a former lawmaker, said Wong would not be responding to questions while the case is ongoing.
body.zh: 前立法会议员黄威廉被控酒后驾驶和交通事故后未能停车，两个月前该事件促使他辞去立法会议员职务。前立法会议员黄威廉。照片：William Wong，来自 Facebook。这位66岁的立法会议员周三早上在沙田裁判法院出庭，首次提及此案。黄先生被控酒精浓度超过规定限度驾驶；危险驾驶；发生事故后未能停车；以及未报告涉及损坏的事故。这些指控均与 6 月 29 日在香港中文大学（中大）发生的一起事件有关。警方称，身兼该大学工程学院副院长的黄某涉嫌当晚撞到了中大宿舍外停放的两辆汽车。事故发生后，黄离开了现场，但后来返回接受调查，期间他未能通过酒精测试。几天后，他辞去议员职务，并为给社会带来“麻烦”而道歉。香港中文大学还暂停了黄先生的工程学院外事副院长职务，尽管该大学网站仍将他列为教授。香港立法会内的一个标牌上显示了立法会议员的姓名，其中包括黄威廉，他因酒后驾车被捕而于 2026 年 7 月 3 日辞职。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。据检方称，黄的呼气酒精含量为 45 微克，是法定上限 22 微克的两倍多。据当地媒体报道，黄以 5,000 港元保释，将于 11 月 11 日返回法庭。根据保释条件，他被禁止开车，必须每两周到警察局报到，并且被禁止联系控方证人。黄在离开法院大楼时回避了记者的提问。他的律师、前立法会议员谢保罗表示，在案件进行期间，黄将不会回答问题。

reflection.en: The charges against William Wong, including drink driving and failing to stop after an accident, underscore the importance of accountability for those in public life. Micah 6:8 calls us to act justly, love mercy, and walk humbly with our God, principles that should guide all citizens, especially those who have held positions of trust. Even when facing legal...
reflection.zh: 黄碧云被控酒驾及肇事后不顾而去等罪名，凸显了公职人员问责的重要性。《弥迦书》6章8节呼吁我们行公义、好怜悯、谦卑与神同行，这些原则应指导所有公民，尤其是那些曾担任受信赖职位的人。 即使面临法律后果，前进的道路也包括承认过错、寻求公义并展现谦卑，这体现了对正直品格的承诺，以荣耀神和社区。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: Hong Kong man arrested for allegedly splashing woman with unknown liquid on MTR
title.zh: 香港男子涉嫌在地鐵上向女子潑灑不明液體被捕

summary.en: A 59-year-old man has been arrested on suspicion of indecent assault after a 20-year-old female student reported being splashed with a liquid on the MTR's East Rail line. Police made the arrest after reviewing surveillance footage.
summary.zh: 一名20歲的女學生報警稱在地鐵東鐵線列車上被一名男子潑灑不明液體，警方隨後逮捕了一名59歲男子，懷疑其涉及非禮。

body.en: A 59-year-old man has been arrested on suspicion of indecent assault after a woman reported being splashed with a liquid on the MTR. People get on the East Rail Line of MTR, on September 6, 2025. File photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. The police made the arrest on Tuesday evening after reviewing surveillance footage of the incident on the East Rail line of the MTR between Tai Po Market and Tai Wo stations, Acting Chief Inspector Ng Chin-wang of the Tai Po district crime division said on Tuesday. ‘Deviant behaviour’ Ng said that a 20-year-old female student reported the incident to station staff at Tai Wo and called the police after suspecting that she had been touched by a passenger and finding an unknown clear white liquid on her clothing at around 7pm on Monday evening. A 59-year-old local man, surnamed Luk, was arrested in Tai Po on Tuesday afternoon on suspicion of indecent assault. The Tai Po crime unit is handling the investigation. A preliminary investigation suggests that the suspect acted on his own in the train carriage and identified his target before committing the act. He also did not know the student personally. People walk in the Hong Kong’s bustling Mong Kok district in March 2023. File photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. Ng also urged people to step forward and report such incidents to the police. “We urge victims of sexual crimes and witnesses to come forward and allow the police to take further action, so that we can join hands to fight against deviant behaviour in our society,” he said in Cantonese. ‘No real consequences’ Media coverage in recent years has shone a light on cases when individuals were prosecuted for splashing liquids on women in public spaces . The act is seen as a type of sexual violence. Earlier this year, a 34-year-old man was charged with loitering after allegedly splashing an unknown liquid on three women in separate incidents in Sha Tin. In September 2024, a mainland Chinese neuroscience PhD student at the City University of Hong Kong was fined HK$5,000 after pleading guilty to splashing water mixed with his semen onto a woman’s buttocks at the university. The prosecution later sought a heavier sentence and moved to issue an arrest warrant after the man left Hong Kong. Concern groups called for a stronger sentence, saying the initial penalty sent the message that sexual violence has “no real consequences.”
body.zh: 一名女子举报在地铁上被泼液体后，一名 59 岁男子因涉嫌非礼被捕。 2025 年 9 月 6 日，人们搭乘港铁东铁线。资料图片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。大埔警区刑事科代总督察吴展宏周二表示，警方在查阅大埔墟至太窝站之间的港铁东铁线事件的监控录像后，于周二晚进行逮捕。 “行为异常” 吴说，周一晚上7点左右，一名20岁女学生怀疑自己被一名乘客触摸，发现衣服上有不明透明白色液体，向太和车站工作人员报案，并报了警。一名59岁的本地男子陆某周二下午因涉嫌猥亵罪在大埔被捕。大埔重案组现正跟进调查。初步调查显示，犯罪嫌疑人在火车车厢内自行作案，并在作案前确定了目标。他本人也不认识该学生。 2023 年 3 月，人们在香港繁华的旺角区行走。资料照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。吴还敦促人们站出来向警方举报此类事件。他用粤语说：“我们呼吁性犯罪受害人和目击者挺身而出，让警方采取进一步行动，以便我们携手打击社会上的不正常行为。” “没有真正的后果” 近年来的媒体报道揭示了一些个人因在公共场所向女性泼洒液体而被起诉的案件。该行为被视为性暴力的一种。今年早些时候，一名 34 岁男子在沙田多起事件中向三名女子泼洒不明液体，因此被控游荡罪。 2024年9月，香港城市大学一名中国内地神经科学博士生承认将精液混合的水溅到一名女子臀部上，被罚款5000港元。检方其后寻求加重刑罚，并在该男子离开香港后发出逮捕令。关注团体呼吁判处更严厉的刑罚，称最初的刑罚传达了这样的信息：性暴力“没有真正的后果”。

reflection.en: This incident on the MTR highlights a moment of violation and fear for one individual. The call to 'learn to do good; seek justice, rebuke the insolent' reminds us to stand against such acts and support those who have been wronged. May justice prevail and safety be restored for all commuters.
reflection.zh: 這起在地鐵發生的事件，凸顯了一名乘客所經歷的侵犯與恐懼。‘你們要求公義，實行公平，現在卻要潔淨你們的手，因為滿手是血！’（賽1:15-16，意譯）這提醒我們，要挺身反對這類行為，並支持那些受害的人。願公義得以彰顯，所有通勤者的安全都能得到保障。

verse.textEn: Learn to do right; seek justice. Defend the oppressed. Take up the cause of the fatherless; plead the case of the widow.
verse.textZh: 学习行善，寻求公平，解救受欺压的；给孤儿伸冤，为寡妇辨屈。

title.en: CE expresses sorrow over Tung Chee-hwa's passing
title.zh: 行政长官对董建华逝世表示哀悼

summary.en: Hong Kong's Chief Executive John Lee expressed deep sadness following the death of Tung Chee-hwa, the city's first Chief Executive, at the age of 89. Lee commended Tung's leadership during Hong Kong's return to China and the implementation of 'One Country, Two Systems,' noting his role in navigating the Asian...
summary.zh: 香港行政长官李家超周三对香港首任行政长官董建华逝世表示深切哀悼，享年89岁。李家超在声明中称赞董建华在确保香港顺利回归祖国和实施“一国两制”方面的领导作用，并指出他在亚洲金融危机期间的领导以及推动经济复苏和与内地经济联系的贡献。

body.en: Chief Executive John Lee on Wednesday expressed profound sorrow over the passing of Hong Kong's first Chief Executive, Tung Chee‑hwa, who died at the age of 89. In a statement, Lee said Tung's leadership was exemplary in ensuring Hong Kong's smooth return to the motherland and implementing "One Country, Two Systems". Lee said during Tung's tenure, he steered Hong Kong through the Asian financial crisis and led the city to a robust economic recovery. Lee said Tung's foresight in promoting economic ties with the mainland laid a solid foundation for Hong Kong's competitiveness – and his contributions were exceptionally significant. Lee said Tung continued to serve the nation as Vice‑Chairman of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference National Committee, and contributed to Hong Kong's prosperity and development after he concluded his tenure as Chief Executive in 2005. Lee said Tung also played a key role in fostering exchanges between Hong Kong and the international community, raising the city's global influence. "Mr Tung dedicated his life to serving the country and Hong Kong. I am profoundly grieved by his passing, and his life-long and monumental contributions to Hong Kong will forever be etched on our memory," he said. Edited by Aaron Tam
body.zh: 行政长官李家超周三对香港首任行政长官董建华逝世表示深切哀悼，享年89岁。李家耀在一份声明中表示，董建华的领导在确保香港顺利回归祖国和落实“一国两制”方面发挥了模范作用。李光耀表示，董建华任职期间，带领香港度过亚洲金融危机，实现经济强劲复苏。李说，董建华在促进与内地经济联系方面的远见卓识，为香港的竞争力奠定了坚实的基础，他的贡献异常重大。李说，董建华2005年卸任行政长官后，继续以全国政协副主席身份为国家服务，为香港的繁荣发展作出了贡献。李说，董建华还在促进香港与国际社会的交流、提升香港的全球影响力方面发挥了重要作用。他说：“董先生毕生致力于服务国家和香港。我对他的去世深感悲痛，他对香港一生的巨大贡献将永远铭刻在我们的记忆中。”谭咏麟编辑

reflection.en: The news of Tung Chee-hwa's passing at 89 reminds us of the universal human experience of mortality. Hebrews 9:27 speaks to this reality, stating that it is appointed for all people to die. In the midst of reflecting on a leader's life and contributions, we are also reminded of our own finite time and the ultimate accountability we all face.
reflection.zh: 董建华先生以89岁高龄逝世的消息，提醒我们死亡是全人类共同的经历。希伯来书9章27节指出了这一现实，即人人都有一死。在回顾一位领导者的一生及其贡献的同时，我们也应铭记自己生命的有限，以及我们终将面对的终极审判。

verse.textEn: Just as people are destined to die once, and after that to face judgment.
verse.textZh: 按着定命，人人都有一死，死后且有审判。

title.en: Hong Kong a ‘2-way springboard’ between mainland China and world: John Lee
title.zh: 香港是连接中国内地与世界的“双向跳板”：李家超

summary.en: Hong Kong will continue to serve as a gateway linking belt and road economies with mainland China and global markets, the chief executive has said, underscoring the city’s role in bringing together capital, talent and businesses to advance the national initiative.
summary.zh: 香港将继续作为连接“一带一路”经济体与中国内地及全球市场的门户，行政长官表示，强调了该市在汇聚资本、人才和企业以推进国家倡议方面的作用。

body.en: Hong Kong will continue to serve as a gateway linking belt and road economies with mainland China and global markets, the chief executive has said, underscoring the city’s role in bringing together capital, talent and businesses to advance the national initiative. Speaking at the opening of the annual Belt and Road Summit on Wednesday, John Lee Ka-chiu said more than 60 government and business agreements and memorandums of understanding (MOUs) would be signed during the event, with the total...
body.zh: 行政长官表示，香港将继续充当连接“一带一路”经济体与中国内地和全球市场的门户，并强调香港在汇聚资本、人才和企业以推进国家倡议方面的作用。李家超周三在一年一度的“一带一路”高峰论坛开幕式上发表讲话时表示，活动期间将签署 60 多项政府和企业协议及谅解备忘录（MOU），总...

reflection.en: John Lee describes Hong Kong as a "2-way springboard," a hub for capital, talent, and business. This vision of connection and advancement echoes the wisdom of committing one's endeavors to a higher power. As we build and connect, may our plans be guided by divine wisdom, ensuring our efforts contribute to flourishing and stability.
reflection.zh: 李家超将香港描述为“双向跳板”，是资本、人才和商业的中心。这种连接和进步的愿景呼应了将努力付托于更高力量的智慧。当我们建设和连接时，愿我们的计划得到神圣智慧的指引，确保我们的努力有助于繁荣和稳定。

verse.textEn: Commit to Yahweh whatever you do, and he will establish your plans.
verse.textZh: 你所做的，要交托雅伟，你所谋的，就必成立。

title.en: 'Improving globalisation can curb int'l uncertainties'
title.zh: 改善全球化可遏制国际不确定性

summary.en: Secretary for Commerce and Economic Development Algernon Yau stated on Wednesday that improving globalization is crucial for addressing challenges posed by the volatile international landscape. He emphasized that geopolitical tensions have altered international commerce rules and relations, leading to consequences...
summary.zh: 商务及经济发展局局长丘应棠周三表示，改善全球化是应对动荡国际格局所带来挑战的关键。他强调，地缘政治紧张局势改变了国际商业规则以及国家和地区之间的关系，导致保护主义抬头，并带来了成本上升和供应链中断等经济后果。

body.en: Secretary for Commerce and Economic Development Algernon Yau on Wednesday said that improving globalisation is the key to tackle the challenges brought by the volatile international landscape. Chairing a panel themed "Building Resilient Trade and Investment Frameworks in a Diverse Global Landscape" at the Belt and Road Summit, he said the rules of international commerce and relations between countries and regions had changed due to geopolitical tensions. Rising protectionism through tariffs, discriminatory regulations, export restrictions, have led to economic consequences, including higher costs and supply chain disruptions, Yau said. But the minister highlighted that countries and regions should not move away from the international market. “It is imperative for us to pursue a trade and investment model that can withstand all this unreasonable pressure,” he said. “We must uphold a rules-based multilateral trading system and to promote transparent and non-discriminatory regulations, and facilitate customs and digital compatibility and ensure that the benefits of trade are shared.” The commerce chief said the SAR had played a part in helping businesses to open up new markets and diversify supply chains. For instance, the government offered financial and legal advisory as well as logistics and strategic support services. Yau noted that by stepping up Hong Kong’s role as a "super connector" and "super value-adder" through the Belt and Road Initiative, and the expansion of free trade agreements to promote trade across regions, it would also help companies mitigate risks. The Belt and Road Summit at the Convention and Exhibition Centre in Wan Chai will conclude on Thursday. Edited by Tony Sabine
body.zh: 香港商务及经济发展局局长邱腾华周三表示，改善全球化是应对国际形势动荡带来的挑战的关键。他在“一带一路”高峰论坛上主持了“在多元化的全球格局中建立有弹性的贸易和投资框架”小组讨论时表示，由于地缘政治紧张局势，国际商业规则以及国家和地区之间的关系已经发生变化。丘表示，关税、歧视性法规、出口限制等保护主义抬头​​，导致了经济后果，包括成本上升和供应链中断。但部长强调，国家和地区不应远离国际市场。 “我们必须追求一种能够承受所有这些不合理压力的贸易和投资模式，”他说。 “我们必须维护基于规则的多边贸易体系，促进透明和非歧视性监管，促进海关和数字兼容性，确保贸易利益共享。”这位商务主管表示，特区在帮助企业开拓新市场和实现供应链多元化方面发挥了作用。例如，政府提供财务和法律咨询以及物流和战略支持服务。邱腾华指出，透过「一带一路」倡议，以及扩大自由贸易协定以促进跨地区贸易，加强香港作为「超级联系人」和「超级增值者」的角色，也有助企业纾缓风险。 “一带一路”高峰论坛将于周四在湾仔会展中心闭幕。托尼·萨宾编辑

reflection.en: In a world marked by geopolitical tensions and rising protectionism, the call to improve globalization underscores the need for wise counsel. As Secretary Algernon Yau noted the disruptions caused by tariffs and export restrictions, it's clear that navigating these complex economic waters requires thoughtful, informed decision-making. Proverbs 11:14 reminds...
reflection.zh: 在一个地缘政治紧张和保护主义抬头的世界里，呼吁改善全球化凸显了寻求明智建议的必要性。正如商务及经济发展局局长丘应棠指出的，关税和出口限制带来了混乱，显然，驾驭这些复杂的经济环境需要深思熟虑、信息灵通的决策。箴言11:14提醒我们，谋士众多，所谋乃成，敦促领导者寻求多样化和明智的意见，以建立有韧性的框架。

verse.textEn: For lack of guidance a nation falls, but victory is won through many advisers.
verse.textZh: 无智谋，民就败落；谋士多，人便安居。

title.en: ‘Keep pushing, never fear hardships,’ Hong Kong’s first astronaut tells students
title.zh: 香港首位航天员寄语学生：‘继续前进，永不畏惧艰难’

summary.en: Hong Kong's first astronaut, Lai Ka-ying, will conduct a live lesson from space to students and teachers at her alma mater, Tsuen Wan Public Ho Chuen Yiu Memorial College, on Wednesday. The 90-minute "Tiangong Class" will be broadcast to campuses across the city and streamed live on television, with Lai and her two...
summary.zh: 香港首位航天员赖嘉颖将于周三上午在其母校荃湾公立何传耀纪念中学，为学生和教师进行一场太空授课。这场为期90分钟的“天宫课堂”将面向全港校园直播，并进行电视转播。赖嘉颖将与她的两位神舟二十三号乘组同事一同参与。

body.en: Hong Kong’s first astronaut, Lai Ka-ying, will deliver a live lesson from space to students and teachers at her alma mater on Wednesday morning, with the 90-minute event broadcast to campuses across the city and streamed live on television. Lai and her two fellow Shenzhou-23 crew members – mission commander Colonel Zhu Yangzhu and Zhang Zhiyuan – will take part in the “Tiangong Class” at Tsuen Wan Public Ho Chuen Yiu Memorial College. Representatives from the youth sector and innovation and...
body.zh: 香港首位宇航员黎嘉英将于周三上午在太空为母校的学生和老师进行现场直播，整个活动时长 90 分钟，将向全市各个校园进行直播，并通过电视进行直播。赖和她的两名神舟二十三号船员——任务指挥官朱杨柱上校和张志远——将参加荃湾公立何传耀纪念中学的“天宫班”。来自青年部门和创新部门的代表...

reflection.en: As astronaut Lai Ka-ying prepares to teach from the International Space Station, her message to students – 'Keep pushing, never fear hardships' – resonates deeply. This journey, demanding immense dedication and resilience, mirrors the spiritual strength promised to those who trust in Yahweh, enabling them to soar above challenges.
reflection.zh: 航天员赖嘉颖即将从太空站为学生授课，她寄语学生“继续前进，永不畏惧艰难”，这番话语深刻地引起了共鸣。这次太空之旅需要巨大的奉献和韧性，它呼应了雅伟应许赐予那些等候祂之人的力量，使他们能超越挑战，如同翱翔天际。

verse.textEn: Those who hope in Yahweh will renew their strength. They will soar on wings like eagles; they will run and not grow weary.
verse.textZh: 但那等候雅伟的，必从新得力。他们必如鹰展翅上腾。

title.en: Humble leader and role model for a generation: Hong Kong’s Tung Chee-hwa mourned
title.zh: 香港首任行政长官董建华逝世，各界致哀

summary.en: Tung Chee-hwa, Hong Kong's first chief executive who oversaw the city's 1997 return to Chinese rule, has died at the age of 89. His office confirmed his passing on Tuesday, stating he died surrounded by loved ones at the Hong Kong Sanatorium & Hospital. Tung also served as a vice-chairman of the Chinese People's...
summary.zh: 香港首任行政长官、见证了香港于1997年回归中国的董建华已于周二去世，享年89岁。他的办公室在周三凌晨发布的声明中证实了这一消息，并表示他是在亲人的陪伴下安详离世的。董建华也曾担任中国人民政治协商会议全国委员会副主席。

body.en: Tung Chee-hwa, Hong Kong’s first chief executive who oversaw the city’s 1997 return to Chinese rule, has died. According to a statement from his office issued in the early hours on Wednesday, he died on Tuesday at the age of 89, surrounded by his loved ones. It is understood that he died at the Hong Kong Sanatorium & Hospital. Tung was also a vice-chairman of China’s top political advisory body, the Chinese People’s Political Consultative Conference. In this live blog, the South China Morning...
body.zh: 香港首任行政长官董建华去世，他领导香港于 1997 年回归中国。根据他的办公室周三凌晨发布的一份声明，他于周二在亲人的陪伴下去世，享年 89 岁。据了解，他于养和医院去世。董建华还曾担任中国最高政治咨询机构中国人民政治协商会议的副主席。在这个实时博客中，《南华早报》...

reflection.en: The news of Tung Chee-hwa's passing at 89 reminds us of the universal human experience of mortality. Hebrews 9:27 speaks to this reality, stating that 'man is destined to die once, and after that to face judgment.' This truth calls us to reflect on the brevity of life and the importance of how we live it.
reflection.zh: 董建华先生以89岁高龄辞世的消息，提醒我们所有人都将面对生命的终点。希伯来书9章27节说道：“人人都有一死，死后且有审判。”这一真理促使我们反思生命的短暂，以及我们如何度过此生的重要性。

verse.textEn: Just as people are destined to die once, and after that to face judgment.
verse.textZh: 按着定命，人人都有一死，死后且有审判。

title.en: Marriage equality strengthens Hong Kong families and communities
title.zh: 婚姻平權強化香港家庭與社區

summary.en: Hong Kong's debate over same-sex relationships is often framed as a question of constitutional law, social values, or individual rights, but it also impacts public health. A year after the Legislative Council rejected the Registration of Same-sex Partnerships Bill, the legal uncertainty surrounding same-sex couples...
summary.zh: 香港關於同性伴侶關係的辯論常被框定為憲法、社會價值或個人權利的問題，但這也關乎公眾健康。在立法會否決《同性伴侶關係登記條例草案》一年後，同性伴侶的法律認證問題仍未解決。亨利·李（Henry Li）在丈夫去世後，不得不經歷漫長的法律訴訟，以爭取應有的保障，這凸顯了該未決問題給同性伴侶帶來的壓力。

body.en: Hong Kong’s debate over same-sex relationships is often framed as a question of constitutional law, social values, or individual rights. But it is also a question of public health. Henry Li and Edgar Ng’s wedding in 2017. Photo: Supplied. A year after the Legislative Council rejected the Registration of Same-sex Partnerships Bill, the legal recognition of same-sex couples remains unresolved – and that uncertainty places unnecessary stress on same-sex couples. It is plainly not in society’s interest to witness another heart-breaking situation like that faced by Henry Li , who was forced into lengthy legal proceedings after the death of his husband simply to secure protections that should never have been in doubt. The consequences deserve to be considered not only in legal terms, but also in terms of health, well-being, and social cohesion. Mental health has become an increasingly important policy concern in Hong Kong, particularly among younger people. Yet public discussions often focus on individual interventions while paying less attention to the structural conditions that influence health, including social inclusion, protection from discrimination and legal recognition of non-traditional family relationships. At first glance, marriage may not appear to be a public health issue. Yet public health has long recognized that health is shaped not only by healthcare services or individual choices, but also by the social conditions in which people live. Laws influence access to security, social support, and equal treatment. In other words, the law itself forms part of the environment in which one’s health is determined. This matters because the health disparities experienced by LGBTQ+ people in Hong Kong remain significant. A 2025 survey by researchers from the Chinese University of Hong Kong and the University of Hong Kong found that 30.8 per cent of LGBTQ+ respondents reported symptoms of moderate-to-severe depression, while 24 per cent reported moderate-to-severe anxiety. These figures were virtually unchanged from a comparable survey conducted seven years earlier. The persistence of these disparities suggests that greater visibility alone has not eliminated the structural and social factors associated with poorer mental health outcomes. The researchers described the findings as evidence of a long-neglected problem requiring broader societal and policy responses. Beyond symbolism One often-overlooked factor is the legal environment in which LGBTQ+ people live. The minority stress framework describes how persistent experiences of discrimination, stigma, and exclusion create chronic psychological pressures that contribute to poorer health outcomes among sexual minorities. Importantly, the problem does not arise from sexual orientation itself,...
body.zh: 香港关于同性关系的争论常常被视为宪法、社会价值观或个人权利的问题。但这也是一个公共卫生问题。 2017 年，亨利·李 (Henry Li) 和埃德加·吴 (Edgar Ng) 的婚礼。照片：提供。立法会否决《同性伴侣登记条例草案》一年后，同性伴侣的法律承认问题仍未解决——这种不确定性给同性伴侣带来了不必要的压力。目睹李亨利所面临的另一种令人心碎的情况显然不符合社会利益，他在丈夫去世后被迫进入漫长的法律诉讼程序，只是为了获得本不应该受到怀疑的保护。其后果不仅应从法律角度考虑，还应从健康、福祉和社会凝聚力角度考虑。心理健康已成为香港日益重要的政策关注点，特别是在年轻人中。然而，公众讨论往往侧重于个人干预措施，而较少关注影响健康的结构性条件，包括社会包容、免受歧视以及对非传统家庭关系的法律承认。乍一看，婚姻似乎并不是一个公共健康问题。然而，公共卫生部门早已认识到，健康不仅取决于医疗保健服务或个人选择，还取决于人们生活的社会条件。法律影响获得安全、社会支持和平等待遇的机会。换句话说，法律本身就构成了决定个人健康的环境的一部分。这很重要，因为香港 LGBTQ+ 人群所经历的健康差异仍然很大。香港中文大学和香港大学的研究人员在 2025 年进行的一项调查发现，30.8% 的 LGBTQ+ 受访者报告有中度至重度抑郁症状，而 24% 的人报告有中度至重度焦虑症状。这些数字与七年前进行的可比调查相比几乎没有变化。这些差异的持续存在表明，仅仅提高可见度并不能消除与较差的心理健康结果相关的结构性和社会因素。研究人员将这些发现描述为一个长期被忽视的问题的证据，需要更广泛的社会和政策应对措施。超越象征意义 一个经常被忽视的因素是 LGBTQ+ 人群生活的法律环境。少数群体压力框架描述了持续的歧视、耻辱和排斥经历如何造成慢性心理压力，从而导致性少数群体的健康状况较差。重要的是，问题并不是由性取向本身引起的，......

reflection.en: The unresolved legal status of same-sex partnerships in Hong Kong creates profound hardship, as seen in Henry Li's struggle for protections after his husband's death. This situation underscores the need to advocate for those facing systemic injustice and to ensure that all families receive the recognition and support they deserve. Isaiah 1:17 calls us to...
reflection.zh: 香港同性伴侶關係法律地位懸而未決，造成了深重困苦，正如亨利·李在丈夫去世後為爭取保障而經歷的艱難。這種情況凸顯了為那些面臨體制性不公的人辯護，並確保所有家庭獲得應有的認可和支持的必要性。 以賽亞書 1:17 呼籲我們「你們要學習行善，尋求公平，解救受欺壓的，給孤兒伸冤，為寡婦之冤。」願我們被這些故事感動，積極捍衛弱勢群體，並倡導維護所有家庭尊嚴和安全的政策。

verse.textEn: Learn to do right; seek justice. Defend the oppressed. Take up the cause of the fatherless; plead the case of the widow.
verse.textZh: 学习行善，寻求公平，解救受欺压的；给孤儿伸冤，为寡妇辨屈。

title.en: Hong Kong Tiananmen vigil activists to be sentenced on Friday, facing max. penalty of 10 years’ jail
title.zh: 香港“六四”烛光晚会案活动人士周五判刑，最高可判十年监禁

summary.en: Three Hong Kong activists convicted under the national security law for their roles in commemorating the Tiananmen Square crackdown will be sentenced on Friday. They face a maximum of 10 years in prison each. The activists, former leaders of the Hong Kong Alliance, were found guilty of inciting subversion.
summary.zh: 三名因纪念天安门镇压事件而被判有罪的香港活动人士，将于周五被判刑。他们根据国家安全法被判犯有煽动颠覆罪，每人最高可判处十年监禁。这些活动人士曾是香港市民支援爱国民主运动联合会（支联会）的领导人。

body.en: Three Hong Kong Tiananmen vigil activists convicted under the national security law will be sentenced this Friday, with each of them facing maximum penalties of 10 years behind bars. Former Hong Kong Alliance in Support of Patriotic Democratic Movements of China Albert Ho (left), Lee Cheuk-yan (centre) and Chow Hang-tung (right) at Victoria Park in Hong Kong on June 4, 2020, after the annual Tiananmen vigil was banned on public health grounds because of Covid-19. Photo: Anthony Wallace/AFP. Chow Hang-tung, Lee Cheuk-yan and Albert Ho will appear at the West Kowloon Law Courts Building, according to the Judiciary’s court schedule. The trio are former leaders of the Hong Kong Alliance in Support of Patriotic Democratic Movements of China, which used to organise annual Tiananmen vigils in Causeway Bay’s Victoria Park until they were banned in 2020 and 2021. Chow and Lee, a former lawmaker, pleaded not guilty to inciting subversion, and sat through a trial earlier this year. They were found guilty last month , with the judges saying they had “all along been hostile towards the [Chinese Communist Party] and the Central Government under its leadership.” Hong Kong police set up a cordon outside the West Kowloon Law Courts Building on August 21, 2026, ahead of the verdict hearing of the trial of two Tiananmen vigil activists Chow Hang-tang and Lee Cheuk-yan on national security charges. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. Both of them have been remanded in custody since September 2021. Ho, also a former lawmaker, pleaded guilty when the trial began in January. Unlike Chow and Lee, he was initially granted bail after being charged, but was remanded in March 2023 after a magistrate ruled he had violated bail conditions . The Hong Kong Alliance in Support of Patriotic Democratic Movements of China announced its disbandment in September 2021 amid the enactment of the national security law. The group itself was also prosecuted, and convicted along with Chow and Lee last month.
body.zh: 三名根据国家安全法被定罪的香港天安门守夜活动人士将于本周五被判刑，他们每人将面临最高 10 年监禁的刑罚。 2020 年 6 月 4 日，前香港支持中国爱国民主运动联盟何俊仁（左）、李卓人（中）和周恒东（右）在香港维多利亚公园，一年一度的天安门守夜活动因 Covid-19 以公共卫生为由被禁止。照片：安东尼·华莱士/法新社。根据司法机构的法庭时间表，周恒东、李卓人及何俊仁将在西九龙法院大楼出庭。这三人是香港支持中国爱国民主运动联盟的前领导人，该联盟曾在铜锣湾维多利亚公园组织一年一度的天安门守夜活动，直到2020年和2021年被禁止。周和李是前立法会议员，他们对煽动颠覆罪不认罪，并在今年早些时候接受了审判。他们上个月被判有罪，法官称他们“一直敌视[中国共产党]及其领导的中央政府”。 2026 年 8 月 21 日，在对两名天安门守夜活动人士周行棠和李卓人以国家安全罪名进行审判之前，香港警方在西九龙法院大楼外设置了警戒线。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。自 2021 年 9 月起，两人均被还押候审。同为前议员的何先生在 1 月份审判开始时认罪。与周和李不同，他最初在受到指控后获得保释，但在地方法官裁定他违反保释条件后于 2023 年 3 月被还押。香港支持中国爱国民主运动联盟于2021年9月随着国家安全法的颁布而宣布解散。该组织本身也受到起诉，并于上个月与周和李一起被定罪。

reflection.en: The sentencing of these three activists brings into sharp focus the tension between civic duty and conscience. They face significant prison time for actions rooted in remembrance and advocacy. The principle of obeying God rather than human authorities, when they conflict, speaks to the deep moral choices individuals face when laws and deeply held beliefs...
reflection.zh: 这三名活动人士的判刑，将公民责任与良心之间的紧张关系推到了聚光灯下。他们因根植于纪念和倡导的行为而面临漫长的牢狱之灾。《使徒行传》5章29节的原则——‘顺从神，过于顺从人’——触及了当法律与个人坚定的信念发生冲突时，个体所面临的深刻道德抉择。

verse.textEn: We must obey God rather than human beings!
verse.textZh: 顺从神，不顺从人，是应当的。

title.en: Unidentified Murder review – playful sendup of alien abduction and true crime influencers in Hong Kong
title.zh: 《不明谋杀》评论——香港外星人绑架和真实犯罪网红的戏谑模仿

summary.en: Childhood friends claim to have witnessed the disappearance of a schoolkid in this low-budget comedy caper that pushes limits of storytelling. Modestly scaled and intricately structured, Kwok Ka-Hei and Jack Lee Chun-Kit’s comedy is a capriciously playful send-up of true crime aficionados and wannabe influencers, done...
summary.zh: 在这部突破叙事界限的低成本喜剧冒险片中，儿时好友声称目睹了一名学童的失踪。由郭嘉曦和李振杰执导的这部规模不大、结构精巧的喜剧，以一种随心所欲的戏谑方式模仿了真实犯罪爱好者和伪网红，但其出发点是喜爱而非恶意。影片围绕一个（虚构的）25年前的案件展开，该案件吸引了整个香港的关注。

body.en: Childhood friends claim to have witnessed the disappearance of a schoolkid in this low-budget comedy caper that pushes limits of storytelling Modestly scaled and intricately structured, Kwok Ka-Hei and Jack Lee Chun-Kit’s comedy is a capriciously playful send-up of true crime aficionados and wannabe influencers, done with affection rather than malice. It revolves around a (fictional) 25-year-old case that captivates the whole of Hong Kong. Back when they were seven, childhood friends Mark (Ling Man-lung) and Kit (Ronald Lam Tsz-kit) claimed to have witnessed the abduction by aliens of their classmate Ho in the woods of Tung Tau Hill. On the 25th anniversary of this supposed incident, the pair re-enter the internet’s consciousness after an interview on an online chatshow about unsolved mysteries. Cashing in on their viral fame, Mark’s girlfriend Man (Renci Yeung) hires actor Kim (Peter Chan Charm-man) to pretend to be Ho, all in the hope of racking up views on her social channels. Just when the cameras are all set up, Man watches in horror as the staged reunion leads to a real murder … or does it? The film unfolds in a series of increasingly tricksy complications and reversals. All of a sudden, apparent victims are revealed to be scheming masterminds, and vice versa. As most of the actions take place in the forest where the abduction supposedly occurred, the plot derives comic relief from the increasingly blurred line between truth and playacting. Largely shot with handheld cameras, it has a visual style that lends authenticity to representations of online media, though occasionally this distracts from the physical comedy performed by the cast. The constant twists also turn into bit of a competitive sport, meaning the film becomes more of a writing exercise than anything else. Continue reading...
body.zh: 儿时的朋友声称在这部低成本喜剧中目睹了一名小学生的失踪，这部喜剧突破了讲故事的极限。郭家熙和李俊杰的这部喜剧规模适中，结构复杂，是对真正的犯罪爱好者和想要成为影响者的反复无常的讽刺，是出于感情而不是恶意。它围绕着一个（虚构的）25 年前震惊整个香港的案件展开。七岁时，青梅竹马的Mark（凌文龙饰）和Kit（林中基饰）声称在东头山的树林里亲眼目睹了同学何氏被外星人绑架。在这起所谓的事件发生 25 周年之际，两人在一次关于未解之谜的在线访谈节目中接受采访后，重新进入了互联网的视野。马克的女友曼（杨仁慈饰）利用他们的病毒名气，聘请演员金（陈可辛饰）假扮何浩，希望能在她的社交频道上获得更多的关注。就在摄像机全部架好时，曼惊恐地看着这场上演的重聚导致了一场真正的谋杀……是吗？影片在一系列日益棘手的复杂情况和逆转中展开。突然之间，表面上的受害者被揭露为诡计多端的策划者，反之亦然。由于大部分情节都发生在据称发生绑架的森林中，因此事实与表演之间的界限越来越模糊，情节因此而变得喜剧化。它主要是用手持摄像机拍摄的，其视觉风格为在线媒体的表现提供了真实性，尽管有时这会分散演员们表演的肢体喜剧的注意力。不断的曲折也变成了一场竞技运动，这意味着这部电影更像是一场写作练习。继续阅读...

reflection.en: This film playfully satirizes our fascination with true crime and the influencers who amplify these stories. In a world saturated with sensational narratives, Philippians 4:8 reminds us to focus our minds on what is true, honorable, and excellent, rather than getting lost in speculation or manufactured drama. May we cultivate discernment in what we consume...
reflection.zh: 这部电影以一种戏谑的方式讽刺了我们对真实犯罪故事和放大这些故事的网红们的迷恋。在一个充斥着耸人听闻叙事的世界里，《腓立比书》4:8 提醒我们要将心思意念专注于真实、可敬、公义、清洁、可爱、有美名的事，而不是沉溺于猜测或人为制造的戏剧。愿我们培养辨别力，选择所消费和分享的内容，寻求真理与良善。

verse.textEn: Whatever is true, whatever is noble, whatever is right, whatever is pure, whatever is lovely, whatever is admirable — think about such things.
verse.textZh: 凡是真实的、可敬的、公义的、清洁的、可爱的、有美名的，这些事你们都要思念。

title.en: Hong Kong pro-democracy activist Joshua Wong pleads guilty in second national security case
title.zh: 香港民主派活动人士黄之锋承认在第二起国安案中认罪

summary.en: Joshua Wong, a prominent pro-democracy activist in Hong Kong, pleaded guilty on Wednesday to charges under the national security law, specifically conspiring to seek foreign sanctions against China. The charge carries a maximum penalty of life imprisonment.
summary.zh: 香港一位著名的民主派活动人士黄之锋周三承认触犯国安法，罪名是共谋寻求外国制裁中国，该罪名最高可判处无期徒刑。

body.en: Wong, 29, is accused of urging foreign powers to impose sanctions, blockades and other hostile measures against China Joshua Wong , one of Hong Kong’s most prominent pro-democracy activists, pleaded guilty on Wednesday to conspiring to seek foreign sanctions against Hong Kong and China, a national security charge that carries a maximum life sentence. Prosecutors have accused Wong, 29, of working with the exiled Hong Kong activist Nathan Law to urge foreign powers to impose sanctions, blockades or other hostile measures against China. Continue reading...
body.zh: 29 岁的黄之锋被指控敦促外国势力对中国实施制裁、封锁和其他敌对措施。香港最著名的民主活动人士之一黄之锋周三承认密谋寻求外国对香港和中国实施制裁，这一国家安全指控最高可判处无期徒刑。检察官指控 29 岁的黄与流亡香港活动人士罗冠聪合作，敦促外国势力对中国实施制裁、封锁或其他敌对措施。继续阅读...

reflection.en: Joshua Wong, a young activist known for his role in Hong Kong's democracy movement, has pleaded guilty to charges under the national security law. This situation brings to the fore the difficult tension between civic obedience and deeply held convictions. The apostles' unwavering stance, 'We must obey God rather than human beings,' offers a timeless...
reflection.zh: 香港一位以其在民主运动中角色而闻名的年轻活动人士黄之锋，已承认触犯国安法。这一局面凸显了公民服从与内心深处信念之间的艰难张力。使徒们坚定的立场——“顺从神，过于顺从人”——为这种良心冲突提供了永恒的视角。

verse.textEn: We must obey God rather than human beings!
verse.textZh: 顺从神，不顺从人，是应当的。

title.en: Shein shares slide on fast-fashion retailer’s stock market debut
title.zh: 希音在港交所上市首日股价下跌

summary.en: Shares of the fast-fashion retailer Shein fell by up to 10% on their debut on the Hong Kong stock exchange. The company, founded in China and now headquartered in Singapore, was once valued at nearly $100 billion but listed at a valuation of just over $26 billion.
summary.zh: 这家快时尚零售商希音在香港证券交易所上市首日股价下跌高达10%。这家公司起源于中国，现总部设在新加坡，曾一度估值近1000亿美元，但此次上市的估值仅略高于260亿美元。

body.en: Hong Kong flotation at $26bn by firm once valued at $100bn follows failure to list in US and UK Shares in the fast-fashion brand Shein slumped by as much as 10% as the China-founded company made its long-anticipated trading debut on the Hong Kong stock exchange. The Singapore-headquartered company, once valued at almost $100bn (£74bn), went public on Tuesday pricing shares at HK$48.56, valuing the business at just over $26bn. Continue reading...

Shein was seen as a shot of tech adrenalin for a listless local listings scene, and an opportunity to advertise the UK’s openness to international capital. Continue reading...

Committing our plans and work to God, as Proverbs 16:3 suggests, can bring clarity and purpose, even...

title.en: AI D-Day weather forecast falters under pressure
title.zh: 人工智能的诺曼底登陆天气预报在压力下失灵

summary.en: New research from the University of Reading indicates that even today's most advanced weather computers would have struggled to accurately predict the weather conditions for the D-Day landings in June 1944. Using AI models, researchers created 50 different forecasts for the storm that caused the Allied invasion to be...
summary.zh: 英国雷丁大学的一项新研究表明，即使是当今最先进的天气计算机，也难以准确预测1944年6月诺曼底登陆时的天气状况。研究人员利用人工智能模型，对导致盟军入侵推迟的那场风暴进行了50次不同的天气预报。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

Today's best weather computers would still have struggled to accurately predict the weather for the D-Day landings, University of Reading research shows. The new research, published in the journal Weather ahead of the release of the D-Day film "Pressure," used AI models to produce 50 different forecasts of the storm that famously pushed back the Allies' invasion of Normandy in June 1944.

The researchers checked how confident the AI model was in its forecast of the weather Group Captain James Stagg had to predict on June 5 and 6. For June 5, the day originally planned for the invasion, the model got the storm's position right and correctly predicted poor conditions over Normandy, matching Stagg's own analysis. For June 6, the model predicted the storm would move toward Norway, bringing calmer weather, albeit much more quickly than what really happened.

Professor Andrew Charlton-Perez, lead author of the study at the University of Reading, said, "Captain James Stagg had one of the hardest jobs in history. Get the forecast wrong, the invasion could have failed and the Second World War could have been lost.

"Some Allied meteorologists were insistent the weather would be fine for the invasion to take place as planned on June 5, after weeks of hot weather. Our research shows Stagg would likely have defied his colleagues and made the same call to delay if he had the AI forecast to support him. The AI pointed to a real risk of dangerous winds on June 5, enough to justify delaying the invasion by a day.

"The AI incorrectly predicted June 6 would be much calmer and clearer than it really was, as soldiers faced more treacherous weather. Stagg believed the conditions were fair enough on June 6, leading Eisenhower to give his famous order, 'OK, we'll go.'

"AI weather forecasts can process huge amounts of data in seconds, but they can still make mistakes. Having a trained meteorologist to make sense of all of the forecast data and make forecasts based on their knowledge and experience remains just as critical today as it was for the D-Day landings."

The extraordinary story of how Stagg had to determine whether the weather would be good enough to let 160,000 troops cross the Channel and storm the beaches of Normandy on June 5 is now the subject of a Hollywood film called "Pressure," starring Andrew Scott as Stagg and Brendan Fraser as Eisenhower.

In the film, Stagg has to balance advice from different forecasting teams that disagree about how a storm in the North Sea will affect the invasion.

body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 雷丁大学的研究表明，当今最好的天气计算机仍然难以准确预测诺曼底登陆的天气。这项新研究在诺曼底登陆电影《压力》上映前发表在《天气》杂志上，利用人工智能模型对这场风暴做出了 50 种不同的预测，这场风暴曾在 1944 年 6 月阻止了盟军对诺曼底的入侵。 研究人员检查了人工智能模型对詹姆斯·斯塔格上尉必须预测的 6 月 5 日和 6 日天气的信心程度。对于 6 月 5 日，即最初计划的入侵日，该模型正确地预测了风暴的位置，并正确预测了诺曼底上空的恶劣天气，这与斯塔格自己的分析相符。 6 月 6 日，模型预测风暴将向挪威移动，带来平静的天气，尽管比实际发生的速度要快得多。 雷丁大学这项研究的主要作者安德鲁·查尔顿-佩雷斯教授表示：“詹姆斯·斯塔格上尉的工作是历史上最艰难的工作之一。如果预测错误，入侵可能会失败，第二次世界大战也可能失败。” “在经历了数周的炎热天气后，一些盟军气象学家坚称天气状况良好，有利于按计划于 6 月 5 日进行入侵。我们的研究表明，如果人工智能预测支持他，斯塔格很可能会反抗他的同事，并做出同样的推迟决定。 AI 指出 6 月 5 日确实存在危险大风的风险，这足以证明推迟一天​​入侵是合理的。 “人工智能错误地预测 6 月 6 日会比实际情况更加平静和清晰，因为士兵们面临着更加危险的天气。斯塔格认为 6 月 6 日的情况足够公平，导致艾森豪威尔下达了他著名的命令：‘好吧，我们出发。’ “人工智能天气预报可以在几秒钟内处理大量数据，但它们仍然可能会出错。拥有训练有素的气象学家来理解所有预报数据并根据他们的知识和经验做出预报，在今天仍然和诺曼底登陆一样重要。” 6月5日，斯塔格必须确定天气是否足够好，让16万军队横渡英吉利海峡并袭击诺曼底海滩，这个非凡的故事现在成为好莱坞电影《压力》的主题，由安德鲁·斯科特饰演斯塔格，布兰登·弗雷泽饰演艾森豪威尔。 在影片中，斯塔格必须平衡来自不同预测团队的建议，这些预测团队对于北海风暴将如何影响入侵存在分歧。 研究人员将该模型与英吉利海峡上实际发生的情况进行了比较，...

reflection.en: The D-Day landings, a pivotal moment in history, were heavily dependent on accurate weather prediction. This research shows that even with advanced AI, forecasting such complex systems remains a challenge. It reminds us that while human ingenuity and technology are valuable tools, true wisdom and foresight ultimately come from committing our plans and...
reflection.zh: 诺曼底登陆是历史上一个关键时刻，其成功在很大程度上依赖于精确的天气预报。这项研究表明，即使拥有先进的人工智能，预测如此复杂的天气系统仍然是一个挑战。这提醒我们，虽然人类的智慧和技术是宝贵的工具，但真正的智慧和远见最终来自于将我们的计划和努力托付给雅伟，信靠祂在一切境况中的最终指引和主权。

title.en: Calculative mindsets linked to greater willingness to bend moral rules
title.zh: 计算型思维方式与更愿意弯曲道德规则相关联

summary.en: New research published in the PsyCh Journal indicates that individuals who tend to view experiences through a mathematical cost-benefit lens are more inclined to disregard moral rules. This analytical approach is associated with a greater readiness to make ethical compromises for personal gain, such as money or...
summary.zh: 发表在《PsyCh Journal》上的一项新研究表明，倾向于将经历视为数学成本效益问题的人，越有可能忽视道德规则。这种倾向与为了金钱或地位而做出道德妥协的意愿更大，以及在有利可图时接受不道德的帮助有关。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

In new research in the PsyCh Journal , people who tended to analyze experiences as mathematical cost-benefit problems were more likely to ignore moral rules. This tendency was associated with a greater willingness to make ethical compromises for money or status, as well as to accept immoral help when it benefited them.

The findings come from three studies (two questionnaire-based and one experimental) involving mostly young, highly educated and predominantly Chinese adults.

The results suggest that reducing this kind of "calculative thinking" in organizational and interpersonal settings may help prevent ethical compromise. Managers and individuals should be cautious about framing social and moral decisions in terms of efficiency, costs and benefits.

"A calculative mindset can be useful when people need to weigh costs and benefits, but our findings suggest that applying this way of thinking too broadly may also make it easier to psychologically disengage from moral concerns. This highlights the importance of preserving moral and relational considerations when decisions involve potential personal gains," said corresponding author Mingzheng Wu, Ph.D., of Zhejiang University.

Why prioritize personal gain over principles? The relationship between calculative mindset, moral disengagement, and ethical compromise, PsyCh Journal (2026). DOI: 10.1002/pchj.70120

body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 在《心理学杂志》的新研究中，倾向于将经验分析为数学成本效益问题的人更有可能忽视道德规则。这种倾向与更愿意为了金钱或地位而做出道德妥协，以及在对他们有利时接受不道德的帮助有关。 研究结果来自三项研究（两项基于问卷调查和一项实验），涉及的对象大多是年轻人、受过高等教育且主要是中国成年人。 结果表明，减少组织和人际环境中的这种“算计思维”可能有助于防止道德妥协。管理者和个人在根据效率、成本和收益制定社会和道德决策时应保持谨慎。 “当人们需要权衡成本和收益时，计算思维可能会很有用，但我们的研究结果表明，过于广泛地应用这种思维方式也可能让人更容易在心理上摆脱道德担忧。这凸显了在决策涉及潜在个人利益时保留道德和关系考虑的重要性，”浙江大学的通讯作者吴明正博士说。 为什么要优先考虑个人利益而不是原则？精于算计的心态、道德脱离和道德妥协之间的关系，PsyCh Journal (2026)。 DOI：10.1002/pchj.70120 英语硕士，自 2021 年起担任文案编辑，拥有高等教育和健康内容方面的经验。致力于值得信赖的科学新闻。完整档案 → 数学生物学学士学位，创意写作硕士学位。游历广泛，对科学和语言有独特的观点。完整档案 →

The prophet Micah reminds us that true wisdom lies not in maximizing personal gain, but in 'doing justice, and loving kindness, and walking humbly with your God.' May we seek to balance our analytical minds with a...
reflection.zh: 这项研究揭示了一个令人担忧的趋势：当我们把生活简化为一系列的计算时，道德考量的分量就会减轻。先知弥迦提醒我们，真正的智慧不在于最大化个人利益，而在于“施行公义，喜爱怜悯，谦卑地与你的雅伟同行。”愿我们寻求用公义和怜悯的心来平衡我们的分析能力。

title.en: Drinking very hot drinks could triple risk of oesophageal cancer, study finds
title.zh: 饮用过热饮料或使食道癌风险加倍

summary.en: A new study suggests that consuming very hot beverages, such as tea and coffee, can triple the risk of developing esophageal cancer. Researchers advise allowing hot drinks to cool to a comfortable temperature before consumption to mitigate this risk.

body.en: Research finds temperature and amount of hot drinks consumed heightens possibility of developing disease Drinking very hot tea and coffee triples the risk of developing cancer of the gullet, the world’s largest study of the link between them has found. The findings show that people should let very hot cups of tea and coffee cool down until they are comfortable to drink, in order to reduce their risk of the disease, cancer experts said. Continue reading...
body.zh: 研究发现，喝热饮的温度和量会增加患疾病的可能性 世界上最大的关于两者之间联系的研究发现，喝很热的茶和咖啡会使患食道癌的风险增加三倍。癌症专家表示，研究结果表明，人们应该让很热的茶和咖啡冷却下来，直到可以舒服地饮用为止，以降低患这种疾病的风险。继续阅读...

As we navigate our routines, let us be mindful of practices that may harm us and seek wisdom in caring for the bodies Yahweh has given us.
reflection.zh: 这项研究揭示了一种与日常习惯相关的实际风险。它提醒我们，即使是看似微小的选择也可能对健康产生重大影响。在我们日常生活中，让我们留意那些可能伤害我们的行为，并在照顾雅伟所赐予的身体方面寻求智慧。
