title.en: Beavers 'could boost wildlife and tackle drought'
title.zh: 海狸“可促进野生动植物并应对干旱”

summary.en: Gloucestershire Wildlife Trust is looking for suitable areas to reintroduce the animals, which supporters say could help landscapes become more resilient to drought and climate change.
summary.zh: 格洛斯特郡野生动物信托基金正在寻找适合重新引入海狸的区域，支持者认为这有助于使景观更能抵御干旱和气候变化。

body.en:
Supporters of a plan to reintroduce beavers to a county say they could help landscapes become more resilient to drought and climate change.

Gloucestershire Wildlife Trust and Forestry England are surveying different parts of the county to assess their suitability for a new reintroduction programme.

"Beavers are a keystone species" said Emily Bowen of the Beaver Trust. "They are ecosystem engineers, which means that they can have a massive impact on the landscape around them."

The Department for Environment, Food and Rural Affairs (Defra), which would have to approve the measure, said it could make a "huge difference to nature recovery".

"By changing the land to suit their needs, they can change it in such a way that boosts biodiversity and increases resilience in terms of climate change," Bowen added.

As semi-aquatic mammals, beavers are known for building dams that create ponds and wetlands.

Even small streams can feed a substantial wetland habitat that will then support an abundant array of biodiversity.

Beavers are a native species, but have not been a regular sight in the west of England for around 400 years, after hunting for food and medical ingredients forced their numbers to dramatically decline.

A Defra spokesperson said: "Reintroducing beavers has the potential to make a huge difference to nature recovery, and we are proud to champion this work.

"We will continue to support our partners and ensure that the return of beavers benefits both wildlife and communities."

Beavers have already been living at Greathough Brook in the Forest of Dean since 2018 and regular surveys have revealed a dramatic increase in biodiversity.

"I've seen stoats, I've seen weasels, I've even seen pine martens," said Kate Wollen, from Forestry England.

"The beavers have created this amazing habitat that has brought in all the insects that are at the bottom of the food chain and then it brings in all the other animals that then feed on them, it's just a whole wonderful network of habitats."

A new re-introduction programme in the Severn Vale area would require a government licence.

Studies are being carried out to find suitable locations and a consultation is underway with landowners and users who might be affected by the change in the landscape.

"We have to make sure that we are working really closely with people who live, work and manage the areas that we're thinking about putting beavers," said Mega Adamou, of Gloucestershire Wildlife Trust.

"We'll be seeing a little bit more resilience to drought in those areas where the beavers might end up living."

"It's been really interesting to see how the general public have taken to beavers and getting people thinking about seeing them back in our countryside."

There have been three licensed releases of...
body.zh: 将海狸重新引入一个县的计划的支持者表示，这可以帮助当地的景观变得更能抵御干旱和气候变化。 格洛斯特郡野生动物信托基金和英格兰林业局正在对该县的不同地区进行调查，以评估其是否适合新的重新引入计划。 “海狸是一个关键物种”，海狸信托基金的艾米丽·鲍文 (Emily Bowen) 说道。 “他们是生态系统工程师，这意味着他们可以对周围的景观产生巨大影响。” 环境、食品和农村事务部（Defra）必须批准这项措施，并表示这可能对“自然恢复产生巨大影响”。 鲍文补充道：“通过改变土地以满足他们的需求，他们可以以促进生物多样性和增强气候变化抵御能力的方式改变土地。” 作为半水生哺乳动物，海狸以建造水坝、形成池塘和湿地而闻名。 即使是小溪流也可以滋养大量的湿地栖息地，从而支持丰富的生物多样性。 海狸是本地物种，但在大约 400 年来，在英格兰西部不再常见，因为对食物和药用成分的捕猎迫使它们的数量急剧下降。 Defra 发言人表示：“重新引入海狸有可能对自然恢复产生巨大影响，我们很自豪能够支持这项工作。 “我们将继续支持我们的合作伙伴，并确保海狸的回归使野生动物和社区受益。” 自 2018 年以来，海狸就生活在迪恩森林的格雷特霍夫溪，定期调查显示生物多样性急剧增加。 “我见过白鼬，见过黄鼠狼，甚至见过松貂，”英国林业局的凯特·沃伦说。 “海狸创造了这个令人惊叹的栖息地，它引入了食物链底部的所有昆虫，然后又引入了以它们为食的所有其他动物，这是一个美妙的栖息地网络。” 塞文谷地区新的重新引入计划需要政府许可。 目前正在开展研究以寻找合适的地点，并正在与可能受到景观变化影响的土地所有者和使用者进行协商。 格洛斯特郡野生动物信托基金会的梅加·阿达穆 (Mega Adamou) 表示：“我们必须确保我们与生活、工作和管理我们考虑放海狸的地区的人们真正密切合作。” “我们将看到海狸最终生活的地区对干旱的恢复能力更强。” “看到公众如何喜欢海狸并让人们考虑回到我们的乡村看到它们真的很有趣。” 已经有三个许可版本...

reflection.en: The reintroduction of beavers in Gloucestershire is a hopeful sign of ecological restoration. These 'ecosystem engineers' have the potential to heal damaged landscapes, reminding us of the inherent goodness and resilience of Yahweh's creation when given a chance to flourish.
reflection.zh: 在格洛斯特郡重新引入海狸是生态恢复的希望迹象。这些“生态系统工程师”有潜力治愈受损的景观，提醒我们当雅伟的创造物有机会繁荣时，其固有的良善和韧性。

verse.textEn: God saw all that he had made, and it was very good.
verse.textZh: 神看着一切所造的都甚好。

title.en: Douglas Head designated a Conservation Area
title.zh: 道格拉斯角被指定为保护区

summary.en: Douglas Head has been formally designated a Conservation Area by the Manx government, recognizing its significant historical, architectural, and cultural importance. This designation, supported by 92% of the public in a recent consultation, restricts property alterations without planning permission to preserve the...
summary.zh: 道格拉斯角已被马恩岛政府正式指定为保护区，以表彰其重要的历史、建筑和文化意义。这项指定在最近的公众咨询中获得了92%的支持，限制了未经规划许可对房产进行的改动，以保护该地区的特色。

body.en:
Douglas Head has been formally designated a Conservation Area by the Manx government.

Douglas City Council said it "welcomed" the move, recognising the headland's "significant historical, architectural and cultural importance".

It follows years of campaigning by local historians and two public consultations, the most recent of which found 92% support for the move.

While the designation does not prevent all development on the headland, it does restrict the kind of changes owners to property within the boundary can make without first obtaining planning permission.

Applications consider whether any alterations would preserve or enhance the area's character.

The Isle of Man's Area Plan says applications within the boundary "will generally not be supported."

Douglas Head already has eight registered buildings, more than almost anywhere else on the island outside of central Douglas.

They include the Great Union Camera Obscura (1892), Douglas Lighthouse, the Harbour Swing Bridge Tower and its original 1895 machinery, and Harold Tower.

Read more stories from the Isle of Man on the BBC, watch BBC North West Tonight on BBC iPlayer and follow BBC Isle of Man on Facebook , external and X , external .
body.zh: 道格拉斯角已被马恩岛政府正式指定为保护区。 道格拉斯市议会表示“欢迎”此举，并认识到该岬角“具有重要的历史、建筑和文化重要性”。 此前，当地历史学家进行了多年的竞选活动并进行了两次公众咨询，最近一次咨询的支持率高达 92%。 虽然这一指定并不妨碍岬角上的所有开发，但它确实限制了边界内财产所有者在未事先获得规划许可的情况下可以进行的变更。 申请会考虑任何改变是否会保留或增强该地区的特色。 马恩岛地区规划表示，边界内的申请“通常不会得到支持”。 道格拉斯角已经拥有八座注册建筑，几乎比道格拉斯中部以外的岛上其他任何地方都多。 其中包括大联合暗箱 (1892 年)、道格拉斯灯塔、海港平转桥塔及其 1895 年原始机械装置以及哈罗德塔。 在 BBC 上阅读更多来自马恩岛的故事，在 BBC iPlayer 上观看 BBC 西北今晚节目，并在 Facebook、external 和 X, external 上关注 BBC Isle of Man。

reflection.en: The formal designation of Douglas Head as a Conservation Area highlights a community's decision to protect a place of historical and cultural value. It echoes the ancient understanding that all the earth, with its unique landscapes and heritage, ultimately belongs to its Creator, calling for careful stewardship and preservation.
reflection.zh: 道格拉斯角被正式指定为保护区，这体现了社区保护一个具有历史和文化价值之地的决定。它呼应了古老的认识，即全地及其独特的景观和遗产，最终都属于其创造者，这呼吁我们进行审慎的管理和保护。

verse.textEn: The earth is Yahweh's, and everything in it, the world, and all who live in it.
verse.textZh: 地和其中所充满的，世界和住在其间的，都属雅伟。

title.en: 'Adrenaline got us through New Forest wildfire'
title.zh: 新森林野火：消防员称“肾上腺素让我们挺过难关”

summary.en: Firefighters described the New Forest wildfire, which destroyed over 100 hectares of ancient trees and heathland, as 'apocalyptic.' They credited adrenaline and community spirit for helping them manage the blaze that started from a van fire on the A31.
summary.zh: 消防员形容新森林的野火“如同末日”，摧毁了超过100公顷的古树和石楠地。他们将扑灭这场始于A31公路一辆货车起火的火灾归功于肾上腺素和社区精神。

body.en:
"It was almost apocalyptic," recalls retained firefighter Matt O'Hare, as he describes the scene that greeted him at the devastating wildfire in the New Forest.

Fire spread from a blazing van on the A31 on 9 August, destroying ancient oak and beech trees, rare heathland and wildlife across an area of more than 100 hectares .

"As we went through the New Forest, we could see the huge smoke plume and we thought, 'This is big'," he said.

"It was really weird. You had all the cars that had been stopped on the A31 parked up either side, people in the road.

As the wind rapidly swept the flames across the forest, O'Hare and his colleagues went towards the fire.

"At that time, we were going, 'How on earth are we going to stop this?' But we were told where to go by senior officers and you just sort of deal with the area that you are in as best as you can," he said.

A major incident was declared, and fire crews from neighbouring counties and beyond helped tackle the fire.

About 130 firefighters were on the scene of the fire at the peak of the incident, working in heatwave conditions.

Like many retained firefighters, O'Hare has another job that he needed to keep up alongside his firefighting duties.

"I was doing 10-to-12-hour shifts on the A31, then coming home early in the morning and working from 08:00 to 18:00 at my manufacturing job.

Watch manager at Fordingbridge Fire Station Shaun Lincoln, 59, said it was the largest fire he had been to in 21 years as a firefighter.

"It was off the scale, very, very tiring. I think adrenaline keeps you going and community spirit," he said.

"We live in the New Forest, it's quite personal to us, we wanted to get there and do our bit."

Lincoln said all the crew had been touched by the gratitude shown by local people, who clapped as they returned from fighting the fire.

"There were hampers, cakes and hydration drinks. It was really, really nice, a little bit of fuel for the guys coming back from a long shift," he said.

"I am really, really proud. Everyone worked their socks off, day in, day out. The guys just didn't stop from day one to the end."

You can follow BBC Hampshire & Isle of Wight on Facebook , external , X (Twitter) , external , or Instagram , external .
body.zh: “这几乎是世界末日，”留任的消防员马特·奥黑尔回忆道，他描述了新森林毁灭性野火中迎接他的场景。 8 月 9 日，A31 公路上一辆着火的面包车起火，烧毁了古老的橡树和山毛榉树、稀有的石南地和野生动物，面积超过 100 公顷。 “当我们穿过新森林时，我们可以看到巨大的烟雾，我们想，‘这很大’，”他说。 “这真的很奇怪。A31 公路上停的所有汽车都停在两边，路上还有人。 当风迅速席卷森林时，奥黑尔和他的同事们走向了火场。 “当时，我们想，‘我们到底要如何阻止这一切？’但高级官员告诉我们该去哪里，而你只是尽可能地处理你所在的区域，”他说。 宣布发生重大事故，来自邻近县及其他地区的消防人员帮助扑灭火灾。 事故最严重时，约有 130 名消防员在火灾现场，在热浪条件下工作。 与许多留任的消防员一样，奥黑尔在履行消防职责的同时还需要从事另一项工作。 “我在 A31 上进行 10 到 12 小时的轮班，然后一大早就回家，从 08:00 到 18:00 从事我的制造工作。 59 岁的福丁布里奇消防局值班经理肖恩·林肯 (Shaun Lincoln) 表示，这是他作为消防员 21 年来经历过的最大火灾。 “这超出了规模，非常非常累。我认为肾上腺素可以让你保持前进和社区精神，”他说。 “我们住在新森林，这对我们来说非常个人化，我们想到达那里并尽自己的一份力量。” 林肯说，所有船员都被当地人表现出的感激之情所感动，当他们救火归来时，当地人鼓掌。 “有礼篮、蛋糕和补水饮料。这真的非常非常好，为那些从长时间轮班回来的人提供了一点燃料，”他说。 “我真的非常非常自豪。每个人都日复一日地努力工作。这些人从第一天到最后都没有停下来。” 您可以在 Facebook、external、X (Twitter)、external 或 Instagram、external 上关注 BBC Hampshire & Isle of Wight。

reflection.en: The wildfire in the New Forest sounds like an overwhelming and terrifying event, pushing the firefighters to their limits. Yet, even in the face of such destruction, they found the strength to continue. This reminds us that even when we feel utterly spent, Yahweh promises to renew our strength, allowing us to soar like eagles, ready to face whatever...
reflection.zh: 新森林的野火听起来是一场压倒性的、可怕的事件，将消防员推向了极限。然而，即使面对如此的破坏，他们也找到了继续前进的力量。这提醒我们，即使在我们感到筋疲力尽时，雅伟也应许要使我们重新得力，使我们能如鹰展翅，准备好面对前方的任何挑战。

verse.textEn: Those who hope in Yahweh will renew their strength. They will soar on wings like eagles; they will run and not grow weary.
verse.textZh: 但那等候雅伟的，必从新得力。他们必如鹰展翅上腾。

title.en: Backshall backs calls for natural history GCSE
title.zh: Backshall 支持将自然历史列为 GCSE 课程的呼吁

summary.en: Naturalist Steve Backshall and Sir Tim Smit are advocating for nature education to be central to school curricula, proposing a new GCSE in natural history. This initiative comes amid survey data indicating that 55% of children have never climbed a tree, highlighting a disconnect from the natural world.
summary.zh: 博物学家史蒂夫·巴克肖尔和蒂姆·史密斯爵士呼吁将自然教育置于学校课程的核心，并提议开设新的自然历史 GCSE 课程。此前的一项调查显示，55% 的儿童从未爬过树，这凸显了与自然世界的脱节。

body.en:
Naturalist Steve Backshall and Lost Gardens of Heligan co-founder Sir Tim Smit have called for more "greenlightenment" to put nature education at the heart of school curriculums.

It comes as the government has been consulting on a new natural history GCSE , which Sir Tim said was a "seismic moment for British education", adding "a deep understanding of the natural world is fundamental to humanity's future".

Backshall, who hosted the Wild Heligan experience to excite young people about wildlife, said: "I see every day how nature revitalises, restores and fills people with joy."

A survey by Heligan of 1,004 parent and child groups across England found 55% of children had never climbed a tree.

Backshall said: "We can get so much from the wild world, but now more than ever the wild world needs us.

"Young people who are engaged with nature will be happier, healthier and more likely to take on our planet's problems."

Sir Tim said: "It is our responsibility to equip the next generation with the tools to protect nature so it doesn't become history."

He added children had not lost their interest in nature but had lost opportunities to experience it.

The survey found "ordinary contact with nature" was unfamiliar to many children and 61% of children had never collected a conker or camped in a tent.

The research also found 34% of children they asked said they would definitely choose the proposed natural history GCSE if their school offered it, with another 41% saying they probably would.

The government said, if brought in, the GCSE would "ensure that children are equipped with the highly sought after skills for the workforce of a changing world" and could help reduce the number of number of young people not in education, employment or training.

Follow BBC Cornwall on X , external , Facebook , external and Instagram , external . Send your story ideas to spotlight@bbc.co.uk , external .
body.zh: 博物学家史蒂夫·巴克歇尔和黑里根失落花园联合创始人蒂姆·斯密特爵士呼吁更多的“绿灯”，将自然教育置于学校课程的核心。 与此同时，政府正在就新的自然历史GCSE进行咨询，蒂姆爵士表示这是“英国教育的一个地震时刻”，并补充说“对自然世界的深刻理解是人类未来的基础”。 巴克歇尔主持了野生黑里根体验活动，旨在激发年轻人对野生动物的兴趣，他说：“我每天都看到大自然如何焕发活力、恢复活力，让人们充满欢乐。” Heligan 对英格兰 1,004 个家长和儿童团体进行的一项调查发现，55% 的儿童从未爬过树。 巴克歇尔说：“我们可以从野生世界得到很多东西，但现在野生世界比以往任何时候都更需要我们。 “接触大自然的年轻人会更快乐、更健康，更有可能承担我们星球的问题。” 蒂姆爵士说：“我们有责任为下一代配备保护自然的工具，以免它成为历史。” 他补充说，孩子们并没有失去对大自然的兴趣，但失去了体验大自然的机会。 调查发现，“与大自然的普通接触”对许多孩子来说并不熟悉，61%的孩子从未收集过七叶树果树或在帐篷里露营过。 研究还发现，34% 的受访儿童表示，如果学校提供自然历史 GCSE 课程，他们肯定会选择，另有 41% 的儿童表示可能会选择。 政府表示，如果引入GCSE，将“确保儿童具备在不断变化的世界中劳动力市场备受追捧的技能”，并有助于减少未接受教育、就业或培训的年轻人数量。 在 X, external、Facebook, external 和 Instagram, external 上关注 BBC Cornwall。将您的故事创意发送至外部聚光灯@bbc.co.uk。

reflection.en: The call for a natural history GCSE reflects a deep concern for how we are 'forming the young.' When a significant majority of children haven't experienced something as fundamental as climbing a tree, it signals a need to intentionally re-engage them with the natural world. This education is not just about facts, but about fostering a sense of wonder and...
reflection.zh: 呼吁开设自然历史 GCSE 课程，反映了对我们如何“塑造年轻人”的深切担忧。当绝大多数儿童从未体验过爬树这样基本的事情时，这表明需要有意识地让他们重新接触自然世界。这种教育不仅仅是关于事实，更是关于培养一种惊奇感和联系感，从而塑造他们未来对造物的理解和关怀。

verse.textEn: Start children off on the way they should go, and even when they are old they will not turn from it.
verse.textZh: 教养孩童，使他走当行的道，就是到老他也不偏离。

title.en: Babies born to anaemic mothers have smaller brains, study finds
title.zh: 研究发现贫血母亲所生婴儿大脑较小

summary.en: A study has found that babies born to mothers with anemia have smaller brains, especially in key regions associated with movement, learning, and emotional regulation. These differences, detectable from one year of age, could potentially lead to cognitive issues when the children start school.
summary.zh: 一项研究发现，患有贫血症的母亲所生的婴儿大脑较小，尤其是在与运动、学习和情绪调节相关的关键区域。这些差异从一岁起即可检测到，并可能导致孩子入学时出现认知问题。

body.en: Key regions of the brain linked to movement, learning and emotions were affected and may lead to cognitive problems Babies born to mothers with anaemia have smaller brains, particularly in key regions linked to movement, learning and the regulation of emotion, according to a study. Researchers said the differences, first detected at the age of one, could lead to cognitive problems when children started school. Continue reading...
body.zh: 一项研究表明，与运动、学习和情绪相关的大脑关键区域受到影响，并可能导致认知问题患有贫血的母亲所生的婴儿的大脑较小，特别是与运动、学习和情绪调节相关的关键区域。研究人员表示，这些差异在一岁时首次发现，可能会导致孩子们开始上学时出现认知问题。继续阅读...

reflection.en: This study reveals a profound connection between maternal health and infant development, showing how anemia can affect crucial brain regions. It calls us to consider the unseen vulnerabilities of the most defenseless among us and to advocate for their well-being before birth.
reflection.zh: 这项研究揭示了母体健康与婴儿发育之间深刻的联系，表明贫血症会影响大脑的关键区域。它呼吁我们关注最弱小者身上看不见的脆弱之处，并在他们出生前就为他们的福祉发声。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: GPS collars reveal secrets of the power struggle between lions and hyenas in the wild
title.zh: GPS项圈揭示野外狮子与鬣狗权力斗争的秘密

summary.en: New research using GPS collars to track individual lions and hyenas has overturned the assumption that hyenas merely follow lions for scraps. The findings show that lions, particularly males, are the ones that approach hyenas, and hyenas tend to yield when encounters occur.
summary.zh: 一项使用GPS项圈追踪个体狮子和鬣狗的新研究，颠覆了鬣狗仅仅跟随狮子寻找残羹剩饭的假设。研究结果表明，狮子，尤其是雄狮，是主动接近鬣狗的一方，而鬣狗在遭遇时往往会退让。

body.en: Hidden deep in the bush, ranging over huge territories at speeds humans can't match and through terrain not even the most rugged vehicle can handle, hyenas and lions are hard to study. Now, new research using GPS collars to map the movements of individual animals has revealed crucial information about the relationship between these competing carnivore species. We've long assumed that hyenas simply shadow lions for scraps, but these findings show that when they encounter each other, it's the lions, especially males, that approach hyenas, and the hyenas that give way.
body.zh: 鬣狗和狮子隐藏在灌木丛深处，以人类无法比拟的速度跨越广阔的领土，并且穿过即使是最坚固的车辆也无法应对的地形，因此很难研究它们。现在，利用 GPS 项圈绘制个体动物运动地图的新研究揭示了有关这些竞争性食肉动物物种之间关系的重要信息。长期以来，我们一直认为鬣狗只是尾随狮子寻找残羹剩饭，但这些发现表明，当它们相遇时，狮子，尤其是雄性，会接近鬣狗，而鬣狗就会让路。

reflection.en: In the wild, dominance isn't always about passive scavenging. This research shows lions actively asserting their position over hyenas, demonstrating a dynamic of power and yielding. It reminds us that true strength can be found not just in aggression, but in the ability to command respect and set boundaries, overcoming any impulse to merely react.
reflection.zh: 在野外，统治地位并非总是被动地乞食。这项研究表明，狮子会主动向鬣狗展示其地位，这是一种力量和退让的动态。它提醒我们，真正的力量不仅在于攻击性，还在于赢得尊重和设定界限的能力，从而克服仅仅被动反应的冲动。

verse.textEn: Do not be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.
verse.textZh: 你不可为恶所胜，反要以善胜恶。

title.en: Grooming-related messages reach almost two-thirds of children
title.zh: 近三分之二的儿童收到与诱骗相关的网络信息

summary.en: A recent study found that nearly two-thirds of Australian children aged 10-17 surveyed reported receiving some form of grooming-related communication from strangers online in the past year. Additionally, almost one-third of these children reported direct requests for sexual information or interactions.
summary.zh: 一项最新研究发现，在接受调查的澳大利亚10至17岁的儿童中，近三分之二的儿童在过去一年中曾收到陌生人通过网络发送的某种形式的诱骗相关信息。此外，近三分之一的儿童报告称收到了直接索要性信息或进行性互动的要求。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

Nearly two-thirds of Australian children surveyed in a recent study received at least one form of grooming-related communication from a stranger online in the past year, while almost one-third reported receiving direct requests for sexual information or interactions.

The study, led by Adelaide University, involved an online survey of roughly 300 Australian children ages 10 to 17. It was designed to broadly reflect the demographic characteristics of the Australian population and provide a snapshot of children's online experiences rather than nationally representative estimates.

Published in Child Abuse & Neglect , the research was undertaken by Adelaide University in collaboration with researchers from eSafety, the Australian Institute of Criminology and Michigan State University.

"The most common experiences involved communication related to trust-building, personal questions and risk-assessment behaviors, such as strangers discussing common interests and asking about a child's life, relationships or online activities," said lead researcher Dr. Katie Logos from Adelaide University's School of Society and Culture.

"More explicit solicitation-related communication, such as directly requesting sexual information, conversations or images, was less common but still experienced by a substantial number of children, with around one in five children being asked by someone they only knew online to send photos or videos of themselves or to meet up in person."

Many children reported feeling indifferent about these interactions, often believed they were communicating with another child rather than an adult, and commonly responded by doing nothing or restricting the communicator from contacting them.

"This suggests some grooming behaviors may blend into ordinary online conversations and might be difficult to recognize," Logos said.

"While some of the interactions may genuinely have involved other young people, children often cannot verify who is behind an account, highlighting concerns about adults posing as children to gain trust."

Another key finding was that children who used common online safety measures, such as privacy settings, parental guidance or age-appropriate platforms, were just as likely to report receiving grooming-related communication as those who did not.

"This does not mean these safety measures are ineffective. It is possible that some children adopted stronger safety practices after experiencing these interactions," said researcher Professor Russell Brewer, from Adelaide University's School of Society and Culture and director of the Australian Cybercrime...
body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 在最近的一项研究中，近三分之二的澳大利亚儿童在过去一年中从网上的陌生人那里至少收到过一种形式的与仪容仪表相关的交流，而近三分之一的儿童表示收到过有关性信息或性互动的直接请求。 这项研究由阿德莱德大学牵头，对大约 300 名 10 至 17 岁的澳大利亚儿童进行了在线调查。该研究旨在广泛反映澳大利亚人口的人口特征，并提供儿童在线体验的概况，而不是全国代表性的估计。 该研究发表在《儿童虐待与忽视》杂志上，由阿德莱德大学与 eSafety、澳大利亚犯罪学研究所和密歇根州立大学的研究人员合作进行。 “最常见的经历涉及与建立信任、个人问题和风险评估行为相关的沟通，例如陌生人讨论共同兴趣并询问孩子的生活、人际关系或在线活动，”阿德莱德大学社会与文化学院的首席研究员凯蒂·洛格斯博士说。 “与直接索要性信息、对话或图像等更明确的引诱相关的交流不太常见，但仍有相当多的儿童经历过，大约五分之一的儿童被他们只在网上认识的人要求发送自己的照片或视频或亲自见面。” 许多孩子表示对这些互动感到漠不关心，常常认为自己是在与另一个孩子而不是成人交流，并且通常的反应是不采取任何行动或限制交流者与他们联系。 洛格斯说：“这表明一些梳理行为可能会融入普通的在线对话中，并且可能难以识别。” “虽然有些互动可能确实涉及其他年轻人，但孩子们往往无法核实账户背后的人是谁，这突显了成年人冒充儿童以获得信任的担忧。” 另一个重要发现是，使用常见在线安全措施（例如隐私设置、家长指导或适合年龄的平台）的儿童与不使用此类措施的儿童一样有可能收到与诱骗相关的通信。 阿德莱德大学社会与文化学院研究员、澳大利亚网络犯罪研究中心主任拉塞尔·布鲁尔教授表示：“这并不意味着这些安全措施无效。一些孩子在经历这些互动后可能采取了更严格的安全措施。”

reflection.en: This study reveals a disturbing reality: a significant majority of young people are encountering predatory communication online. It is a stark reminder of our collective responsibility to protect the vulnerable and speak up for those who cannot protect themselves. We must advocate for safer digital spaces and support children navigating these complex...
reflection.zh: 这项研究揭示了一个令人不安的现实：绝大多数年轻人都在网上遭遇掠夺性的沟通。这有力地提醒我们，保护弱者、为那些无法保护自己的人发声是我们共同的责任。我们必须倡导更安全的数字空间，并支持那些在这些复杂挑战中摸索前行的孩子们。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: Chesapeake Bay underwater grasses increase 7%, buoyed by gains in salty waters
title.zh: 切萨皮克湾水下草地增加7%，咸水区增幅明显

summary.en: Submerged aquatic vegetation (SAV), a key indicator of Chesapeake Bay's ecosystem health, saw a 7% increase in 2025, reaching 89,385 acres. This marks the highest acreage recorded since 2018, with significant gains observed in saltier waters, according to researchers at William & Mary's VIMS & Batten School.
summary.zh: 根据威廉玛丽学院VIMS和巴滕学院的研究人员称，作为切萨皮克湾生态系统健康的关键指标——水下植被（SAV）在2025年增加了7%，达到89,385英亩。这是自2018年以来记录到的最高湾区面积，尤其在咸水区域增幅显著。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

Submerged aquatic vegetation (SAV), one of the Chesapeake Bay's most important indicators of ecosystem health, increased by 7% in 2025, according to researchers at William & Mary's VIMS & Batten School.

The annual Baywide aerial survey reported a total of 89,385 acres (140 square miles) of underwater grasses in the Chesapeake Bay and its tidal tributaries, an increase of 6,134 acres (9.6 square miles) from 2024. The results represent the highest Baywide acreage recorded since 2018. The total is just shy of the Chesapeake Bay Watershed Agreement's 2030 interim goal of 90,000 acres (141 square miles) and represents approximately 45% of the 196,600-acre (307-square-mile) long-term goal.

The results highlight the substantial progress made since underwater grass coverage reached historic lows in the 1980s and the challenges that remain to fully restore one of the Bay's most valuable habitats.

"This year's survey demonstrates both that we're moving in the right direction and that there is a lot of complexity in Chesapeake Bay underwater grass communities," said Christopher J. Patrick, associate professor and director of the SAV Program at VIMS & the Batten School of Coastal & Marine Sciences.

"We continue to see strong recovery in the main basin, particularly the saltier portions of the Bay, with some setbacks experienced in localized freshwater areas. The mainstem recoveries are particularly encouraging, as they are indicative of watershed-level management yielding positive outcomes."

Much of the Baywide increase was driven by the continued expansion of underwater grass beds in higher-salinity waters. The Polyhaline Zone, which includes the Bay's saltiest waters near its mouth, increased from 25,266 acres (39 square miles) in 2024 to an estimated 28,142 acres (44 square miles) in 2025, setting a new record for the second consecutive year. The moderately salty Mesohaline Zone expanded nearly 15%, from 33,033 acres (52 square miles) in 2024 to an estimated 37,879 acres (59 square miles) in 2025.

Researchers attribute much of that growth, and the record-setting expansion of eelgrass, to sustained year-over-year increases in water clarity in the lower Bay. Recent work has demonstrated consistent improvements in water quality throughout the entire Chesapeake Bay mainstem over the past several years.

The concurrent expansion of eelgrass meadows, both in size and into deeper waters, is consistent with those improvements. Similar processes are likely also driving the expansion of widgeon grass in the middle portion of the Bay, which is still recovering from a crash due to...
body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 据 William & Mary 的 VIMS & Batten 学校的研究人员称，作为切萨皮克湾生态系统健康最重要指标之一的水下植被 (SAV) 到 2025 年将增加 7%。 年度 Baywide 航空调查报告称，切萨皮克湾及其潮汐支流的水下草丛面积总计 89,385 英亩（140 平方英里），比 2024 年增加了 6,134 英亩（9.6 平方英里）。结果代表了自 2018 年以来记录的最高 Baywide 面积。总面积仅略低于切萨皮克湾流域协议的 2030 年中期目标90,000 英亩（141 平方英里），约占 196,600 英亩（307 平方英里）长期目标的 45%。 结果突显了自 20 世纪 80 年代水下草覆盖率达到历史低点以来所取得的实质性进展，以及全面恢复海湾最有价值的栖息地之一仍然面临的挑战。 VIMS 和巴顿海岸与海洋科学学院副教授兼 SAV 项目主任 Christopher J. Patrick 表示：“今年的调查表明，我们正在朝着正确的方向前进，而且切萨皮克湾水下草群落也非常复杂。” “我们继续看到主流域的强劲复苏，特别是海湾的盐分较高的部分，但局部淡水地区经历了一些挫折。主干流的恢复尤其令人鼓舞，因为它们表明流域层面的管理取得了积极的成果。” Baywide 的增长很大程度上是由高盐度水域水下草床的持续扩张推动的。多盐区包括湾口附近最咸的水域，面积从 2024 年的 25,266 英亩（39 平方英里）增加到 2025 年的估计面积 28,142 英亩（44 平方英里），连续第二年创下新纪录。中盐中盐区扩大了近 15%，从 2024 年的 33,033 英亩（52 平方英里）扩大到 2025 年的估计面积 37,879 英亩（59 平方英里）。 研究人员将这种增长以及鳗草创纪录的扩张很大程度上归因于下湾海水透明度的持续逐年增加。最近的工作表明，过去几年来整个切萨皮克湾干流的水质持续改善。 鳗草草甸的同时扩张，无论是在面积上还是在更深的水域中，都与这些改进是一致的。类似的过程很可能也推动了海湾中部的威吉恩草的扩张，该地区仍在从由于……造成的崩溃中恢复。

reflection.en: The Chesapeake Bay's underwater grasses are flourishing, a vibrant sign of a recovering ecosystem. This resurgence reminds us of the intricate beauty and resilience Yahweh has woven into the natural world, a testament to His wisdom in creation. May we continue to be stewards of these precious environments, recognizing the profound wonder in every blade of...
reflection.zh: 切萨皮克湾的水下草地正在蓬勃生长，这是生态系统恢复的生动迹象。这次复苏提醒我们雅伟编织在自然界中的复杂之美和韧性，这是他创造智慧的明证。 愿我们继续成为这些宝贵环境的管家，认识到波涛之下每一根草的深邃奇妙。

verse.textEn: How many are your works, Yahweh! In wisdom you made them all; the earth is full of your creatures.
verse.textZh: 雅伟啊，你所造的何其多！都是你用智慧造成的；遍地满了你的丰富。

title.en: A vicarious calibration model enables quantitative applications of Fengyun-3 satellite ocean color data
title.zh: 一种指示校准模型可实现风云三号卫星海洋颜色数据的定量应用

summary.en: Ocean color remote sensing is crucial for tracking global ocean carbon sinks and primary productivity. However, current satellite sensor calibration accuracy is insufficient, and the weak marine signals, which constitute only about 10% of the received signals, lead to significant uncertainties in applications. China's...
summary.zh: 海洋颜色遥感是监测全球海洋碳汇和初级生产力的重要工具。然而，目前的卫星传感器在轨校准精度不足，微弱的海洋信号仅占接收信号的约10%，导致海洋颜色遥感应用存在显著的不确定性。中国装备了MERSI传感器的风云三号D星和F星卫星面临着挑战。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

Ocean color remote sensing is a vital tool for monitoring global ocean carbon sinks and primary productivity. However, the on-orbit calibration accuracy of satellite sensors is insufficient, and weak marine signals account for only approximately 10% of the signals received by satellites, leading to significant uncertainties in ocean color remote-sensing applications.

China's Fengyun-3D (FY-3D) and Fengyun-3F (FY-3F) satellites, both equipped with Medium Resolution Spectral Imager (MERSI) sensors, have faced a persistent "weak signal, strong interference" dilemma in their ocean color observation channels, calling for a dedicated, targeted calibration solution.

Recently, a joint research team led by the National Satellite Meteorological Center in China and the Aerospace Information Research Institute of the Chinese Academy of Sciences developed a vicarious calibration model for the MERSI sensors aboard FY-3D and FY-3F. The model effectively corrected radiometric biases in the ocean color channels of the two satellites, significantly improving the accuracy of retrieved ocean remote-sensing reflectance.

The findings mark a major step forward for Chinese satellite ocean color data, enhancing quantitative application capabilities, and were recently published in Atmospheric and Oceanic Science Letters .

"Limited on-orbit sensor calibration, along with atmospheric interference, has introduced considerable biases in the observation of weak ocean signals, thereby restricting the quantitative application of ocean color remote sensing," explained Professor Chong Shi, corresponding author of the study.

"Our approach leverages high-precision ground-based observations as a reference and integrates radiative transfer simulations with regression analysis to calibrate the ocean color channels. By taking into account the sensors' spectral response characteristics, this method accurately disentangles atmospheric path-radiance contributions and corrects water-leaving radiance. This study is expected to provide more reliable remote-sensing data to support ocean color observation research."

The research team plans to extend the proposed vicarious calibration framework to more complex aquatic environments, such as turbid coastal waters, and conduct time-series analyses to monitor the long-term stability of the calibration coefficients. The study not only establishes a basis for the quantitative use of FY-3 ocean color data but also provides a technical reference for calibrating China's ocean color remote-sensing data.

body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 海洋颜色遥感是监测全球海洋碳汇和初级生产力的重要工具。然而，卫星传感器在轨定标精度不足，海洋信号较弱仅占卫星接收信号的10%左右，导致海洋颜色遥感应用存在较大不确定性。 搭载中分辨率光谱成像仪（MERSI）传感器的中国风云三号D（FY-3D）和风云三号F（FY-3F）卫星的海洋颜色观测通道一直面临“信号弱、干扰强”的困境，需要专门的、有针对性的校准解决方案。 近日，由国家卫星气象中心和中国科学院空天信息研究院牵头的联合研究团队开发了风云三号D和风云三号F上MERSI传感器的替代标定模型。该模型有效校正了两颗卫星海洋颜色通道的辐射偏差，显着提高了反演海洋遥感反射率的精度。 该研究结果标志着中国卫星海洋颜色数据的定量应用能力迈出了重要一步，并于近期发表在《大气与海洋科学快报》上。 该研究通讯作者石崇教授解释说：“有限的在轨传感器校准以及大气干扰，在微弱海洋信号的观测中引入了相当大的偏差，从而限制了海洋颜色遥感的定量应用。” “我们的方法以高精度地面观测为参考，将辐射传输模拟与回归分析相结合，以校准海洋颜色通道。通过考虑传感器的光谱响应特性，该方法准确地解开大气路径辐射的贡献并校正水离开的辐射。这项研究有望为海洋颜色观测研究提供更可靠的遥感数据。” 研究团队计划将所提出的替代校准框架扩展到更复杂的水生环境，例如浑浊的沿海水域，并进行时间序列分析以监测校准系数的长期稳定性。该研究不仅为FY-3海洋颜色数据的定量使用奠定了基础，而且为我国海洋颜色遥感数据的校准提供了技术参考。 倪安等，弱信号海洋颜色的替代校准...

reflection.en: The pursuit of understanding our planet's oceans through advanced technology reflects a deep human drive to explore and comprehend the intricate systems of creation. This scientific endeavor, like all efforts to observe and learn from the natural world, can be seen as a way of discerning the wisdom inherent in Yahweh's handiwork. May this improved data help...
reflection.zh: 通过先进技术探索我们星球的海洋，体现了人类深入了解和认识受造界复杂系统的内在驱动力。这项科学探索，如同所有观察和学习自然界的工作一样，可以看作是辨识雅伟作品中固有的智慧的一种方式。 愿这些改进的数据能帮助我们更好地管理地球上至关重要的海洋生态系统，并认识到一切知识的最终指向造物主。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: Why does Southeast Asia keeps breathing the same haze—and can ASEAN do more to stop it?
title.zh: 东南亚为何持续呼吸着同样的雾霾——东盟能做更多来阻止它吗？

summary.en: Southeast Asia has been trying to tackle haze from forest fires for decades, but the region finds itself breathing it again every few years. This transboundary environmental problem has become a recurrent phenomenon, with recent fires in Indonesia sending smoke across Malaysia, Brunei Darussalam, and other parts of...
summary.zh: 东南亚几十年来一直在努力应对森林火灾造成的雾霾，但每隔几年，该地区就会再次呼吸到雾霾。这种跨界环境问题已成为一种反复出现的现象，最近印度尼西亚的火灾将烟雾吹向马来西亚、文莱达鲁萨兰和其他东南亚地区，导致区域性雾霾警报。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

Southeast Asia has spent decades trying to tackle haze from forest fires. Yet every few years, the region finds itself breathing it again. The transboundary environmental problem has become a recurrent phenomenon in the region.

The latest episode is no exception. Forest and land fires in Indonesia have sent smoke across parts of Malaysia, Brunei Darussalam and other parts of Southeast Asia. On Aug. 26, the ASEAN Specialized Meteorological Center raised the regional haze alert to Level 3 as smoke from hotspots in Kalimantan, the Indonesian territory that makes up the majority of the island of Borneo, spread across borders.

Indonesia bears the primary responsibility for preventing and fighting fires on its territory. But once the smoke crosses national borders, haze becomes more than a domestic environmental problem. Malaysia and Brunei Darussalam have agreed to take this matter to the ASEAN level.

This issue has now become a test of whether ASEAN can help its members manage problems that no country can contain alone.

Transboundary haze is hardly new. Historical records show that smoke from fires in Indonesia has affected neighboring countries since at least the 1970s. The 1997 and 2015 fires were among the region's most severe.

Scientific research points to a combination of human activity and environmental conditions. Land clearing through burning can ignite fires, while drained and degraded peatlands are particularly vulnerable. Once dry, peat can burn underground and produce thick, persistent smoke that is difficult to extinguish.

Weather can make the situation worse. Prolonged dry conditions, including those associated with El Niño, can dry out vegetation and peatlands, allowing fires to spread more easily. In the current crisis, below-normal rainfall and strong dry-season conditions are helping sustain the fires and carry smoke across borders.

This means the haze cannot be solved simply by responding when fires are already burning. Prevention, land management and enforcement matter just as much.

Indonesia is central to the problem because many of the fires generating transboundary smoke occur within its territory, particularly on the islands of Sumatra and Kalimantan. This places the primary responsibility on the Indonesian government to prevent fires, enforce environmental regulations and hold those responsible accountable.

Indonesia already has laws and institutions aimed at preventing forest and land fires. Research also shows that the government has strengthened peatland protection and related institutions since 2016.

body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 东南亚几十年来一直在努力解决森林火灾造成的雾霾问题。然而每隔几年，该地区就会发现自己再次呼吸到这种空气。跨界环境问题已成为该地区反复出现的现象。 最新一集也不例外。印度尼西亚的森林和土地火灾已导致马来西亚、文莱达鲁萨兰国和东南亚其他地区的部分地区冒出浓烟。 8月26日，东盟专业气象中心将区域霾警报提升至3级，原因是来自印度尼西亚领土加里曼丹（占婆罗洲岛大部分面积）的热点地区烟雾蔓延至边境。 印度尼西亚对其领土上的火灾预防和扑救负有首要责任。但一旦烟雾跨越国界，雾霾就不仅仅是一个国内环境问题了。马来西亚和文莱达鲁萨兰国已同意将此事提交至东盟层面。 这个问题现在已经成为考验东盟是否能够帮助其成员国解决任何国家都无法单独遏制的问题。 跨境雾霾并不是什么新鲜事。历史记录显示，至少从 20 世纪 70 年代起，印度尼西亚火灾产生的烟雾就已经影响到了邻国。 1997 年和 2015 年的火灾是该地区最严重的火灾之一。 科学研究指出人类活动和环境条件的结合。通过燃烧清理土地可能会引发火灾，而干涸和退化的泥炭地尤其容易受到伤害。一旦干燥，泥炭就会在地下燃烧并产生难以扑灭的浓浓而持久的烟雾。 天气会使情况变得更糟。长期的干旱条件，包括与厄尔尼诺现象有关的条件，会使植被和泥炭地干燥，使火灾更容易蔓延。在当前的危机中，低于正常水平的降雨量和强烈的旱季条件正在帮助维持火势并将烟雾带过边境。 这意味着仅在火灾已经燃烧时做出反应就无法解决雾霾问题。预防、土地管理和执法同样重要。 印度尼西亚是这一问题的核心，因为许多产生跨境烟雾的火灾发生在其领土内，特别是在苏门答腊岛和加里曼丹岛。这使得印度尼西亚政府负有预防火灾、执行环境法规并追究责任人责任的首要责任。 印度尼西亚已经制定了旨在预防森林和土地火灾的法律和机构。研究还显示，自2016年以来，政府加强了泥炭地保护和相关机构建设。 反复发生的火灾表明......

reflection.en: The persistent haze blanketing Southeast Asia is a stark reminder of our shared responsibility for the environment. Psalm 24:1 declares that the earth and its fullness belong to Yahweh. This truth calls us to be faithful stewards, recognizing that the air we breathe and the lands we inhabit are not ours to exploit but are entrusted to us for care.
reflection.zh: 笼罩东南亚的持续雾霾，鲜明地提醒我们对环境负有共同的责任。《诗篇》24:1宣告：“地和其中所充满的，都属于雅伟。”这一真理呼召我们成为忠实的管家，认识到我们呼吸的空气和居住的土地并非可以任我们剥削，而是托付给我们去照管的。

verse.textEn: The earth is Yahweh's, and everything in it, the world, and all who live in it.

title.en: The trail of clues that suggest our planet might be heating faster than we realised
title.zh: 地球变暖速度可能超乎我们想象的线索踪迹

summary.en: A dispute on social media over this summer's heatwaves has revealed a concerning shift in climate science, suggesting the planet might be warming faster than previously understood.
summary.zh: 今年夏天的热浪引发了一场网络争论，揭示了气候科学领域一个令人担忧的转变，表明地球变暖的速度可能比之前认为的更快。

body.en:
This July, during Britain's record-breaking hot summer, a curious row broke out on X over climate science.

Reform's deputy leader Richard Tice shared a Telegraph article headlined: "Heatwaves caused by fall in pollution." He said cleaner air, rather than carbon dioxide, was behind higher temperatures and claimed the public had been "gaslit".

He was wrong to suggest that carbon dioxide is not the primary driver of global warming. But the science he was distorting is real - and much more interesting than his original claim.

The fossil fuels that we've been burning for more than a century produce two very different kinds of pollution. As is well known, carbon dioxide warms the Earth. But less well-known is sulphur pollution, which forms vast numbers of tiny particles in the air and reflects sunlight back into space, partly counteracting the warming effect of carbon.

Thanks to clean-air policies around the world - like the US's Acid Rain Program in the early 1990s, that reduced gas pollution from power plants - sulphur emissions are falling sharply while carbon dioxide emissions remain near record highs.

Scientists increasingly believe the loss of that cooling effect is slightly speeding up global warming.

The past three years were the three warmest ever recorded, and the Met Office says 2027 is "very likely" to replace 2024 as the warmest year on record.

And away from social media, the argument over Tice's tweet raised an even more interesting - and worrying - question. Is it possible that our planet is actually more sensitive to greenhouse gases than we imagined?

Global temperatures jump around naturally from year to year. El Niño, for example, a natural warming of the Pacific Ocean, can temporarily push them higher. So a run of record hot years does not necessarily mean the underlying rate of global warming has increased.

Reto Knutti and his team at ETH Zurich have tried to strip out the effects of El Niño and other natural fluctuations to reveal the underlying trend.

"It's pretty clear that the rate of warming has accelerated," says Knutti, a professor of climate physics at the Swiss university and a former co-ordinating lead author for the IPCC - the UN-backed body that produces the world's most authoritative assessments of climate science.

A separate study published this year reached a similar conclusion after accounting for several major natural influences.

Burning coal and oil releases sulphur dioxide, which forms tiny particles known as sulphate aerosols. These particles are bright and reflect some sunlight before it can reach and warm the planet's surface.

You've probably heard the greenhouse analogy used to explain global warming. Gases like carbon dioxide make it harder for heat to escape from the Earth, rather like the glass...
body.zh: 今年七月，在英国破纪录的炎热夏季期间，X 网上爆发了一场关于气候科学的奇怪争论。 改革党副领导人理查德·泰斯分享了一篇《每日电讯报》文章，标题为“污染下降引发热浪”。他说，高温背后的原因是更清洁的空气，而不是二氧化碳，并声称公众受到了“煤气灯”的影响。 他错误地认为二氧化碳不是全球变暖的主要驱动因素。但他歪曲的科学是真实的——而且比他最初的主张有趣得多。 我们一个多世纪以来一直燃烧的化石燃料产生了两种截然不同的污染。众所周知，二氧化碳使地球变暖。但不太为人所知的是硫污染，它在空气中形成大量微小颗粒，并将阳光反射回太空，部分抵消了碳的变暖效应。 得益于世界各地的清洁空气政策（例如 20 世纪 90 年代初美国的酸雨计划减少了发电厂的气体污染），硫排放量急剧下降，而二氧化碳排放量仍接近历史最高水平。 科学家们越来越相信，冷却效应的丧失正在略微加速全球变暖。 过去三年是有记录以来最热的三年，英国气象局表示，2027 年“很有可能”取代 2024 年，成为有记录以来最热的一年。 除了社交媒体之外，关于泰斯推文的争论还引发了一个更有趣、也更令人担忧的问题。我们的星球是否有可能实际上对温室气体比我们想象的更敏感？ 全球气温逐年自然跳跃。例如，厄尔尼诺现象（太平洋的自然变暖）可能会暂时推高它们。因此，连续创纪录的炎热年份并不一定意味着全球变暖的潜在速度有所加快。 苏黎世联邦理工学院的雷托·克努蒂（Reto Knutti）和他的团队试图排除厄尔尼诺现象和其他自然波动的影响，以揭示潜在的趋势。 瑞士大学气候物理学教授、IPCC 前协调主要作者克努蒂说：“很明显，变暖的速度正在加快。”IPCC 是联合国支持的机构，负责对气候科学进行世界上最权威的评估。 今年发表的另一项研究在考虑了几个主要的自然影响后得出了类似的结论。 燃烧煤炭和石油会释放二氧化硫，形成称为硫酸盐气溶胶的微小颗粒。这些粒子很明亮，在到达地球表面并使其变暖之前会反射一些阳光。 您可能听说过用来解释全球变暖的温室类比。二氧化碳等气体使热量更难从地球逸出，就像玻璃一样......

reflection.en: The rapid evolution of understanding in climate science, as seen in the debate over heatwave data, reflects the prophecy that 'many shall run to and fro, and knowledge shall increase.' This surge in information calls for discernment, seeking wisdom to understand and respond to the complex challenges facing our planet....
reflection.zh: 许多人往来奔走，知识就增长。气候科学中关于热浪数据的争论，以及对地球变暖速度的新见解，正体现了这一点。这种知识的激增呼唤着分辨力，以及寻求智慧来理解和应对我们星球面临的复杂挑战。

title.en: Scientists discover a powerful new antivenom hidden in rattlesnake blood
title.zh: 科学家在响尾蛇血液中发现强效新抗蛇毒剂

summary.en: Researchers have discovered that combinations of toxin-blocking proteins naturally present in rattlesnake blood can effectively neutralize venom from several dangerous snake species. Laboratory tests showed these mixtures were approximately 10 times more potent than a current commercial antivenom, suggesting a...
summary.zh: 研究人员发现，响尾蛇血液中天然存在的毒素阻断蛋白组合能够有效中和多种危险蛇类的毒液。实验室测试表明，这些混合物的效力约为当前市售抗蛇毒剂的10倍，为治疗蛇咬伤开辟了一条有前景的新途径。

body.en:
University of Maryland researchers have identified a promising new way to treat venomous snakebites by borrowing from snakes' own natural defenses. Their approach uses toxin-blocking proteins that western diamondback rattlesnakes evolved to protect themselves from venom.

By combining specific proteins found in rattlesnake blood, the researchers achieved unusually strong protection against venom from several dangerous snake species.

The study was led by Distinguished University Professor of BiologySean B. Carroll and published in the Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences . The findings could help researchers develop more powerful antivenoms for deadly snakebites, which remain a major health threat in some regions of the world.

"This is one of those great stories when nature has already solved a problem we've been grappling with for decades," said Carroll, who also holds the Andrew and Mary Balo and Nicholas and Susan Simon Endowed Chair at UMD.

Snakebite is considered one of the world's most neglected tropical diseases. According to the World Health Organization, venomous snakes kill an estimated 80,000 to 140,000 people annually, while hundreds of thousands of survivors are left with permanent disabilities. Many of those affected live in rural areas where effective antivenom can be difficult to obtain.

Existing antivenoms save lives, but they also have major drawbacks. They are typically produced by exposing large animals to snake venom and then collecting the antibodies those animals generate. Manufacturing these treatments can be costly, their quality and effectiveness can vary, and they may not work equally well against the many different toxins found in venom from different snake species. They can also cause serious immune reactions.

Those limitations have pushed scientists to search for better options. In this case, the researchers turned to snakes themselves for clues.

"We've known from anecdotes for 100 years that vipers tend to be resistant to their own venom," Carroll said. "But for a long time, nobody knew what exactly was circulating in their blood that protected them."

In 2022, Carroll's laboratory found part of the answer: a protein called FETUA-3. The researchers discovered that it could block the activity of many metalloproteinase toxins found in western diamondback rattlesnake venom. It could also bind to and inhibit toxins from the venoms of several other rattlesnake species.

"Here was evolution's way for snakes to protect themselves from accidental self-envenomation," he said, which prompted a follow-up question. "Why rely on horse antibodies when nature has packaged an effective antidote right there in the snake?"

For the new research, co-authors including Elda Sánchez, director of the National Natural...
body.zh: 马里兰大学的研究人员利用蛇自身的自然防御能力，发现了一种治疗毒蛇咬伤的有前途的新方法。他们的方法使用西方小菜斑响尾蛇进化来的毒素阻断蛋白来保护自己免受毒液的侵害。 通过结合响尾蛇血液中发现的特定蛋白质，研究人员获得了针对几种危险蛇类毒液的异常强大的保护作用。 该研究由杰出大学生物学教授肖恩·B·卡罗尔（Sean B. Carroll）领导，并发表在《美国国家科学院院刊》上。这些发现可以帮助研究人员开发出更强大的抗蛇毒血清来治疗致命的蛇咬伤，蛇咬伤仍然是世界某些地区的主要健康威胁。 “这是一个伟大的故事，大自然已经解决了我们几十年来一直在努力解决的问题，”卡罗尔说，他也是马里兰大学安德鲁和玛丽巴洛以及尼古拉斯和苏珊西蒙捐赠主席。 蛇咬伤被认为是世界上最被忽视的热带疾病之一。据世界卫生组织称，毒蛇每年导致约 80,000 至 140,000 人死亡，数十万幸存者留下永久性残疾。许多受影响者生活在农村地区，那里很难获得有效的抗蛇毒血清。 现有的抗蛇毒血清可以挽救生命，但它们也有重大缺点。它们通常是通过将大型动物暴露于蛇毒中，然后收集这些动物产生的抗体来产生的。制造这些治疗方法可能成本高昂，其质量和效果也各不相同，而且它们对于不同蛇类毒液中发现的多种不同毒素的效果可能不同。它们还会引起严重的免疫反应。 这些限制促使科学家寻找更好的选择。在这种情况下，研究人员转向蛇本身寻找线索。 卡罗尔说：“我们从 100 年来的轶事中得知，毒蛇往往对自己的毒液有抵抗力。” “但很长一段时间，没有人知道他们的血液中到底循环着什么来保护他们。” 2022 年，卡罗尔的实验室找到了部分答案：一种名为 FETUA-3 的蛋白质。研究人员发现，它可以阻止西方小菜斑响尾蛇毒液中发现的许多金属蛋白酶毒素的活性。它还可以结合并抑制其他几种响尾蛇物种的毒液中的毒素。 “这是蛇的进化方式，可以保护自己免受意外的自我毒害，”他说，这引发了一个后续问题。 “当大自然已经在蛇体内包装了有效的解毒剂时，为什么还要依赖马抗体呢？” 对于这项新研究，合著者包括国家自然科学中心主任埃尔达·桑切斯……

reflection.en: The natural world is a testament to Yahweh's intricate design and wisdom. In this case, the very creatures that possess dangerous venom also hold the key to its neutralization within their own biology. This discovery reminds us that by observing and understanding creation, we can uncover profound solutions and appreciate the Creator's ingenuity.
reflection.zh: 大自然是雅伟精妙设计和智慧的明证。在此案例中，拥有剧毒的生物本身也蕴藏着中和毒液的关键。这一发现提醒我们，通过观察和理解受造界，我们可以揭示深刻的解决方案，并欣赏创造者的奇思妙想。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: Your personality may be more genetic than scientists realized
title.zh: 你的个性可能比科学家们意识到的更具遗传性

summary.en: A study has identified over 1,200 genetic variants associated with the Big Five personality traits, suggesting a significant genetic link between personality and various life outcomes such as health, longevity, careers, and income. The research involved an international collaboration analyzing data from 46 cohorts...
summary.zh: 一项研究确定了与“大五”人格特质相关的1200多个基因变异，表明人格与健康、寿命、职业和收入等多种生活结果之间存在显著的遗传联系。该研究涉及一项国际合作，分析了来自全球46个研究队列的数据。

body.en:
An international team of scientists has identified more than 1,200 genetic variants associated with the Big Five personality traits. The findings also suggest that many of the same genetic patterns connected to personality are related to a wide range of life outcomes, including health, longevity, education, careers, and income.

The study, led by the Revived Genomics of Personality Consortium, brought together data from 46 research cohorts around the world. Participants provided DNA samples and completed questionnaires designed to measure the Big Five personality traits: openness to experience, conscientiousness, extraversion, agreeableness and neuroticism.

These traits describe relatively stable patterns in how people tend to think, feel, and behave. Researchers compared participants' genetic data with differences in their personality scores to identify genetic variants associated with each trait.

"There is no single 'personality gene,'" said Ted Schwaba, lead author of this study and faculty at MSU's Department of Psychology. "Personality traits are associated with many genetic variants, but even the largest effects of individual genetic variants are still very small. However, even though any individual genetic variant makes very little difference in personality, the effects of many variants together can be more sizeable."

Although the influence of any one genetic variant was tiny, the researchers found that their combined effects were more substantial and consistent. The genetic patterns also appeared to hold across very different groups of people.

For instance, variants associated with extraversion in a young adult living in the Netherlands could also help predict extraversion in an older retired adult in the United States. By using methods that compared relatives with one another, the team found evidence that these genetic associations could not simply be explained by growing up in the same environment.

Even so, genetics is only part of the picture. The findings also reinforced the important role that a person's environment plays in shaping personality.

The researchers found that genetic variants associated with personality overlap with genetic patterns connected to many other areas of life. These include mental and physical health, longevity, education, career choices and outcomes, as well as the way people are viewed by those close to them.

Some of the links involved everyday habits. Genetic variants associated with conscientiousness were also related to being more active during the daytime. Meanwhile, variants associated with openness to experience and extraversion were connected with a greater tendency to be a night owl.

The results also highlight how genetics and environment can interact with one another rather than operating...
body.zh: 一个国际科学家团队已鉴定出 1,200 多种与“大五人格”特征相关的基因变异。研究结果还表明，许多与性格相关的相同遗传模式与广泛的生活结果相关，包括健康、长寿、教育、职业和收入。 这项研究由复兴人格基因组学联盟 (Revived Genomics of Personality Consortium) 领导，汇集了来自全球 46 个研究队列的数据。参与者提供了 DNA 样本并完成了旨在衡量五大人格特征的调查问卷：开放性、责任心、外向性、宜人性和神经质。 这些特征描述了人们如何思考、感受和行为的相对稳定的模式。研究人员将参与者的遗传数据与他们的性格评分差异进行比较，以确定与每个特征相关的遗传变异。 “不存在单一的‘人格基因’，”这项研究的主要作者、密歇根州立大学心理学系的教员泰德·施瓦巴 (Ted Schwaba) 说。 “人格特征与许多遗传变异有关，但即使单个遗传变异的最大影响仍然很小。然而，即使任何单个遗传变异对人格的影响很小，但许多变异加在一起的影响可能会更大。” 尽管任何一种遗传变异的影响都很微小，但研究人员发现它们的综合影响更为实质性和一致。这些遗传模式似乎也适用于非常不同的人群。 例如，与生活在荷兰的年轻人的外向性相关的变异也可以帮助预测美国老年退休成年人的外向性。通过使用相互比较亲属的方法，研究小组发现证据表明这些遗传关联不能简单地用在同一环境中长大来解释。 即便如此，遗传学只是问题的一部分。研究结果还强调了一个人的环境在塑造人格方面所发挥的重要作用。 研究人员发现，与性格相关的遗传变异与与生活许多其他领域相关的遗传模式重叠。这些因素包括身心健康、寿命、教育、职业选择和结果，以及亲近的人看待人们的方式。 有些链接涉及日常习惯。与责任心相关的基因变异也与白天更加活跃有关。与此同时，与开放经验和外向性相关的变异与夜猫子的更大倾向有关。 结果还强调了遗传和环境如何相互作用而不是操作......

reflection.en: This research reveals a deep genetic connection to our personalities, suggesting that much of who we are is woven into our very being. It echoes the ancient wisdom that creation itself, in its intricate design, speaks of the Creator's profound knowledge and the complex tapestry of human life.
reflection.zh: 这项研究揭示了与我们个性深厚的遗传联系，表明我们很大程度上是被编织进我们自身的存在中的。它呼应了古老的智慧，即创造本身，以其错综复杂的设计，诉说着造物主深邃的知识和人类生命的复杂织锦。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.

title.en: Ozempic and Wegovy may have an unexpected mental health benefit
title.zh: 奥泽平与韦戈维可能带来意想不到的心理健康益处

summary.en: Semaglutide, the active ingredient in Ozempic and Wegovy, has been linked in a large Swedish study to a 21% lower risk of psychiatric hospitalization among nearly 15,000 individuals with bipolar disorder. Researchers hypothesize that its effects on inflammation and biological pathways in the brain may contribute to...
summary.zh: 在奥泽平（Ozempic）和韦戈维（Wegovy）中发现的司美格鲁肽（Semaglutide）成分，在一项对近15,000名双相情感障碍患者的大型瑞典研究中，与精神科住院风险降低21%相关。研究人员推测，其对炎症和大脑生物通路的影响可能有助于稳定情绪，尽管其他GLP-1类药物未显示出相同的关联性。

body.en: Semaglutide, the drug behind Ozempic and Wegovy, may have benefits that extend well beyond weight loss and diabetes. In a large Swedish study of nearly 15,000 people with bipolar disorder, its use was linked to a 21% lower risk of psychiatric hospitalization. Researchers think effects on inflammation and brain-related biological pathways could help stabilize mood, though other GLP-1 drugs did not show the same association.
body.zh: Ozempic 和 Wegovy 背后的药物索马鲁肽的益处可能远远超出减肥和糖尿病的范围。瑞典一项针对近 15,000 名双相情感障碍患者的大型研究显示，使用该药物可将精神病住院风险降低 21%。研究人员认为，对炎症和大脑相关生物通路的影响可能有助于稳定情绪，但其他 GLP-1 药物并未显示出相同的关联。

reflection.en: This news offers a glimmer of hope for individuals navigating the complexities of bipolar disorder. The potential for a medication, primarily known for weight management, to also contribute to mental stability and reduce psychiatric hospitalizations is a significant development. It reminds us that healing can come through unexpected avenues, and that...
reflection.zh: 这一消息为那些应对双相情感障碍复杂性的人们带来了一线希望。一种主要以体重管理而闻名的药物，竟然也能帮助稳定精神状态并减少精神科住院，这是一个重要的进展。它提醒我们，治愈可能来自意想不到的途径，并且持续的研究不断揭示支持心理健康的新方法。

verse.textEn: When they came to Jesus, they saw the man who had been possessed by the legion of demons, sitting there, dressed and in his right mind; and they were afraid.
verse.textZh: 他们来到耶稣那里，看见那被鬼附着的人，就是从前被群鬼所附的，坐着，穿上衣服，心里明白过来，他们就害怕。

title.en: Giant new dinosaur discovered beneath construction site in Brazil
title.zh: 巴西建筑工地发现巨型新恐龙

summary.en: Scientists have identified a giant new dinosaur species in Brazil, named Dasosaurus tocantinensis, which lived approximately 120 million years ago and measured about 20 meters in length. Its fossils were unearthed during construction work, and its evolutionary connection to a Spanish dinosaur suggests ancient land...
summary.zh: 科学家在巴西发现了一种新的巨型恐龙物种，名为“托坎廷斯达氏恐龙”（Dasosaurus tocantinensis），生活在大约1.2亿年前，体长约20米。其化石是在建筑工地施工期间出土的，它与一种西班牙恐龙的进化联系表明，古老的陆桥促进了这些生物跨大陆的传播。

body.en:
A newly identified dinosaur species discovered during construction work in northeastern Brazil is offering fresh clues about how giant dinosaurs spread across ancient continents.

The species, named Dasosaurus tocantinensis , is described in a study published in the Journal of Systematic Palaeontology . The animal measured about 20 meters long and lived roughly 120 million years ago. Its fossils were found at the site of a road rail terminal under construction in Davinópolis, a city in the state of Maranhão.

One of the most striking aspects of the discovery is the dinosaur's evolutionary connection to Europe. Its closest known relative lived in what is now Spain, suggesting that these animals belonged to a broader lineage that once occupied regions that are now separated by the Atlantic Ocean.

Researchers propose that the ancestors of Dasosaurus tocantinensis reached South America by moving through North Africa sometime between 140 and 120 million years ago. At the time, these landmasses were still connected within the supercontinent Gondwana.

"It's the largest known dinosaur for Maranhão, which has other species, but not sauropods like this one; rather, it has smaller ones, such as the diplodocid Amazonsaurus maranhensis , which was about 10 meters long," says Elver Luiz Mayer, a professor at the Federal University of the São Francisco Valley (UNIVASF) in the state of Bahia.

Mayer normally studies mammals from the Quaternary period, which is far more recent than the age of the dinosaur fossils. He became involved with the find in 2021 while working in São Félix do Xingu in the state of Pará, where he was then a professor at the Federal University of Southern and Southeastern Pará (UNIFESSPA)

The fossils had been uncovered by archaeologists who were monitoring the Davinópolis construction project as part of environmental licensing requirements. At first, the remains were thought to belong to large prehistoric mammals that may have lived alongside ancient humans.

"Given its depth of about eight meters, I realized that it was much older. The age of the geological formation was already known from previous research and indicated that it was material from the transition from the Lower to the Upper Cretaceous, about 120 million years ago," says Mayer. He then contacted various specialists and formed a multidisciplinary group to study the specimen.

The fossils went through an extensive preparation process before being analyzed in Pará. Afterward, the specimen was returned to Maranhão. It is now kept in São Luís, the state capital, at the State Center for Natural History and Archaeology Research, which also took part in the research.

The preserved skeleton...
body.zh: 在巴西东北部的建筑工程中发现的一种新发现的恐龙物种为巨型恐龙如何在古代大陆上传播提供了新的线索。 《系统古生物学杂志》上发表的一项研究描述了该物种，名为 Dasosaurus tocantinensis。这种动物身长约 20 米，生活在大约 1.2 亿年前。它的化石是在马拉尼昂州达维诺波利斯市正在建设的公路铁路终点站现场发现的。 这一发现最引人注目的方面之一是恐龙与欧洲的进化联系。它的已知近亲生活在现在的西班牙，这表明这些动物属于一个更广泛的谱系，这个谱系曾经占据了现在被大西洋隔开的地区。 研究人员推测，托坎蒂大索龙的祖先在 140 至 1.2 亿年前的某个时间穿过北非到达南美洲。当时，这些大陆在冈瓦纳超大陆内仍然是相连的。 巴伊亚州圣弗朗西斯科河谷联邦大学 (UNIVASF) 教授埃尔弗·路易斯·梅耶尔 (Elver Luiz Mayer) 表示：“它是马拉尼昂州已知最大的恐龙，马拉尼昂州还有其他物种，但没有像这样的蜥脚类恐龙；相反，它有较小的恐龙，例如梁龙科亚马逊龙 maranhensis，长约 10 米。” 梅耶尔通常研究第四纪时期的哺乳动物，该时期比恐龙化石的时代要晚得多。 2021 年，他在帕拉州圣费利克斯杜辛古 (São Félix do Xingu) 工作时参与了这一发现，当时他是帕拉州南和东南联邦大学 (UNIFESSPA) 的教授 这些化石是由考古学家发现的，他们正在监测达维诺波利斯建设项目，作为环境许可要求的一部分。起初，这些遗骸被认为属于大型史前哺乳动物，它们可能与古人类生活在一起。 “考虑到它的深度约为八米，我意识到它的年龄要大得多。从之前的研究中已经知道了地质构造的年龄，并表明它是大约 1.2 亿年前从下白垩纪到上白垩纪过渡的物质，”梅耶尔说。然后，他联系了多位专家，组建了一个多学科小组来研究该标本。 这些化石在帕拉州进行分析之前经过了广泛的准备过程。随后，标本被送回马拉尼昂州。它现在保存在州首府圣路易斯的国家自然历史和考古研究中心，该中心也参与了这项研究。 保存完好的骨架...

reflection.en: The discovery of Dasosaurus tocantinensis, unearthed by chance during construction, reminds us that the earth holds many secrets, waiting to be revealed through diligent study. Job 12:7-9 speaks of asking the animals and birds, the fish and the earth, for wisdom, for all of them teach us. This new dinosaur, bridging continents through ancient land...
reflection.zh: 在建筑施工中偶然发现的托坎廷斯达氏恐龙，提醒我们大地隐藏着许多秘密，等待着通过勤奋的研究被揭示。约伯记12:7-9说，你可以问走兽，它们会教导你；天空的飞鸟，它们也会告诉你。这些古老陆桥连接的跨大陆恐龙，证明了当我们观察和学习创造时，可以揭示生命的复杂历史。

title.en: Scientists observe Einstein’s gravity in the quantum world for the first time
title.zh: 科学家首次在量子世界中观测到爱因斯坦的引力

summary.en: Physicists have directly observed a long-predicted quantum effect of gravity, confirming a key aspect of Einstein's theory of gravity under quantum conditions. The experiment involved splitting an atom's quantum wave, with one part held stationary and the other falling freely.
summary.zh: 物理学家首次直接观测到了引力的一个长期预测的量子效应，在量子条件下对爱因斯坦引力理论的一个关键方面进行了验证。该实验涉及将一个原子的量子波一分为二，一部分保持静止，另一部分自由下落。

body.en:
An international team that includes Nobel Prize-winning physicist Professor Sir Roger Penrose has directly observed a long-predicted gravitational effect in a falling quantum object for the first time. The finding shows that a central principle of Einstein's theory of gravity continues to agree with quantum behavior under the conditions tested. The research, led by Ben-Gurion University of the Negev, the University of Ulm and the University of Oxford, was published September 2 in Science Advances .

Modern physics rests on two remarkably successful frameworks. Quantum mechanics describes the unusual behavior of atoms and other extremely small objects, while Einstein's theory of gravity explains falling bodies and the large-scale structure of the Universe. Despite their individual success, physicists still do not have a complete theory that brings the two together.

The new experiment explores a region where these two descriptions overlap. Researchers measured a specific change in the quantum properties of atoms as they moved under the influence of gravity. The effect matched the prediction that follows when Einstein's equivalence principle, one of the foundations of his theory of gravity, is extended to a quantum object.

The equivalence principle says that gravity should effectively vanish locally for an observer in free fall. A person falling freely in a lift, for example, would experience weightlessness. The principle has been confirmed with extraordinary precision using ordinary matter, but testing it directly with quantum objects has been much more difficult because quantum objects can behave like waves and can effectively follow more than one path at the same time.

To make such a test possible, the team built an instrument called the Quantum Galileo Interferometer. The device allowed the researchers to split the quantum wave associated with an atom into two separate paths. One part could be kept in place while the other was allowed to fall freely. The two were then brought back together so the researchers could determine how gravity had affected the falling wave.

The experiment was carried out at Ben-Gurion University using clouds of rubidium atoms cooled to temperatures just above absolute zero. The atoms were manipulated near the surface of a specially designed atom chip.

The experimental team, including PhD student Or Dobkowski, began by using microwave pulses to place the ultracold atoms into a quantum superposition. This effectively allowed each atom to follow two paths at once.

Tiny electrical wires built into the chip then generated carefully controlled magnetic fields. One part of the atomic wave interacted with the magnetic field, allowing the researchers to create an upward force that precisely balanced the downward pull of...
body.zh: 包括诺贝尔奖获得者物理学家教授罗杰·彭罗斯爵士在内的国际团队首次直接观察到了下落量子物体中长期预测的引力效应。这一发现表明，爱因斯坦引力理论的核心原理在测试条件下仍然与量子行为一致。这项研究由内盖夫本古里安大学、乌尔姆大学和牛津大学领导，于 9 月 2 日发表在《科学进展》杂志上。 现代物理学依赖于两个非常成功的框架。量子力学描述了原子和其他极小物体的异常行为，而爱因斯坦的引力理论则解释了下落物体和宇宙的大尺度结构。尽管物理学家取得了个人的成功，但他们仍然没有一个完整的理论将两者结合在一起。 新实验探索了这两种描述重叠的区域。研究人员测量了原子在重力影响下移动时量子特性的特定变化。这一效应与爱因斯坦引力理论的基础之一——等效原理扩展到量子物体时所做出的预测相符。 等效原理表明，对于自由落体的观察者来说，重力应该有效地局部消失。例如，一个人在电梯里自由落体时会体验到失重的感觉。这一原理已通过普通物质以极高的精度得到证实，但直接用量子物体对其进行测试要困难得多，因为量子物体的行为可以像波一样，并且可以有效地同时遵循多个路径。 为了使这样的测试成为可能，该团队建造了一种称为量子伽利略干涉仪的仪器。该设备允许研究人员将与原子相关的量子波分成两个独立的路径。一部分可以固定在适当的位置，而另一部分则可以自由落下。然后将两者重新放在一起，以便研究人员能够确定重力如何影响下落的波浪。 该实验是在本古里安大学进行的，使用冷却至略高于绝对零温度的铷原子云。原子在专门设计的原子芯片表面附近被操纵。 包括博士生 Or Dobkowski 在内的实验团队首先使用微波脉冲将超冷原子置于量子叠加态。这有效地允许每个原子同时遵循两条路径。 芯片内置的微小电线会产生精心控制的磁场。原子波的一部分与磁场相互作用，使研究人员能够产生一种向上的力，精确地平衡向下的拉力……

reflection.en: The heavens declare the glory of Yahweh, and the deep things of creation reveal His wisdom. This experiment, observing gravity's quantum effects, is a testament to the intricate order of the universe that scientists continue to uncover. It reminds us that even in the smallest, most complex realms, the Creator's handiwork is evident, inviting awe and further...
reflection.zh: 诸天述说雅伟的荣耀，创造的深奥之处彰显祂的智慧。这项观测引力量子效应的实验，证明了宇宙精妙的秩序，科学家们正不断揭示它。这提醒我们，即使在最小、最复杂的领域，造物主的作为也是显而易见的，引人惊叹并进一步探索。

title.en: How meteorologists recreated weather that helped decide second world war
title.zh: 气象学家如何重现了决定第二次世界大战的天气

summary.en: Meteorologists assisted in recreating weather scenes for the film 'Pressure,' which dramatizes the critical period leading up to the D-day landings in June 1944. The film focuses on the true story of meteorologist Gp Capt James Stagg, who had to advise General Eisenhower on the suitability of weather conditions for...
summary.zh: 气象学家协助重现了电影《压力》中的天气场景，该片描绘了1944年6月诺曼底登陆前夕的关键时期。电影聚焦于气象学家詹姆斯·斯塔格（James Stagg）的真实故事，他必须就天气条件是否适合入侵向艾森豪威尔将军提供建议，而一场迫近的风暴使这一决定变得复杂。

body.en: Experts helped guide weather scenes in Pressure – a film depicting dramatic buildup to 1944’s D-day landings Dressed in a Royal Air Force uniform and sporting a trim moustache, Andrew Scott looks slightly queasy – as well he might. Behind him is a huge map of the Channel, and in front of him is Brendan Fraser, looming with a request: “I need a forecast,” he says. Starring in the film Pressure, based on a true story, Scott plays the meteorologist Gp Capt James Stagg – the man who must tell Gen Eisenhower – played by Fraser – whether conditions will be suitable for the D-day landings scheduled to take place on 5 June 1944. But a large storm is approaching the Normandy coast. Continue reading...
body.zh: 专家们帮助指导了《压力》中的天气场景——这部影片描绘了 1944 年诺曼底登陆的戏剧性场面。安德鲁·斯科特穿着皇家空军制服，留着整齐的小胡子，看起来有点恶心——他可能也有这种感觉。他身后是一张巨大的英吉利海峡地图，面前是布伦丹·弗雷泽 (Brendan Fraser)，他若隐若现地提出请求：“我需要天气预报，”他说。在根据真实故事改编的电影《压力》中，斯科特饰演气象学家詹姆斯·斯塔格上尉，他必须告诉弗雷泽饰演的艾森豪威尔将军，条件是否适合计划于 1944 年 6 月 5 日进行的诺曼底登陆。但是一场大风暴正在逼近诺曼底海岸。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The story of the D-day landings hinges on a critical forecast, a moment where human knowledge met the unpredictable forces of nature. In the face of immense pressure and uncertainty, the need for wisdom was paramount. James 1:5 reminds us that when faced with such weighty decisions, we can ask Yahweh for the discernment needed to navigate complex...
reflection.zh: 诺曼底登陆的故事围绕着一次关键的天气预报展开，那是人类知识与不可预测的自然力量交汇的时刻。面对巨大的压力和不确定性，智慧的需求至关重要。雅各书1:5提醒我们，当面对如此重大的决定时，我们可以向雅伟祈求所需的洞察力，以应对复杂的情况。

verse.textEn: If any of you lacks wisdom, you should ask God, who gives generously to all without finding fault.
verse.textZh: 你们中间若有缺少智慧的，应当求那厚赐与众人、也不斥责人的神，主就必赐给他。

title.en: The American “cheetah” wasn’t a cheetah at all
title.zh: 所谓的“美洲猎豹”根本不是猎豹

summary.en: The extinct 'American cheetah' was not a cheetah but a puma relative with a surprisingly flexible lifestyle. Fossils from the Yukon suggest northern populations survived partly by eating fish, possibly including salmon, while southern cats hunted on land.
summary.zh: 已灭绝的“美洲猎豹”并非猎豹，而是美洲狮的近亲，拥有出人意料的灵活生活方式。来自育空的化石表明，北方种群部分依靠吃鱼（可能包括鲑鱼）生存，而南方种群则在陆地上狩猎。

body.en:
New research led by scientists at the University of California, Santa Cruz, is reshaping what is known about Miracinonyx trumani , the extinct North American predator commonly called the American cheetah. Evidence from nuclear paleogenomes and stable isotopes shows that the animal was not actually a cheetah. Instead, it was a highly adaptable close relative of the puma, and populations living in the far north appear to have relied heavily on fish to survive in Arctic environments.

The findings, published on September 4 in Current Biology , also extend the known range of the species by about 20 degrees of latitude farther north than scientists had previously recognized. In places such as Wyoming and Florida, M. trumani lived as a generalist predator in temperate grasslands. In the Arctic Yukon, however, the cats occupied a very different ecological role as tertiary consumers and likely specialized in anadromous fish such as salmon.

Adult Miracinonyx trumani are thought to have weighed about 150 pounds on average, stood roughly 3 feet tall, and measured around 8 feet from head to the tip of the tail. Their slim bodies and long front legs may have helped them travel efficiently through the open landscapes of Pleistocene North America. Although their proportions resembled those of modern cheetahs, growing evidence suggests these cats were much more versatile hunters, able to chase prey on land while also using powerful forelimbs to grab and hold it.

"These cats were remarkably flexible, much like pumas are across their range today," said Molly Cassatt-Johnstone, a Ph.D. candidate in the Paleogenomics Lab at UC Santa Cruz and lead author of the study. "We found loss-of-function mutations in certain genes that regulate circadian rhythms, suggesting they may have adapted to the extreme light cycles of summers and winters in northern latitudes."

For many years, M. trumani played a major role in theories about the ecology of Ice Age North America. Scientists often pointed to the predator as a possible explanation for the extraordinary speed of the American pronghorn.

Under the "ghosts of predators past" hypothesis, pronghorns became exceptionally fast because they evolved alongside a cheetah-like predator capable of high-speed pursuit. Their speed, in this view, was an evolutionary defense against a hunter that later disappeared.

The new genomic evidence changes that picture. Researchers confirmed that M. trumani was a sister species of the modern puma and split from that evolutionary lineage about 2.6 million years ago. Its narrow, "cheetah-like" build therefore appears to be a vivid case of evolutionary convergence, in which unrelated species independently develop similar features because they face comparable environmental pressures.

To investigate...
body.zh: 由加州大学圣克鲁斯分校的科学家领导的一项新研究正在重塑人们对 Miracinonyx trumani 的了解，Miracinonyx trumani 是一种已灭绝的北美掠食者，通常被称为美洲猎豹。核古基因组和稳定同位素的证据表明，该动物实际上并不是猎豹。相反，它是美洲狮的一种适应性很强的近亲，生活在极北地区的人们似乎严重依赖鱼类在北极环境中生存。 这项研究结果发表在 9 月 4 日的《当代生物学》杂志上，还将该物种的已知分布范围扩大了约 20 度，比科学家之前认识的更北纬。在怀俄明州和佛罗里达州等地，杜鲁门巨蜥生活在温带草原上，是一种多面手捕食者。然而，在北极育空地区，猫科动物作为第三级消费者占据着非常不同的生态角色，并且可能专门捕食鲑鱼等溯河产卵鱼类。 据认为，成年 Miracinonyx trumani 平均重约 150 磅，站立时高约 3 英尺，从头到尾尖长约 8 英尺。它们纤细的身体和长长的前腿可能帮助它们有效地穿越更新世北美的开阔景观。尽管它们的比例与现代猎豹相似，但越来越多的证据表明，这些猫科动物是多才多艺的猎人，能够在陆地上追逐猎物，同时还可以使用强大的前肢抓住并抓住猎物。 “这些猫科动物非常灵活，就像今天分布范围内的美洲狮一样，”博士莫莉·卡萨特-约翰斯通说。加州大学圣克鲁斯分校古基因组学实验室的候选人，也是该研究的主要作者。 “我们发现某些调节昼夜节律的基因存在功能丧失突变，这表明它们可能已经适应了北纬地区夏季和冬季的极端光周期。” 多年来，特鲁马尼先生在有关北美冰河时代生态学的理论中发挥了重要作用。科学家们经常指出，捕食者可能是美洲叉角羚非凡速度的一个解释。 根据“掠食者过去的幽灵”假说，叉角羚变得异常快，因为它们是与能够高速追击的猎豹一样的掠食者一起进化的。从这个角度来看，它们的速度是对后来消失的猎人的进化防御。 新的基因组证据改变了这一情况。研究人员证实，杜鲁门巨蜥是现代美洲狮的姐妹物种，并在大约 260 万年前从该进化谱系中分离出来。因此，它狭窄的、“猎豹般”的体型似乎是进化趋同的生动例子，其中不相关的物种因为面临类似的环境压力而独立地发展出相似的特征。 为了调查...

reflection.en: New research reveals that the creature known as the 'American cheetah' was, in fact, a relative of the puma, demonstrating an adaptability that included eating fish in northern climates. This reminds us that Yahweh's creation holds many wonders, and careful observation can reveal profound truths about life's diversity and resilience. As Job 12:7 asks, 'But...
reflection.zh: 新的研究表明，被称为“美洲猎豹”的生物实际上是美洲狮的近亲，它展现出的适应能力包括在北方气候下食用鱼类。这提醒我们，雅伟的创造充满了奇迹，仔细观察可以揭示生命多样性和韧性的深刻真理。正如约伯记12:7所问：“但你且问走兽，它们必指教你；天空的飞鸟，它们也必告诉你。”

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.

title.en: Are rich people really worse behaved? Here’s the science – podcast
title.zh: 富人真的行为更差吗？科学是这么说的——播客

summary.en: Research suggests that wealthy individuals are more prone to unethical behavior, such as stealing sweets from children. This finding, which won an Ig Nobel prize, prompts reflection on the relationship between wealth and morality, with scientists exploring potential underlying reasons for this phenomenon.
summary.zh: 研究表明，富裕人士更容易做出不道德行为，例如偷窃儿童的糖果。这项获得搞笑诺贝尔奖的研究促使人们反思财富与道德之间的关系，科学家们正在探索这种现象背后可能的原因。

body.en: Who’s more likely to steal sweets from a child? According to science, it’s the rich. A study seemingly confirming our suspicions about the moral behaviour of the wealthy was one of the winners of the 2026 Ig Nobel prizes, which honour research that makes you laugh and then think. Science editor Ian Sample tells Madeleine Finlay what the researchers think could be behind the phenomenon, and they explore some of the other awards, including one for a surprising quality we look for in our friends and another for a biomechanical definition of kissing Rich people more likely to steal children’s sweets, finds Ig Nobel prize-winning study Support the Guardian: theguardian.com/sciencepod Continue reading...
body.zh: 谁更有可能偷孩子的糖果？根据科学，这是有钱人。一项似乎证实了我们对富人道德行为的怀疑的研究成为 2026 年搞笑诺贝尔奖的获得者之一，该奖项旨在表彰那些让你开怀大笑并引发思考的研究。科学编辑伊恩·萨普告诉玛德琳·芬利，研究人员认为这一现象背后可能存在什么，他们还探讨了其他一些奖项，其中一个奖项是为了我们在朋友身上寻找的令人惊讶的品质，另一个奖项是为了亲吻的生物力学定义，搞笑诺贝尔奖获奖研究发现有钱人更有可能偷孩子的糖果支持卫报：theguardian.com/sciencepod 继续阅读...

reflection.en: This Ig Nobel prize-winning study humorously highlights a potential disconnect between wealth and ethical conduct, suggesting that affluence might correlate with a greater willingness to transgress. It prompts us to consider the societal implications of such findings and the importance of justice and mercy in all walks of life, regardless of economic status.
reflection.zh: 这项搞笑诺贝尔奖获奖研究以幽默的方式揭示了财富与道德行为之间可能存在的脱节，暗示富裕可能与更强的越轨意愿相关。它促使我们思考此类发现的社会影响，以及无论经济地位如何，在所有生活领域中公正和怜悯的重要性。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: ‘This is dangerous’: slime moulds and the bitter debate over the nature of intelligence
title.zh: “这很危险”：黏菌与关于智能本质的激烈辩论

summary.en: Scientists are debating whether simple organisms like slime molds should be considered intelligent, a discussion that could fundamentally alter our perception of the natural world and humanity's place within it. This debate has been ongoing for decades, stemming from observations of slime molds that challenge...
summary.zh: 科学家们正在争论像黏菌这样的简单生物是否应被视为“智能”，这场辩论可能会重塑我们对自然世界的理解以及我们在其中的位置。这场争论已持续数十年，源于对黏菌的观察，这些观察挑战了对智能的传统定义。

body.en: Scientists are battling over whether supposedly simple organisms should be considered ‘intelligent’. The outcome could reshape our understanding of the natural world – and our own place within it Forty years ago, as an undergraduate in Hokkaido, Toshiyuki Nakagaki came upon a lemon-yellow stain in a petri dish. That encounter turned him into a doyen of slime mould research – and fed a storm of biological and philosophical debate about the meanings of life and intelligence that persists to this day. Before, no one would have called a slime mould “intelligent”; the popular adjective, in fact, was “simple”. “A simple mass of protoplasm,” one 1895 description ran; “among the most simple of organisms”, said another. And it was hard to argue otherwise. A slime mould can appear to be just a small cell, capable only of feeding and reproducing. Simple is as simple does. Of that first meeting, Nakagaki said: “I was just impressed with how fast it moved.” Physarum polycephalum , the slime mould species in that petri dish, has a top speed of 1cm an hour. For amoebic organisms, that’s gold-medal standard. At first glance, Physarum seems to spread as irregularly as ink on blotting paper, but in fact it senses its meals of bacteria or other microbes and reaches for them with a long, thin finger of protoplasm – which not only digests its food but then forages further or pulls back into the rest of the mould. It’s impossible to watch a slime mould over many days without sensing some deliberation at play. Continue reading...
body.zh: 科学家们正在争论所谓的简单有机体是否应该被视为“智能”。这一结果可能会重塑我们对自然世界以及我们自己在其中的地位的理解。 四十年前，作为北海道的一名本科生，Toshiyuki Nakagaki 在培养皿中发现了柠檬黄色的污渍。那次遭遇使他成为粘菌研究的元老，并引发了一场关于生命和智力意义的生物学和哲学争论，这场争论一直持续到今天。以前，没有人会称粘菌为“智能”；现在，它已经成为一种智能。事实上，流行的形容词是“简单”。 1895 年的一篇描述写道：“一团简单的原生质”； “是最简单的生物体之一”，另一个人说。很难反驳其他观点。粘菌看起来只是一个小细胞，只能进食和繁殖。简单就是简单。谈到第一次会面，中垣说：“会议进展之快给我留下了深刻的印象。”多头绒泡菌 (Physarum polycephalum) 是该培养皿中的粘菌种类，其最高速度为每小时 1 厘米。对于阿米巴生物来说，这是金牌标准。乍一看，绒泡菌似乎像吸墨纸上的墨水一样不规则地传播，但事实上，它感知到了细菌或其他微生物的食物，并用细长的原生质手指触碰它们——它不仅消化了它的食物，还进一步觅食或拉回霉菌的其余部分。观察粘菌很多天，你不可能不感受到其中的深思熟虑。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The ongoing scientific debate about the intelligence of slime molds invites us to consider the profound wisdom embedded within creation itself. As Job asks, 'But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds of the air, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or the fish in the sea, and they will explain to you.' (Job...
reflection.zh: 关于黏菌智能的科学争论，邀请我们思考造物本身所蕴含的深刻智慧。正如约伯所问：“但你且问走兽，可也教训你；飞鸟，也可告诉你；或与地说话，地也必指教你；海中的鱼，也必向你说明。”（约伯记 12:7-8）。这次探索提醒我们，雅伟精妙的设计即使在最简单的生命形式中也得以展现，只要我们愿意观察和学习，就能从中获得教诲。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
